title: Head of Engineering | Gaming / B2C Products | AI/ML | CTO Track
description:
Engineering Lead/Head of Engineering – CTO Track

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and visionary
**Engineering Lead**
to take ownership of the overall engineering function at a high-growth, well-funded B2B gaming technology startup.

This is a strategic leadership opportunity for a technology leader who can drive end-to-end engineering, define technical architecture, scale products to millions of users, build high-performing engineering teams, and accelerate AI adoption across products and engineering operations.

Working closely with the Co-Founder, the selected candidate will play a critical role in shaping the company's technology vision, engineering strategy, and execution roadmap, with a clear progression path towards the
**Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**
position.

Key Responsibilities

* **Technical Strategy & Architecture:**
  Define and own the technology vision, engineering architecture, and long-term technical roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* **Engineering Leadership:**
  Lead, mentor, and scale engineering teams, including hiring senior engineers, developing engineering managers, and building second-line leadership.
* **Product Scalability:**
  Drive the development and scaling of high-performance products capable of supporting millions of users while ensuring reliability, availability, security, and cost efficiency.
* **AI/ML Integration:**
  Drive meaningful AI/ML adoption across product development, engineering workflows, and business applications.
* **Engineering Execution:**
  Own end-to-end delivery, sprint planning, release management, engineering productivity, quality standards, and incident management.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with Product, Design, and Business teams to translate customer requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* **Engineering Excellence:**
  Establish engineering best practices, development standards, performance metrics, and operational processes.
* **Organizational Development:**
  Build a strong engineering culture, develop technical leaders, and establish an operating model aligned with future CTO responsibilities.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 10+ years of overall software engineering experience with substantial technical and engineering leadership exposure.
* Proven experience managing engineering teams of
  **10+ engineers**
  , either directly or through engineering managers/team leads.
* Strong background in the
  **Gaming Industry**
  , preferably with Real Money Gaming (RMG) platforms or companies.
* Approximately 5–6 years of experience working in B2C technology companies or consumer-facing products.
* Proven experience in high-growth startup environments, preferably scaling B2C products from early stages to millions of users.
* Strong hands-on technical expertise in software architecture, system design, and large-scale application development.
* Demonstrable AI/ML expertise through hands-on projects, product implementations, or technology leadership initiatives.
* Experience owning end-to-end engineering strategy, product delivery, and technology operations.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Software Architecture & System Design
* Node.js / Backend Engineering
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Distributed Systems & Scalable Applications
* AI / Machine Learning Integration
* High-Availability Systems & Performance Optimization
* Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering Operations
* Engineering Team Management & Leadership
* Product Scaling & Technology Roadmap

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in funded or high-growth B2C technology startups.
* Exposure to Real Money Gaming (RMG), online gaming, gaming platforms, or high-traffic consumer applications.
* Experience scaling platforms to millions of users.
* Strong understanding of AI-driven product innovation and engineering automation.
* Experience working directly with founders or executive leadership teams.

**Reporting Structure & Career Opportunity**

* **Reporting To:**
  Co-Founder
* **Initial Interview:**
  Direct interaction with the Co-Founder.
* **Career Progression:**
  Clear opportunity to grow into the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role based on performance and organizational growth.

**Additional Information**

* The role is strictly based in Hyderabad, India.
* Work from Office (On-site) is mandatory.
* Compensation starts at ₹1 Cr+ fixed annual salary.
* This is a senior strategic leadership position with end-to-end ownership of engineering and technology execution.

title: HMI Lead (VC++, MFC, WIN32, 6-10yrs)
description:
**HMI Software Lead Developer– UAV Ground Control Systems (VC++, MFC, Win32)**

**Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles.

**What You Will Do**

* Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance desktop applications used for UAV mission planning, live telemetry tracking, and payload control.
* Core Development: Write, review, and optimize complex multithreaded code using VC++, MFC, and Win32 APIs for Windows environments.
* Team Mentorship: Guide a team of software engineers, enforcing rigorous code quality, memory management practices, and peer review standards.
* Systems Integration: Interface ground software with UAV flight controllers and communication links using protocols like MAVLink, UDP/TCP, and custom serial interfaces.
* Safety & Compliance: Champion aerospace software standards (such as DO-178C guidelines where applicable) to ensure mission-critical reliability and fault tolerance.
* Legacy Modernization: Strategically decouple and refactor legacy MFC codebases into modular architectures to support future cross-platform or UI/UX scaling.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software development with a minimum of 2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity.
* Core Stack: Deep, uncompromising expertise in C++, VC++, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), and Win32 API.
* Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment.
* Networking: Proven experience with network socket programming (TCP/UDP) for real-time, low-latency data streaming.
* Problem Solving: Exceptional debugging skills using Visual Studio tools, WinDbg, and performance profilers.

* Standout Qualifications (Nice to Have)Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or UAV industry developing GCS or avionics software.
* Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS), map rendering (GDAL, QtLocation), or 3D rendering (OpenGL/DirectX).
* Knowledge of aerospace safety-critical verification processes (DO-178C, DO-330).

**Why Join Us?**

You will be directly influencing the software that commands next-generation unmanned aerial systems. We offer a culture of high engineering rigor, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to build products that solve real-world logistical and defense challenges.

**How to Apply**

Apply job here on LinkedIN. OR

Please send your resume to communications@qubistsolutions.com.

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
**About QualMinds**

At QualMinds, we design and develop world-class digital products and custom software solutions for Startups, Scale-ups, and Enterprises. Our engineering teams specialize in Frontend, Backend, Full Stack Development, QA Automation, UI/UX, DevOps, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Agile Delivery. We are passionate about building customer-centric software with the highest standards of quality, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Experience:**
8+ years (3+ years in production LLM/agentic systems, with proven multi-agent architecture experience)

**Job Summary**

We are building
**multi-agent AI systems**
for the automotive dealership ecosystem — networks of specialized, collaborating agents spanning
**customer-facing conversational experiences**
(voice and chat agents on dealership websites that handle inventory search, payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offers, test drive and service scheduling, and lead capture) and
**internal business agents**
(conversational and autonomous operation of campaign management, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — with proactive insights, recommendations, and human-approved actions).

These are not single-chatbot solutions: you will architect
**orchestrated teams of agents**
— planners, retrievers, domain specialists, action executors, and reviewer/critic agents — that coordinate, hand off, and share context to complete complex business workflows reliably. You will own these systems across the
**entire agentic development lifecycle**
: use-case scoping, multi-agent architecture and tool design, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Proven experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures**
  : supervisor/orchestrator patterns, hierarchical and peer-to-peer agent topologies, planner–executor–critic loops, agent handoffs, task decomposition and delegation, shared state/memory design, and failure isolation between agents.
* Hands-on with current agent frameworks and SDKs with strong multi-agent support:
  **LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI, or Vercel AI SDK**
  — including subagents, handoffs, and graph-based orchestration.
* Deep experience with frontier model APIs:
  **OpenAI (GPT-5.x, Realtime API), Anthropic (Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.x), Google (Gemini 3.x, Gemini Live)**
  ; familiarity with open-weight models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) for per-agent cost/latency routing (e.g., small fast models for routing/critic agents, frontier models for planning).
* Expert in
  **tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
  — designing and building MCP servers that expose business systems (inventory, CRM, campaigns, payments, reporting) as governed agent tools; working knowledge of
  **A2A (Agent2Agent)**
  for cross-platform agent interoperability.
* **Realtime voice AI**
  : speech-to-speech pipelines (OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini Live, LiveKit Agents, Pipecat), STT/TTS providers (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia), barge-in/interruption handling, sub-second latency optimization, WebRTC and telephony integration — including voice agents that delegate to backend specialist agents mid-conversation.
* Production
  **RAG and context engineering**
  : vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Vertex AI Search, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and reranking, context window management across agent hops, shared and per-agent memory (short-term, long-term, episodic), and freshness strategies for fast-changing data (inventory, offers, pricing).
* **Agent evaluation and observability**
  : LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, or custom harnesses — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge,
  **multi-agent trajectory evals**
  (correct delegation, handoff quality, loop/runaway detection), eval-gated CI/CD; OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions with distributed tracing across agent boundaries.
* **Guardrails and AI safety**
  : prompt-injection defense, jailbreak resistance, PII redaction, content moderation, inter-agent trust boundaries, human-in-the-loop approval flows for consequential actions (payments, campaign sends, customer messaging), and compliance-aware messaging (TCPA).
* Strong
  **Python and TypeScript**
  ; modern backend (FastAPI, Node.js) and frontend (
  **React/Next.js**
  ) development, including streaming and realtime UX (SSE, WebSockets, WebRTC) and generative UI patterns.
* Cloud-native delivery:
  **GCP (Vertex AI, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager)**
  or equivalent on AWS/Azure; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; durable execution for long-running agent workflows (e.g., Temporal) is a plus.
* Modern engineering workflow: GitHub (Actions, PR reviews), Jira/Linear, prompt and agent versioning, feature-flagged and eval-gated releases.
* Effective daily use of
  **AI-assisted development tools**
  (GitHub Copilot, coding agents, Claude Code, Cursor) and the judgment to review their output critically.
* PostgreSQL and modern data tooling; event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) for agent-triggered and agent-to-agent workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present AI risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* **Architect multi-agent systems end-to-end**
  : decompose business workflows into specialized agents (routing, retrieval, domain reasoning, action execution, review/critique), choose the right orchestration topology per use case, and define agent contracts, handoff protocols, and shared memory/state.
* Design and build customer-facing voice + chat agent teams covering the full public website capability surface: inventory search and comparison, finance/payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offer discovery, appointment scheduling, and lead capture/qualification — with low-latency realtime voice, streaming chat, graceful fallback, and human handoff.
* Ground all agent responses in live business data with strict accuracy guarantees — no hallucinated prices, VINs, or offers — and implement brand-safe guardrails for public surfaces (prompt injection, jailbreaks, off-topic containment, PII handling).
* Build internal multi-agent workflows that operate backend business platforms conversationally and autonomously: campaigns, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — following the
  **insight → recommendation → approved action**
  pattern with specialist agents collaborating under an orchestrator.
* Expose business capabilities as MCP tools with role-based permissions, audit logging, and approval policies scaled to action risk (read vs. draft vs. send vs. pay); enforce least-privilege tool access per agent.
* Build natural-language analytics: NL-to-SQL/semantic-layer querying, automated forecasting summaries, and scheduled executive digests.
* Own evaluation end-to-end: golden datasets per use case, offline regression suites,
  **multi-agent trajectory and delegation evals**
  , eval gates in CI/CD, A/B testing, and production quality monitoring (containment, conversion, CSAT).
* Establish LLMOps/AgentOps practices: prompt and agent versioning, per-agent model routing and semantic caching for cost control, token/latency budgets across agent chains, and observability dashboards with cross-agent distributed tracing.
* Lead root-cause analysis for agent failures (bad tool calls, wrong delegation, runaway loops, hallucinations, unsafe outputs) with durable systemic fixes and new guardrails.
* Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and platform teams to translate business workflows into agent capabilities and clear delivery plans; mentor engineers on multi-agent patterns, context engineering, and evaluation discipline; report AI system health, risks, and trends to leadership with supporting data.

title: Principal Engineer (MERN)
description:
**Design it, build it, and own it in production.**
Anyone can draw a system diagram. What sets great architects apart is what happens after: whether the design holds when traffic grows tenfold, whether security survives a real audit, and whether teams can still build on it two years later.
  
  
Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products
**JustInterview.ai**
(AI hiring) and
**Sparrow**
(API testing). Our systems handle sensitive patient data and real financial transactions at scale. We’re looking for a hands-on Software Architect to shape how these platforms are built, write code alongside the team, and stay accountable for how they perform in production.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the architecture: System design, APIs, data models, security, scalability, observability, and cloud cost.
* Build security in: Design PHI and payment flows with compliance part of the architecture, not a retrofit.
* Drive cloud-native delivery: MERN platforms on AWS/GCP/Azure with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and secrets management.
* Make the hard calls: Monolith vs. microservices, event-driven design, integrations, build vs. buy. Decide, document, and stand behind it.
* Own reliability: Uptime, latency, and throughput as usage grows; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Set the standard: Reference architectures, reusable patterns, and practical engineering guidelines.
* Stay hands-on: Write code, run design reviews, and review PRs every week.
* Think like the client: Translate business goals and constraints into architecture that fits.
* Grow leaders: Mentor senior engineers and develop future tech leads.

**Your First 90 Days**

* Days 1–30: Learn our products, codebases, and infrastructure, and identify the biggest architectural risks and opportunities.
* Days 31–60: Lead a significant design decision from proposal to production and take a visible role in design reviews.
* Days 61–90: Introduce standards or patterns that teams adopt, and become the go-to technical authority on a core platform.

**Must Have**

* 6+ years in software engineering with clear ownership of architecture decisions
* Experience running a production system with 100,000+ users
* Proven track record of solving serious scale and performance bottlenecks
* Strong hands-on Node.js and React (MERN preferred) with TypeScript
* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Background in healthcare, fintech, payments, insurance, or another high-security domain
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design, databases, and reliability
* Ability to explain and defend technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences

**Nice to Have**

* HIPAA/PHI, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2 compliance experience
* Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, or tokenization experience
* High-availability, event-driven, or microservices systems
* Consultancy or product-studio experience across multiple clients
* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

**Why Techdome**

* Independent and profitable: No investor pressure. We play the long game.
* Real influence: Set engineering standards for an 80+ engineer team.
* Fast path to production: Your designs ship quickly and reach real users.
* Global team: Engineers across India, Dubai, and the US.

title: Founding AI FDE Lead / Architect - Enterprise Solutions
description:

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong AI Forward Deployed Lead/Architect Profile owning the full journey from client discovery to production, hands-on and client-facing

* Mandatory (Experience 6): Must have worked directly with enterprise-level clients in a client-facing capacity
* Mandatory (Experience 7): Must have built and led their own team, creating a pod structure per project, and mentored junior AI engineers and consultants
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must be hands-on with Python, LLM frameworks (LangChain/LlamaIndex/HuggingFace) and cloud AI (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Mandatory (Skill 1): Must have strong storytelling, making complex AI accessible to business audiences without dumbing it down, and define AI architecture patterns and bring emerging frameworks/research back to the team
* Mandatory (Skill 2): Must take strong ownership, be genuinely enthusiastic and client-facing (not a pure-research or low-energy profile), thrive in ambiguity and 0 to 1 environments, and want to join long-term as part of the company (ESOP pool)
* Mandatory (Company): Must have experience across both services and product (this is a services-plus-product hybrid; candidates keen on pure product only are not a fit)
* Mandatory (Background): Must come from an AI/ML, data analytics or data-platform company with enterprise client delivery, ideally with startup or growing-company experience having seen AI build cycles in 0 to 1 / ambiguous environments; Supply Chain AI exposure, or manufacturing/logistics, B2B SaaS AI or MLOps background, a plus
* Mandatory (Pedigree): Must have strong pedigree, ideally IIT, then BITS/NITs/IIITs, with a CSE/IT background; strong equivalent capability also considered
* Mandatory (Note 1): CTC is inclusive of the variable component (around 25:75)
* Mandatory (Note 2): First 2 to 3 months on a consultant basis (same CTC, without full-time employee benefits) so both sides can assess fit, then converts to a full-time role
* Preferred (Global exposure): Global client exposure (US/Europe/Middle East/SEA) and cross-cultural fluency

Experience: 7–10 years · Work from office · 5 days a week · Notice period up to 60 days

Benefits
  
  
- Growth Pathway to Principal technical leadership shaping company strategy
- Equity/ESOP pool participation
- Merit-based growth track

title: Tosca Automation Lead / Architect
description:
**Experience:**
10+ years

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office (5 days a week)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Tosca Automation Lead / Architect to design, build, and lead test automation for SAP S/4HANA and related applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca, SAP Fiori / web-based SAP applications, reusable automation design, Tosca LiveCompare, DEX Server execution, qTest integration, reporting, and Playwright with AI-assisted automation. The candidate will help improve automation coverage, execution reliability, visibility, and release readiness.

**Responsibilities**

* Define the automation strategy, framework design, standards, and roadmap for SAP S/4HANA and related applications.
* Design, develop, and maintain reusable Tosca automation for functional, end-to-end, integration, and regression testing.
* Use Tosca LiveCompare to assess SAP changes, identify impacted test cases, and support risk-based regression selection.
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot distributed test execution using Tosca DEX Server, including execution planning, agents, scheduling, and results monitoring.
* Integrate Tosca with qTest and other relevant tools for test management, execution tracking, defect management, CI/CD, and reporting.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for automation coverage, execution status, pass/fail trends, defects, failures, risks, and release readiness.
* Create reusable Tosca modules, components, test data approaches, and templates to support repeatable testing across stores, locations, and configuration variations.
* Assess SAP Fiori and web-based SAP application behavior and select appropriate Tosca automation approaches.
* Lead automation planning for regression cycles, releases, and deployment waves; coordinate with SAP functional, QE, and business teams.
* Review automation assets, troubleshoot failures, improve stability, and establish standards for maintainability, reuse, and execution efficiency.
* Evaluate Playwright-based automation and help define where Tosca and Playwright are best suited, including integration into the broader QE approach.
* Apply AI-assisted testing capabilities with Playwright, including AI-supported test design and generation, script creation, failure analysis, locator recovery or self-healing where appropriate, and agentic workflows.
* Evaluate opportunities to connect AI-driven workflows with MCP, LLM-based tools, or other approved AI capabilities while maintaining human review, security, and traceability.
* 10+ years of experience in Quality Engineering / test automation, including substantial hands-on Tosca experience.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale automation using Tricentis Tosca.
* Practical experience with Tosca LiveCompare for change-impact analysis and regression test selection.
* Experience configuring and supporting Tosca DEX Server and distributed execution.
* Experience integrating Tosca with qTest and other test management, defect tracking, CI/CD, or reporting tools.
* Experience developing automation dashboards and reports and interpreting execution and quality metrics.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA testing and SAP Fiori or other web-based SAP applications.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Post Trade
description:
**About Us**
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Post Trade Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of our brokerage systems. You will work closely with our engineering team and other stakeholders to create scalable, low-latency, and highly available trading systems.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build new products and features while supporting and enhancing existing ones, owning the technical architecture, design, and delivery of high-performance, low-latency brokerage systems using Java
* Partner with Product and Operations to understand requirements, translate them into implementable technical features, and deliver them
* Design and build event-driven architectures using Kafka, packaged with Docker and deployed on Kubernetes
* Support production applications by triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues, drawing on an understanding of system integration, scripting, and test planning.
* Build observability, resilience, and recoverability into applications.
* Assess the health and performance of software applications and databases, and provide software and technology solutions
* Define specifications, develop components, modify the existing software stack, prepare test data, and prepare functional specifications
* Analyze service and application performance using various programming languages, tools, and techniques

**You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
* At least 7 years of experience in Software Engineering with expertise in Java and spring framework.
* Proficient in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs and implementing sophisticated event-driven architectures using Kafka, deployed on Kubernetes.
* Capital Markets or financial technology background (required), with a focus on the trade lifecycle.
* Experience with Jira, Git, and shell scripting(writing scripts to extract and transform data)
* Proficient in NoSQL, SQL, and stored procedures, such as in PostgreSQL and MySQL
* Understanding of Test-Driven Development and how to write effective unit and integration tests
* Working knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices, such as JFrog Artifactory, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation etc
* Experience with a 24/7, highly available architecture
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (required)
* Experience with Scrum and other Agile processes
* Strong analytical,communication and problem-solving skills

**Location**
This role is open to candidates in the following locations:
**Hyderabad, IN**

* This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
* If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

**Working at DriveWealth**
We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.
  
  
To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.
  
  
**Work Authorization**
Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.
  
  
For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.
  
  
**How We Think About AI**
We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.
  
  
**Compensation**
Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **Experience:**
8–15 Years

**Role:**
Manager / Senior Manager

**Practice:**
Consulting – Strategy Team

**Domain:**
SAP Finance & Controlling (FICO)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SAP FICO Manager / Senior Manager to join the Consulting & Strategy team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Finance and Controlling, finance transformation, solution design, and SAP implementation consulting. The role involves leading SAP finance transformation initiatives, advising clients on business process improvements, designing scalable SAP solutions, and managing end-to-end consulting engagements.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead SAP FICO consulting engagements, including finance transformation, implementation, rollout, and optimization projects.
* Drive strategic assessments, business process analysis, fit-gap analysis, and finance transformation roadmaps.
* Design and review SAP FICO solutions aligned with client business requirements and industry best practices.
* Manage core SAP Finance and Controlling processes, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders.
* Lead SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation initiatives, including migration and system conversion projects.
* Advise clients on financial process standardization, automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Manage client stakeholders, workshops, solution presentations, and executive-level discussions.
* Lead functional teams, manage project delivery, and ensure quality, timelines, and budget adherence.
* Oversee functional design documents, configuration reviews, testing strategies, cutover planning, and go-live support.
* Drive integration between SAP FICO and other modules, including SAP MM, SD, and CO-related processes.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, value creation, and technology-enabled finance transformation.
* Contribute to business development activities, proposal preparation, solution estimation, and consulting practice growth.
* Mentor team members and support capability development within the SAP Finance consulting practice.

Required Skills & Experience

* 8–15 years of relevant SAP FICO functional and consulting experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in SAP FI and CO configuration, solution design, and implementation.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance and finance transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of financial accounting, management accounting, and end-to-end finance processes.
* Experience leading consulting engagements, client workshops, and cross-functional teams.
* Proven experience in requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution architecture, and functional design.
* Experience in SAP FICO integration with SAP MM, SD, and other relevant modules.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business and finance requirements into scalable SAP solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in a consulting, professional services, or strategy-led transformation environment.
* Exposure to SAP Central Finance, Group Reporting, Universal Journal, or advanced S/4HANA Finance capabilities.
* SAP certification in SAP FICO or SAP S/4HANA Finance.
* Experience in proposal development, pre-sales, business development, and consulting practice management.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification in Finance, Management, or a related discipline is an advantage.

title: Lead Engineer - Cloud Engineering
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
**Technical Lead, AWS & AI-First Engineering (Horizontal) – Provider Payments**
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Experience:**
8-12 years
  
  
**Role type:**
Horizontal technical leader across Provider Engineering Pods (influence-based; direct reports not required)
  
  
**About The Role**
Provider Payments platforms process high-volume, high-stakes financial transactions for healthcare. We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who raises the engineering bar across multiple Provider Engineering Pods rather than within a single team. You will set standards, shape architecture, mentor engineers, ensure trusted payment data flows into the analytics layer, and make AI-assisted engineering a repeatable, measurable way of working across pods.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Lead across pods**

* Act as the horizontal technical authority across Provider Engineering Pods, setting engineering standards and reference patterns that teams actually adopt.
* Influence architecture decisions and roadmaps through credibility, clear communication, and hands-on contribution rather than reporting lines.
* Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads, and build a culture of technical ownership and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Engineering to turn business outcomes into sound technical direction.

**Architect and build on AWS**

* Lead AWS architecture, application modernization, and cloud-native engineering for Provider Payments platforms.
* Design and build solutions using EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC.
* Drive microservices, event-driven architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and API-first design.
* Modernize legacy applications into scalable, resilient AWS-based architectures.
* Build highly available platforms for high-volume transactional and payment workloads, with strong security, authentication, authorization, observability, and operational readiness.

**Engineer hands-on**

* Contribute directly in .NET Core / .NET 6+, C#, and ASP.NET Core, building REST APIs and distributed systems.
* Work across SQL Server and NoSQL stores, messaging, and asynchronous processing.
* Apply Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, and CI/CD as everyday tools.

**Enable payment data and analytics on Snowflake**

* Design reliable data flows from transactional and event-driven systems on AWS into Snowflake for payment analytics, reporting, and reconciliation.
* Guide data modeling, ingestion patterns, and data quality so payment data is accurate, auditable, and secure (PHI/PCI-aware).
* Keep Snowflake performance and cost under control, and set shared patterns that pods reuse.

**Make AI-first engineering real**

* Promote and operationalize AI/GenAI-assisted engineering across coding and code reviews, test generation, documentation, troubleshooting and incident analysis, observability and operations, and developer productivity.
* Build reusable AI agents, skills, and engineering automation that multiple pods can share.
* Define and track metrics (for example cycle time, review turnaround, test coverage, incident resolution time) so AI adoption delivers measurable productivity gains, not just tool familiarity.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 8-12 years of software engineering experience, with deep hands-on AWS expertise.
* Strong modern .NET (.NET 6+ / ASP.NET Core / C#) engineering skills.
* Proven experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems at scale.
* Hands-on Snowflake experience: data modeling, ingestion from AWS sources, and performance and cost awareness.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership: setting standards, mentoring, and influencing architecture without formal authority.
* Demonstrated AI-assisted engineering adoption that went beyond personal use of Copilot or ChatGPT and delivered repeatable, measurable team-level improvement.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration skills.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Domain exposure to Provider Payments, Claims, Payment Integrity, Revenue Cycle Management, or healthcare financial platforms.
* Track record of large-scale cloud modernization.
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect Professional/Associate, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent).

**Leadership Profile**

* Strong technical ownership and a bias toward outcomes
* Architectural judgment and the ability to influence roadmaps
* Coaching mindset and a growth orientation
* Collaborative, credible, and effective across pods without relying on authority
* Customer and business-outcome focus

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* Shared engineering standards and reference architectures adopted across multiple pods
* Visible modernization progress on priority Provider Payments workloads
* Trusted, well-modeled payment data flowing into Snowflake for reconciliation and reporting
* A working library of reusable AI agents and skills with measurable productivity gains
* Stronger resiliency, observability, and operational readiness on critical payment flows
* Mentored engineers and tech leads growing into broader ownership

**Key hiring combination:**
Deep AWS + strong modern .NET + Snowflake + microservices/event-driven architecture + hands-on leadership + AI-first engineering mindset + ability to influence horizontally across Provider Engineering Pods.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Lead Engineer - Platform
description:
**About Chubb**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com .
  
  
**About Chubb India**
At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow
  
  
With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.
  
  
We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
  
  
**Position Details**
**Job Title:**
Lead Engineer
  
  
**Function/Department:**
Technology
  
  
**Experience:**
12–15 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Lead Engineer within our Ingestion Platform team here at Chubb, you will help rebuild how digital products are delivered to customers and partners worldwide. You will design and build the services, workflows, AI capabilities, and data pipelines that power that platform, and you will raise the technical bar for the engineers around you. As a key contributor on our team, you will own features end to end, from design through production, and who helps shape technical direction within your team. You will partner closely with architects, data scientists, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions in an insurance environment where reliability, privacy, security, and regulatory discipline are just as important as speed. With us, you will have the opportunity to directly shape core platform decisions, architect and deliver systems that scale, helping to define how we build and operate digital experiences with greater intelligence, resilience, and precision.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and build scalable services and APIs with clear contracts, idempotency, retries, and failure isolation, and take features from user stories and acceptance criteria to production in an agile SDLC
* Contribute to design and architecture reviews, propose improvements to standards and tooling, and write clean, testable, observable code with strong unit, integration, and contract tests
* Integrate with internal systems and external partners through governed APIs, event streams, and webhooks, with schema versioning
* Build durable workflows and agentic AI features using tools like Temporal, Camunda, Step Functions, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or the Claude Agent SDK, including human-in-the-loop steps, tool calling, MCP, and guardrails
* Evaluate and monitor AI features with prompt versioning, evaluation sets, tool-call accuracy, task success, cost, latency, and human review gates
* Build RAG, memory, ontology, and document capabilities, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evaluation, and structured knowledge extraction
* Protect retrieval and AI inputs with document access control, PII/PCI redaction, and defenses against prompt injection, while following security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, manage branching and release practices, review code thoroughly, keep pipelines healthy, resolve root causes, mentor engineers, and improve cloud-native automation where it helps

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building distributed, data-intensive or platform systems in production; knowledge of and/or experience with insurance processes, regulatory requirements and industry standards is a plus
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong programming in Python, Java, Scala or similar, and strong SQL, with experience of microservices, APIs and event-driven architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP; experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and/or GitOps is a plus
* Solid distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, retries and backoff, circuit breakers, consistency, structured logging, distributed tracing and correlation IDs; experience with Temporal, Camunda, AWS Step Functions, and/or Cadence is a plus
* Experience with streaming (Kafka, Kinesis or Event Hubs) and distributed data processing (Spark, Flink or Beam), and with data modelling for SQL and NoSQL stores; experience with Delta Lake, Iceberg, and data governance and/or metadata management is a plus
* Hands-on experience with LLM-based applications including at least one production or serious prototype using RAG (chunking, embeddings, vector search) or agents with tool calling; experience with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, MCP, and LLM evaluation and/or observability tools is a plus
* Working knowledge of ontologies or knowledge graphs, and of data science and ML basics (Python data stack, model evaluation, how models are deployed and monitored); experience with Neo4j, MongoDB, GraphDB, JSON-LD, SHACL, Cypher, SPARQL, and/or Gremlin is a plus
* Hands-on CI/CD experience building and maintaining Jenkins pipelines (Jenkins file, shared libraries) with automated test, scan and release stages, and Git workflows with pull requests; experience with SonarQube, dependency and container scanning, SAST/DAST, and/or Artifactory or Nexus is a plus
* Strong code review experience, both providing and receiving reviews, as well as applying standards for correctness, security, testing and readability
* Additional depth in AI/ML platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude API, MLflow, Azure Machine Learning, or SageMaker is a plus

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**
Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
  
  
Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
  
  

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**
Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:
  
  

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Application Process**
Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.
  
  

* Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.
* Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

**Join Us**
With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a

title: SAP Finance Solution Architect
description:
**OUR MISSION**

**At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes with industry leading products and platforms developed through an AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle.**

**ABOUT US**

Redwood Software is the leader in full stack automation fabric solutions for mission-critical business processes. With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in the transformative power of automation and AI. Our unparalleled solutions empower you to orchestrate, manage and monitor your workflows across any application, service or server — in the cloud or on premises — with confidence and control, leveraging AI throughout the development process.

Redwood’s global team of automation experts and customer success engineers provide solutions and world-class support designed to give you the freedom and time to imagine and define your future. Our collaborative and dynamic environment fosters creativity, continuous learning, and a passion for building exceptional products with an emphasis on AI-driven development practices. Get out of the weeds and see the forest, with Redwood Software.

**CORE VALUES**

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

**YOUR IMPACT**

As an SAP ABAP Solution Architect, you will be a senior technical leader in Redwood’s Finance Automation product organization, working closely with the SAP Customizations team. Your primary mandate is to re-architect existing customer-specific ABAP customizations into reusable, configuration-driven (low-code/no-code) components that scale across the broader finance automation product suite — reducing our custom code footprint, improving upgrade safety, and accelerating customer onboarding.

You will analyze the ABAP customizations built for individual customers and finance processes, identify the common patterns behind them, and abstract those patterns into generic, metadata-driven frameworks. Working with product managers and engineering leads, you will define a scalable customization framework strategy for finance automation products such as invoice processing, reconciliation, close automation, and payment automation.

A key part of this role is setting the technical direction for the SAP Customizations team. You will lead technical design reviews, ensure new architecture aligns with S/4HANA best practices (Clean Core principles, side-by-side extensibility, and SAP BTP where applicable), and define the coding standards, reusable templates, and governance guardrails that prevent future one-off, non-generic builds.

Because generic components serve many customers at once, quality and documentation matter more than ever. You will work with engineering teams to define automated regression suites, and you will document architecture decisions, configuration guides, and migration paths from custom code to generic configuration.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on building generic product capability — not one-off client delivery. You will mentor ABAP developers and customization consultants as they adopt the new framework and low-code approach.

**Your responsibilities will also include:**

* **Customization Analysis:**
  Assess existing customer-specific ABAP customizations and identify common patterns that can be abstracted into generic, reusable frameworks.
* **Low-Code/No-Code Architecture:**
  Design configuration models (BRF+, custom Customizing tables, CDS-based parameterization, rules engines) that replace hard-coded logic.
* **Legacy Refactoring:**
  Refactor and re-platform legacy ABAP objects (reports, BAdIs, user-exits, enhancement spots) into standardized, metadata-driven solutions.
* **Framework Strategy:**
  Partner with product management and engineering leads to define a scalable customization framework for finance automation products.
* **Architecture Governance:**
  Lead technical design reviews aligned with S/4HANA Clean Core principles and side-by-side extensibility, and define coding standards, templates, and guardrails for the SAP Customizations team.
* **Quality Automation:**
  Collaborate with wider engineering to define automated regression suites for generic components that serve multiple customers.
* **Documentation & Enablement:**
  Document architecture decisions, configuration guides, and custom-to-configuration migration paths, and mentor ABAP developers and customization consultants on the new approach.

**Success in your first 90–180 days:**

* Deliver an architecture blueprint for converting at least one high-priority customization area into a generic, configurable component.
* Measurably reduce the number of customer-specific code branches against an agreed target.
* Establish reusable design patterns and templates adopted by the SAP Customizations team.

**YOUR EXPERIENCE**

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. You should have 12 to 18 years of overall experience, including 10+ years of hands-on SAP ABAP development, and at least 4 years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role designing reusable, generic SAP solutions rather than point customisations. Prior experience in a software product company, as opposed to a purely SI/implementation background, is highly desirable.

* Deep proficiency in ABAP, including OOP ABAP, BAdIs, user-exits, the enhancement framework, and CDS views.
* Strong understanding of SAP FI/CO or finance-adjacent processes (AP, AR, GL, Bank/Payment processing, Reconciliation); domain knowledge in finance automation is a strong plus.
* Experience with low-code/no-code enablement on SAP: BRF+, Customizing/config tables, Business Rules Framework, dynamic Fiori/UI5 configuration, or similar metadata-driven design patterns.
* Familiarity with S/4HANA Clean Core concepts and side-by-side extensibility via SAP BTP (ABAP Cloud, RAP – RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
* Proven experience refactoring legacy or monolithic custom code into modular, parameter-driven components.
* Experience defining coding standards, code reviews, and governance for ABAP development teams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams at the same time.
* AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated ability to use AI-powered developer tools (e.g., SAP Joule, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) in a production environment.

**ESSENTIAL AI-SKILLS (THE “NEW BAR”)**

* **AI Tool Fluency:**
  Demonstrated ability to proficiently use AI-powered developer tools (e.g., SAP Joule, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) for ABAP analysis, refactoring, and documentation.
* **Code Judgment:**
  Proven track record of evaluating and overriding AI-generated suggestions that are technically correct but architecturally flawed, not Clean Core compliant, or weak on security and performance.
* **Prompting Proficiency:**
  Experience writing clear, contextual, and effective prompts for generative AI to analyze legacy custom code, generate tests, and produce configuration and migration documentation.
* **Adaptability & Learning:**
  High degree of curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new AI tools and techniques that continuously reshape the development workflow.
* **Domain & Architectural Focus:**
  The capacity to abstract away from low-level coding details to focus on high-value finance business logic and systemic architectural integrity.

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience with RPA/workflow automation tools integrated with SAP.
* Exposure to Redwood’s or similar finance process automation products (e.g., job scheduling, process orchestration for finance).
* Knowledge of API-based/OData integration patterns for exposing configuration to non-technical business users.

**Successful candidates will also be expected to have:**

* Ability to stay updated with the latest SAP, S/4HANA, and BTP developments.
* Creative thinking and the ability to propose innovative solutions that align with business objectives.
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards relevant to financial systems.
* Ability to mentor and guide ABAP developers and customization consultants.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex SAP system issues and design scalable, upgrade-safe solutions.
* A product mindset focused on building generic capability that serves many customers.
* Participation in SAP community events, conferences, or publications as a speaker or contributor.

These qualifications equip an SAP ABAP Solution Architect to design and deliver scalable, configurable, and upgrade-safe finance automation solutions, while providing technical leadership and mentorship to the SAP Customizations team.

We believe that diverse teams build better products. At Redwood, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can thrive.

**WHY REDWOOD?**

* Lead one of Redwood’s most strategic product lines with enterprise-wide business impact.
* Competitive salary and benefits, with room to innovate and make your mark.
* Opportunity to work on innovative and impactful products that are transforming industries.
* Generous paid time off, holidays and flexible work arrangements.
* Work with a highly skilled, passionate, and diverse team of engineers.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.
* “One Redwood” company culture.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
Member of Technical Staff – Java Backend

Spring Boot · Kafka · Distributed Systems | 4–7 Years

📍 T-Hub, Hyderabad (On-site)

💼 4–7 years of professional Java backend experience

🕒 Full-time

🗓️ 6-day week for the first 9 months, then 5 days

🌐 https://thequipu.com

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ABOUT QUIPU

Quipu builds AI infrastructure for long-term enterprise memory. Our Knowledge Twin gives every entity in a complex system three things: its live current state, a causal history of what changed and why, and its meaning in a semantic graph. With that, engineering teams and AI agents can study cause and effect instead of guessing at it.

Our platform already supports real enterprise work:

• Automotive: component-level traceability and failure prediction

• Pharma: drug development with fewer high-risk experiments

• Energy & storage: cell-ageing models that teams can trust

• AI agents: a shared, persistent memory that never resets

THE PROBLEM WE'RE SOLVING

\* Enterprise data is scattered across warehouses, event streams, documents and tools, with no single view of any one entity

\* Most systems store the current state but lose the history

\* Without that causal history, teams guess at root causes, repeat costly experiments and can't audit decisions

\* AI agents have the same gap: no long-term memory, so thee trusted with high-stakes work

Quipu fixes this by giving every entity one audit-grade meaning full causal history and its meaning, all queryable by people and AI.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT WE'VE ACHIEVED

🏆 Commercial pilots with 2 Fortune 500 enterprises (pharma, US · automotive, EU)

🥇 Winner, Renault Open Innovation Challenge

🥇 Winner, Maruti Suzuki Innovation Program (NSRCEL, IIM Bangalore)

🚀 Selected for NetApp Excellerator, Cohort 15

🇮🇳 Selected for the IndiaAI Startups Global Acceleration Program (MeitY, Govt. of India), STATION F Paris. September 2026.

🇫🇮 Alumni, Maria 01 Northern Light Accelerator, Helsinki. September 2025.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

• On-site only, at T-Hub, Hyderabad

• 6-day week for the first 9 months, then a standard 5-day week

• You need at least 4 years of professional Java experience. We won't consider applications below that.

We're building core infrastructure on a tight timeline, so we'd rather tell you this now than surprise you later.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE ROLE

We want a backend engineer who thinks in systems, not just code. Our platform runs on an in-house, event-sourced, bitemporal graph database with its own Cypher query engine, built with Java, Spring Boot, Pekko and Kafka.

You'll own architecture decisions for the core services behind it: graph storage, streaming ingestion, ETL pipelines and semantic retrieval at scale. We expect you to think through trade-offs and failure modes before you write any code.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design, build and evolve the Spring Boot microservices at the heart of the platform

• Own architecture: service boundaries, data flow, failure handling and scaling strategy

• Build security in from the start: authN/authZ, multi-tenant data isolation and secrets management

• Build event-driven Kafka pipelines with stream processing that handles backpressure

• Build and run ingestion and ETL workflows across many kinds of data sources

• Model and query data across graph (Neo4j), distributed SQL (YugabyteDB), vector and key-value stores

• Own features end to end, from design through production, and debug them with logs, metrics and traces

• Lead and take part in design reviews, and explain your decisions clearly

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUST-HAVE

✅ 4–7 years of production experience with Java and Spring Boot

✅ Strong core Java: collections, concurrency and JVM internals

✅ Proven ownership of systems and service boundaries, not just single features

✅ Application security: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, RBAC/ABAC and secure API design

✅ Production experience with Kafka or a similar event-streaming platform

✅ Hands-on experience building or running ETL and data pipelines

✅ Distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, partitioning, idempotency, retries, backpressure and failure recovery

✅ Strong SQL, plus experience with at least one NoSQL or graph database

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

STRONG PLUS

⭐ Keycloak, HashiCorp Vault or production IAM integrations

⭐ Akka or Apache Pekko (actors, streams, cluster)

⭐ Neo4j, Cypher or graph data modelling

⭐ Distributed SQL such as YugabyteDB, CockroachDB or Spanner-class systems

⭐ Vector databases and semantic search, such as Milvus or pgvector

⭐ Python (FastAPI) for service sidecars

⭐ LLM-integrated systems: prompt pipelines, extraction workflows and RAG

⭐ Jenkins, Docker and containerised deployments on Linux

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHO YOU ARE

• You ask "Why is the system shaped this way?" before "What should I build?"

• You do well with ambiguity and ownership in a small team. You don't need rigid specs or hand-holding.

• You debug from first principles and write down what you learn

• You explain trade-offs clearly and disagree constructively

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT WE OFFER

🔹 Title: Member of Technical Staff

🔹 Real ownership of core infrastructure: what you build ships and matters right away

🔹 Hard, uncommon problems: bitemporal data modelling, graph traversal at scale and streaming knowledge extraction

🔹 Close mentorship from technical leadership on architecture and systems design

🔹 A small, high-ownership team building for Fortune 500 clients

The Core Engineering Builds And Operates The Platforms, Applications, Data Solutions, Models, And Analytics That Power Critical Processes For The Core Divisions Of The Firm (e.g., Risk, Responsible For The Risk Profile Of Firm Activities; Controllers, Responsible For The Financial Control And Reporting Obligations; Compliance, Responsible For The Firm’s Compliance, Regulatory, And Reputational Risks; Corporate Treasury, Responsible For The Firm’s Liquidity, Funding, Balance Sheet, Etc.; And Human Capital Management, Responsible For Attracting, Developing, And Managing a Global Workforce). A Centralized Engineering Structure In Support Of The Core Enables a Common Platform Model And Operating Framework That Promotes Consistent Governance And Scalable Solutions, Leveraging Cloud, AI, And Machine Learning For Innovation And Efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ Engineers And Strats Deliver Engineering, Data, Analytics, And Quantitative Capabilities Within Six Business Units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

****What We Do****
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital, and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.
  
  
The Core is responsible for financial control and regulatory obligations of the firm. They safeguard the assets of the firm through an independent scrutiny of the financial information and ensure accurate reporting to internal and external consumers. They provide critical metrics and related analysis to the firm’s and divisions’ leadership to navigate the evolving business strategy, including incumbent and strategic initiatives. Controllers play an important role in the changing landscape of the firm, including its new business ventures and acquisitions, and ensure that these new initiatives are in line with the regulatory expectations as well as controlled in terms of their incorporation into the firm
  
  
Engineers in The Core help ensure the firm meets all of its financial control and reporting obligations. Working in small and nimble teams, we build critical and complex software to calculate P&L, measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory filings across the globe.
  
  
**Our Impact**
The Core Engineering is responsible for designing and implementing solutions to manage firm’s profit and loss (P&L), measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory obligations. Our global agile teams (based across Americas, EMEA & Asia) develop and manage the platforms, calculation engines, and analytical tools that controllers, risk management, and deal-making teams use to project, monitor and report externally to regulators for both regular business activity and under stress scenarios.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge software and platforms that form the core of our key business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. We provide real-time access to critical deal information and process billions of data points each day to inform firm-wide market insights and strategies. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain subject matter expertise in both technology and finance, and to directly engage with colleagues and senior management from across the business, risk, finance, and technology.
  
  
**Why join the team**

* Tool & Technologies: You’ll program in Java and model data using Pure/Legend – a data management and data governance open source platform that we will teach you. Other technologies in use in our space: RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, HTML 5, AngularJs/ReactJs, IntelliJ, Gitlab, Jira, AWS solutions, AI platforms, Java, Python, RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, ReactJs/NextJs, IntelliJ/VSCode, Gitlab, Kubernates/Terraform.
* Cloud Technologies: You’ll be involved in building the next generation of finance systems onto the cloud platforms, one of the key strategy for the division to in which you’ll get exposure to technologies like AWS S3,Snowflake, EMR etc.
* Autonomy: You’ll have significant autonomy in designing and writing solutions to help our stakeholders deliver for the firm’s clients.
* Creativity: You’ll be encouraged to suggest improvements to products and to propose ways, in which we can add value for our stakeholders.
* Interpersonal Communication: You’ll engage with data producers and consumers across all areas of the business to understand their requirements and to propose solutions tailored to their needs.
* Training: Your manager will support your professional development, allowing you time for training at work, helping you learn and grow within the organization, and providing opportunities for increasing responsibility.

****Responsibilities****

* In an Agile environment manage end-to-end systems development cycle from requirements analysis to coding, testing, UAT, implementation and maintenance
* Develop high level/detailed technical designs, testing strategies, and implementation plans
* Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that provides exposure to all areas of Finance
* Understand and respond to business needs, facilitating and developing process workflow, data requirements, and specifications required to support implementation
* Build strong relationships with business partners
* Identify opportunities for cross-divisional collaboration and reuse of common solutions
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI-powered automations, prompt engineering concepts.

****Skills & Experience We Are Looking For****

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
* Hands-on software development experience preferably in Java, C/C++, Python, or Scala, exposure to RDBMS and NoSQL datastores
* Strong programming and problem-solving skills
* A clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design and core programming concepts
* Strong full-stack technical design and development skills and experience
* Comfortable with multi-tasking, managing multiple stakeholders and working as part of a team
* Excellent communication skills including experience speaking to technical & business audiences and working globally

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs.
