title: Solutions Architect
description:
**About the job**

**Job Title: Salesforce Solution Architect (Agentforce Revenue Management / ARM Specialist)**

**Experience:**
15 - 20 Years

**Employment Type:**
Permanent | Full-Time

**Shift & Hours:**
Regular Shift

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview:**

* Forsys Inc. is a technology consulting firm that helps enterprises modernise how they run revenue operations — from CPQ and Quote-to-Cash through to pricing, resourcing and delivery. We partner with our clients on high-impact, complex transformation programmes rather than staffing commodity work, which means our architects stay close to the design decisions that matter. We invest heavily in the growth of our consultants, from platform certifications to early access to emerging Salesforce capabilities such as Agentforce. Senior architects join us for the depth of the Lead-to-Cash problems and the freedom to shape the solution rather than just govern a slide pack.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* As a Senior Salesforce Solution Architect specialising in Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM) and Revenue Cloud, you will lead the Solution Delivery Lifecycle — translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure and supportable technical designs. You will architect end-to-end Quote-to-Cash solutions and govern the corporate business applications roadmap across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud. The role is deliberately hands-on: you will run design reviews, guide build teams, unblock technical issues and align stakeholders from business sponsors to engineering leads. Your design decisions directly determine how reliably our clients can quote, contract, bill and recognise revenue at scale.

**Requirements:**

* Act as the design authority for end-to-end Quote-to-Cash solutions on Agentforce Revenue Management and Revenue Cloud, covering product and pricing models, guided selling, quoting, ordering, contracts, billing and revenue recognition.
* Lead the Solution Delivery Lifecycle from requirement elaboration through design, build oversight, testing support and deployment, translating complex business processes into scalable technical designs.
* Define and govern the future-state architecture and roadmap for corporate business applications across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, ensuring a coherent platform strategy rather than point solutions.
* Architect ARM-specific capabilities including dynamic pricing waterfalls, order decomposition and orchestration, subscription and usage-based billing, amendments and renewals, and contract lifecycle management.
* Design integration patterns between Salesforce and enterprise ERP, finance, provisioning and data platforms, with clear interface contracts, error handling and reconciliation approaches.
* Chair and contribute to architecture governance forums — conducting design reviews, enforcing architectural standards, security policies, data models and Salesforce best practices, and signing off on technical approaches.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance to delivery teams: reviewing Apex, LWC and configuration, debugging complex defects, performing performance and scalability analysis, and supporting unit and integration testing.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners and programme leadership on solution options, trade-offs, effort estimation and presales/solutioning input for new and expanding engagements.

**What You'll Bring — Required**

* 15+ years of total IT experience, with 15+ years of relevant experience on the Salesforce platform in architecture and solution delivery roles.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in the Agentforce Revenue Management (ARM) / Revenue Cloud domain, including product catalogue, pricing, quoting, ordering and billing design.
* Strong background in legacy Salesforce CPQ and Billing, with the ability to assess, migrate and re-architect existing implementations onto Revenue Cloud / ARM.
* Proven end-to-end Quote-to-Cash architecture experience, including order orchestration, subscription and usage-based billing, amendments, renewals and revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15).
* Solution architecture depth across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including data modelling, sharing and security, governor limits and large-volume design considerations.
* Hands-on technical capability to review and guide builds in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow and declarative configuration, alongside integration design using REST/SOAP APIs, events and middleware.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise ERP and finance systems (for example SAP, NetSuite or equivalent) and the ability to define robust integration and reconciliation patterns.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a track record of leading design reviews, architecture governance and executive-level solution discussions.

**What You'll Bring — Preferred**

* Salesforce Architect-level certifications (Application Architect, System Architect, or CTA) and Revenue Cloud / CPQ Specialist credentials.
* Exposure to Agentforce and AI-agent-driven capabilities applied to revenue and service processes.
* MuleSoft or other middleware and iPaaS experience for enterprise integration landscapes.
* Industry domain depth in subscription-heavy sectors such as high-tech, software, telecommunications or manufacturing.
* Presales and estimation experience — solution shaping, effort sizing and proposal support for large transformation programmes.

**Eligibility / Qualification**

* 15+ years of total IT experience with 15+ years relevant Salesforce platform experience, including a minimum of 3 years in Agentforce Revenue Management / Revenue Cloud. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Tech. / M.S. / MCA) is preferred. Salesforce certifications are strongly preferred; exceptional ARM and Quote-to-Cash architecture depth will be considered alongside certification status.

title: Sr. Principal Architect-Data
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Principal Architect-R4**
**Databricks AI Design & Architecture | Agentic AI Systems**
As a Principal Architect for Databricks AI & Agentic Systems, you will own the end-to-end technical strategy and architecture of Lilly's AI data platform. You will design the systems that enable autonomous, multi-agent AI workflows—spanning data ingestion, semantic modeling, model orchestration, and real-time decision intelligence—while setting the architectural standards the engineering organization builds against.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor and technical leadership role. You will be the definitive technical authority on Databricks architecture, agentic AI design patterns, and AI/ML platform engineering—directly influencing how Lilly uses AI to transform pharmaceutical R&D, commercial operations, and patient care.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Architecture & Agentic System Design**

* Architect multi-agent AI systems on Databricks, defining agent orchestration frameworks, tool-use patterns, memory/state management, and inter-agent communication protocols.
* Design agentic workflows that combine LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and structured data reasoning to support autonomous decision-making pipelines.
* Establish architecture patterns for agent-to-agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent, integrated within the Databricks ecosystem.
* Define how AI agents interact with Unity Catalog assets—tables, models, volumes, and functions—as tool surfaces for autonomous data retrieval and action execution.
* Architect real-time and near-real-time agentic pipelines leveraging Databricks Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and event-driven triggers.

**Databricks Platform Architecture**

* Own the Databricks Lakehouse architecture end-to-end: catalog/schema design, medallion architecture (raw → refined → curated → AI-ready), storage optimization, and multi-workspace governance.
* Define and enforce Unity Catalog standards for AI assets—model registries, feature tables, vector search indexes, and function-as-a-tool registrations—enabling governed AI consumption across the enterprise.
* Architect the semantic and metrics layer so business logic is expressed once, consistently consumed by BI tools, AI agents, and downstream APIs.
* Set Delta Lake standards: table properties, Z-ordering, partitioning strategies, liquid clustering, and cost-based optimization for petabyte-scale workloads.
* Design Databricks Model Serving architectures, including real-time inference endpoints, batch inference pipelines, and A/B model deployment patterns.

**AI/ML Platform & LLM Integration**

* Define the enterprise architecture for LLM integration on Databricks—covering prompt management, context assembly, vector stores (Databricks Vector Search), embedding pipelines, and LLM fine-tuning workflows.
* Architect MLflow-based model lifecycle management: experiment tracking, model versioning, champion/challenger patterns, and governance-compliant model promotion.
* Design feature engineering and feature serving architectures using Databricks Feature Store, ensuring AI agents have low-latency access to curated, consistent features.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging Databricks AI capabilities—Mosaic AI, AI/BI Genie, DBRX, and Databricks Apps—as first-class architectural components.
* Define patterns for responsible AI: model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, audit trails, and bias mitigation within regulated pharmaceutical contexts.

**Governance, Security & Data Quality**

* Define and enforce data governance, access control, lineage, and auditing across all Databricks workspaces using Unity Catalog and integration with enterprise identity providers.
* Architect data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, Databricks DQ rules, or equivalent) embedded into AI pipelines to ensure model inputs meet reliability standards.
* Define security architecture for AI workloads: network isolation, secret management, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, IP restriction, and compliance with GxP and GDPR requirements.
* Own data sharing architecture—Delta Sharing, external connectors, API gateway patterns—ensuring downstream AI consumers receive governed, versioned data surfaces.

**Technical Leadership & Standards**

* Own architectural decision records (ADRs), reference architectures, and platform blueprints that engineering teams build against independently.
* Lead architecture reviews, design critiques, and proof-of-concept evaluations for platform investments and AI product initiatives.
* Mentor senior data engineers and ML engineers, elevating architectural thinking, system design rigor, and AI engineering best practices across the organization.
* Influence and guide vendor partners (Databricks, cloud providers, ISVs) on solution direction, ensuring alignment with Lilly's technical and data governance strategy.
* Represent Tech@Lilly in external architecture forums, Databricks advisory councils, and industry working groups.

**How You Will Succeed**

* A production-grade agentic AI platform on Databricks that powers autonomous workflows across commercial, R&D, and patient services domains.
* Architecture standards clear and comprehensive enough that distributed engineering teams execute with confidence within well-defined boundaries.
* Measurable platform outcomes: query performance benchmarks met, AI agent latency SLOs achieved, data quality scores at or above targets.
* Governance posture that passes internal audit and supports regulatory submissions in validated GxP environments.
* Sustained adoption of AI best practices—evidenced by engineers citing and following the architectural standards you define.
* Recognized as the go-to technical authority by both engineering and senior business stakeholders on Databricks and AI architecture decisions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform architecture, or AI/ML engineering.
* 4+ years of hands-on, production-grade Databricks experience: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Model Serving, Workflows, Databricks SQL, cluster lifecycle management, and workspace administration.
* 5+ years designing and delivering AI/ML systems at scale—covering model training, feature engineering, model serving, and monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience architecting agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and autonomous workflow design.
* Expert-level SQL and PySpark; strong Python for AI/ML pipeline development.
* Deep knowledge of data modeling, medallion architecture, Delta Lake internals, and data lakehouse design patterns.
* Proven track record of translating complex business requirements into scalable, governed, production-ready architectures.
* Experience leading architecture at the principal or distinguished level—setting standards, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical direction organization-wide.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Professional) and/or Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional.
* Experience with agentic orchestration frameworks:
* Hands-on experience with Mosaic AI, Databricks Apps, AI/BI Genie, and DBRX or similar open-weight LLMs.
* Domain expertise in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or regulated industries (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA)—including Customer Master, Product Master, HCP/HCO data, and commercial alignment data.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps practices: CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Databricks Asset Bundles) and GitOps for platform configuration.
* Experience with vector databases (Databricks Vector Search, Pinecone, Weaviate) and embedding model management.
* Understanding of responsible AI principles, model risk management, and AI governance frameworks in enterprise settings.

* Strong grounding in data modeling (dimensional, data vault, medallion/lakehouse) and data governance (catalogs, lineage, access control)

Accellor is an enterprise AI and digital engineering firm serving large customers across the US, Middle East, and India. title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Role Purpose**

As a Solution Architect, you will lead the architecture and solution design of large-scale technology initiatives spanning multiple systems across the OTT platform ecosystem.

You will be responsible for translating business and product requirements into scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable technical solutions that align with the organisation's strategic objectives.

Our culture is highly delivery-focused, and the role extends well beyond producing architecture diagrams and design documentation.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Programme Management, Operations and external partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on architectural guidance, resolving technical challenges, managing design trade-offs and ensuring successful implementation of solutions through to production release.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Solution Architecture:**
   Lead the architecture and solution design of strategic initiatives across the OTT platform ecosystem, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.
2. **Architectural Evolution:**
   Drive architectural evolution by assessing existing systems, identifying improvement opportunities and challenging established assumptions and technical constraints, including the pragmatic application of AI-enabled tools and capabilities where they deliver measurable value.
3. **End-to-End Delivery:**
   Own solution delivery from concept through implementation, providing technical leadership, resolving complex challenges and ensuring successful outcomes.
4. **Scalable Solution Design:**
   Design scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements and producing key architectural artefacts, including requirements for responsible AI use, data privacy, security, observability and governance where AI capabilities are involved.
5. **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
   Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery and Business stakeholders to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles, standards and best practices.
6. **Architecture Reviews:**
   Conduct architecture reviews, identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies and gaps, and drive continuous quality improvement.
7. **Engineering Guidance:**
   Support engineering teams throughout delivery with architectural guidance, governance and decision-making for complex technical issues. Promote effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering and delivery practices.
8. **Technology Innovation:**
   Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, OTT best practices and relevant AI capabilities to enhance platform capabilities, engineering efficiency and long-term architectural sustainability.

**Skills and Experience**

**You'll Be Set Up for Success If You Have**

* 6+ years' experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, designing and delivering large-scale technology solutions in complex environments.
* Deep understanding of OTT platform architectures and domains, including subscriptions, monetisation, identity and access management (IAM), content and metadata management, and related platform services.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems using

  principles.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and services, preferably
  **AWS**
  .

* Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve architecture, analysis, documentation, engineering productivity and problem-solving, while validating outputs and retaining appropriate technical judgement.
* Ability to assess AI use cases, dependencies, risks and non-functional requirements.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience in technologies such as
  **Node.js, Java, Python or Go**
  , and strong knowledge of database technologies.
* Proven ability to solve complex business and technology challenges, navigate ambiguity and drive effective technical outcomes.
* Experience analysing and optimising business processes, operating models and technology landscapes.
* Strong documentation skills and experience applying industry-standard architecture and design methodologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Experience designing event-driven integrations, data pipelines and asynchronous workflows using messaging and streaming technologies.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including Scrum, backlog refinement and technical planning.

title: SAP BTP Technical Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

ARA's Client is looking for a
**highly experienced SAP BTP professional with strong expertise in SAP BTP Application Development or SAP BTP Integration Suite**
. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, and delivering scalable, secure, cloud-native applications and enterprise integration solutions across SAP and non-SAP landscapes.

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in SAP BTP development, CAP (Node.js), SAP Fiori/UI5, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, and enterprise integration patterns. The candidate should also have experience leveraging Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities to transform SAP business processes and build intelligent, automation-ready enterprise solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SAP BTP Application Development & Architecture**

* Lead end-to-end SAP BTP application architecture and development across pro-code and low-code/no-code environments.
* Design, develop, and deploy SAP Fiori/UI5 applications integrated through OData services and CAP models.
* Develop cloud-native applications using SAP BTP CAP (Node.js), Java, and SAP Build Apps.
* Design and implement CDS-based domain models, service definitions, projections, annotations, and event handlers.
* Manage SAP HANA Cloud persistence models, HDI containers, CDS schema deployments, and database optimization.
* Implement SAP BTP Side-by-Side extensions and scalable, multi-tenant application architectures.
* Manage application deployment using Cloud Foundry, Kyma runtime, and MTA packaging.

**2. SAP BTP Integration Suite & Enterprise Integration**

* Design, develop, and manage end-to-end integration scenarios across SAP and non-SAP systems in cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.
* Develop and maintain integration flows (iFlows) using SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI).
* Implement message mappings, routing, splitting, gathering, enrichment, and transformation patterns.
* Work with enterprise data formats such as JSON, XML, and CSV.
* Develop advanced integration logic using Groovy scripting.
* Implement message persistence, data stores, retries, idempotency, and error-handling mechanisms.
* Design and expose secure APIs using API Management, including authentication, authorization, throttling, and versioning.
* Enable event-driven integrations using SAP Event Mesh and enterprise messaging capabilities.
* Integrate SAP and third-party applications through APIs, connectors, and standardized integration patterns.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration flows and API performance.

**3. SAP BTP Security & Platform Management**

* Manage SAP BTP account setup, subaccounts, service provisioning, destinations, and connectivity.
* Implement authentication and authorization using XSUAA, OAuth2, JWT tokens, scopes, role collections, and principal propagation.
* Design secure application architectures across SAP BTP and on-premise landscapes.
* Manage SAP BTP App Router, multi-tenant routing, identity provisioning, and application logging.
* Ensure compliance with cloud-native development, clean-code principles, and enterprise security standards.

**4. AI, Generative AI & Agentic AI Enablement**

* Transform SAP business processes through AI-driven workflows and Agentic AI innovations.
* Integrate SAP AI services and Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications and integration solutions.
* Develop intelligent integration capabilities such as automated iFlow generation, mapping recommendations, and AI-assisted script optimization.
* Implement retrieval-grounded AI assistance using interface catalogs, mapping specifications, standards, and operational runbooks.
* Develop AI-driven anomaly detection, predictive operations, and conversational troubleshooting capabilities.
* Establish AI evaluation frameworks, testing mechanisms, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approval workflows.
* Leverage AI tools and services such as SAP Build Code and Joule Studio.

**5. DevOps, Testing & Performance Optimization**

* Drive CI/CD pipeline automation using MTA packaging, Cloud Foundry CLI, and DevOps practices.
* Perform application debugging, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
* Establish automated testing strategies for applications, APIs, integration flows, and message transformations.
* Implement monitoring dashboards, alerts, structured logging, and end-to-end traceability.
* Ensure application scalability, reliability, maintainability, and performance.

**6. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead technical architecture and delivery activities across SAP BTP development and integration projects.
* Collaborate with business, product, engineering, data, and customer teams.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to development teams.
* Drive technical decisions, solution design, and enterprise architecture best practices.
* Communicate solutions effectively and conduct client presentations and technical demonstrations.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

**SAP BTP Application Development**

* SAP BTP Application Development and Architecture.
* SAP CAP (Node.js) and Java.
* SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 and OData services (OData V4).
* SAP HANA Cloud and HDI containers.
* ABAP CDS Views, RAP, and BOPF frameworks.
* SAP Build Apps / LCNC development.
* Cloud Foundry, Kyma runtime, and MTA deployments.
* XSUAA, OAuth2, JWT, security roles, and authorizations.
* SAP BTP subaccounts, destinations, connectivity, and service provisioning.

OR

**SAP BTP Integration Suite**

* SAP BTP Integration Suite and SAP Cloud Integration (CPI).
* Integration flows (iFlows) and enterprise integration patterns.
* Message mapping and data transformation (JSON, XML, CSV).
* Groovy scripting and advanced integration flow customization.
* API Management, API security, and lifecycle management.
* SAP Event Mesh and event-driven architecture.
* Integration monitoring, troubleshooting, and error handling.
* Hybrid integration across SAP and non-SAP systems.

**AI & Emerging Technologies**

* Generative AI and Agentic AI integration.
* AI-driven workflow automation and intelligent enterprise applications.
* Retrieval-grounded AI solutions and evaluation frameworks.
* AI-enabled integration and application development.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* SAP BTP Generative AI services and AI/ML integration.
* SAP Build Code and Joule Studio.
* SAP Workflow Management, Business Rules, and Process Automation.
* SAP S/4HANA integration.
* Enterprise messaging and microservices architecture.
* Migration and modernization of legacy integration platforms.
* Integration governance and enterprise-wide architecture standardization.
* SAP Signavio and Business Process Management (BPM).
* SAP Business AI certification.

**Experience & Education**

* **Minimum Experience:**
  12+ years of overall experience.
* **Preferred Experience:**
  12+ years, particularly in SAP BTP Application Architecture and Development.
* **Relevant Experience:**
  Strong hands-on experience in SAP BTP Application Development and SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* **Education:**
  Minimum 15 years of full-time education.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics & Communication, or equivalent.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Strong technical architecture and solution-design capabilities.
* Hands-on experience across both SAP BTP Application Development and Integration Suite.
* Ability to lead large-scale SAP transformation and implementation programs.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Passion for innovation, automation, Generative AI, and emerging SAP technologies.

**Location PAN India**

title: Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead)
description:
As a Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead), you will lead an engineering pod (stream) building features for an enterprise-grade SaaS platform in the data privacy, data governance and AI governance space. You will own the technical design of your stream within the client’s architecture governance, break the backlog into deliverable work, and make sure every sprint ships production-ready, well-tested code. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines solution design, code and design reviews, and day-to-day guidance of a team of backend, data/AI, frontend and quality engineers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the technical design and solution architecture for your stream, aligned with the client’s architecture governance, standards and review processes.
* Break down epics and features into well-defined user stories and technical tasks, and provide reliable effort estimates.
* Lead sprint planning and execution for the pod, making sure committed scope is delivered on time and meets the definition of done.
* Conduct code and design reviews across backend (Java/Spring Boot, Python), frontend (Angular) and integration components, enforcing quality, security and performance standards.
* Design scalable microservices, REST APIs and integration patterns, including connectors to SaaS, cloud, data and AI platforms.
* Drive release readiness: test coverage, CI/CD quality gates, documentation and deployment sign-off.
* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and blockers, and escalate early to the Engineering Manager.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, UX designers and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor engineers, set coding standards, and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2–3 years as a Tech Lead or Solution Architect.
* Proven track record of leading agile teams that deliver enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
* Strong hands-on background in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python, with the ability to review full-stack code.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot and microservices architecture, with working knowledge of Python.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations and data models for distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of Angular and TypeScript, enough to review frontend designs and code.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and release management.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum, backlog refinement and estimation, using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Good understanding of secure coding, OAuth2/SSO and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Salesforce Technical Architect- Automotive Cloud
description:
**Description**
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
The Technical Architect — Automotive Cloud successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for automotive clients operating across OEMs, authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers. Technologies include Salesforce Automotive Cloud, Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management, Salesforce APIs, Apex/LWC, Agentforce, and DMS/telematics integrations.
  
  
You are both a big-picture automotive enterprise thinker and a deep, hands-on problem solver. You take pride in designing systems that withstand high transaction volumes across distributed dealer networks, support complex OEM-to-dealer data hierarchies, and will not fail at critical inflection points such as vehicle launch campaigns, service recall operations, or connected vehicle data ingestion spikes. The solutions you design are built for long-term scalability, growing seamlessly alongside the customer's dealer network footprint and connected vehicle ecosystem.
  
  
You have a strong mix of technical depth and enterprise consulting acumen, knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality, accelerate architectural design cycles, and rapidly prototype automotive-specific configurations. As Salesforce leads the agentic era, you play a front-line role in driving AI-First delivery—designing autonomous agents that power intelligent dealer assist, predictive service scheduling, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
**Stakeholder Collaboration:**
Collaborate with automotive client stakeholders—CTO, VP Digital, Head of Dealer Operations—to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations across enterprise OEM and dealer network engagements.
  
  
**Solution Architecture:**
Translate complex automotive business requirements into well-architected Salesforce solutions, identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI using Agentforce for intelligent dealer assist, predictive service agents, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**Enterprise AI Architecture:**
Design and integrate scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within Automotive Cloud environments—optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits to support real-time telematics ingestion and high-volume dealer operations.
  
  
**Technical Design Leadership:**
Lead design sessions; author TDDs/ADDs aligned to client commercial objectives; leverage AI tools to review architectural assumptions and simulate edge cases such as peak vehicle launch traffic, concurrent DMS sync operations, and large-scale recall campaign orchestration.
  
  
**AI-First Governance & Code Standards:**
Provide project oversight championing AI-First delivery using AI tools and agentic evaluation frameworks. Lead code reviews and enforce standards using AI coding assistants to identify governor limit risks and optimize integration performance.
  
  
**Technical Delivery Management:**
Manage delivery of custom development, DMS integrations, telematics ingestion pipelines, and vehicle master data migrations—using AI tools to accelerate Apex class generation, mock data creation, and REST integration scaffolding
  
  
**Performance Evaluation & ROI:**
Collaborate with automotive customers to develop evaluation frameworks measuring AI performance, dealer satisfaction scores, service retention rates, and business value for specific automotive use cases.
  
  
**Pre-Sales & Prototyping:**
Participate in automotive discovery workshops, technical deep-dives, and rapid POC development—using AI tools to prototype Vehicle Console configurations, dealer portal experiences, and Agentforce automotive agents for prospective clients.
  
  
**Product Team Liaison:**
Liaise with Salesforce Automotive Cloud product teams to channel client implementation feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure implementations align with platform evolution.
  
  
**You're Our Person If...**
**Experience & Platform Depth**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience (extracurricular leadership, military, volunteer, work experience)
* 9–14 years CRM/enterprise software; 6+ years Salesforce platform; 3+ years Automotive Cloud
* Expert Automotive Cloud data model: Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management modules
* Expert-level Salesforce platform suite: Sales, Service, Experience, Automotive Cloud, Agentforce architecture
* Scalable solution design for high-volume automotive scenarios with AI-assisted load modeling
* LDV limitations, design patterns, and data distribution risk analysis
* Multi-tier dealer hierarchy sharing: OWD, sharing rules, and permission sets for OEM/dealer data isolation
* Platform security capabilities: TLS, SSL, and data encryption for automotive commercial data

**Integration, AI & DevOps**

* Expert DMS integration: CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion; telematics ingestion platforms; OEM proprietary back-end systems
* Middleware platforms: MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services; ETL/ELT frameworks
* Auth patterns: SAML, SSO, OAuth 2.0 — secure configuration for OEM and dealership enterprise identity providers
* DevOps: environment management, Git, Copado/Gearset, multi-sandbox deployment pipelines and release management
* Practical fluency: accelerate delivery using AI tools, document architecture, maintain code quality
* Agentforce design: dealer assist agents, connected vehicle chatbots, predictive service recommendations, intelligent recall orchestration
* Collaboration with customers to develop AI performance and business value evaluation frameworks

**Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning**
**Required Certification**
Salesforce Administrator
  
  
Platform App Builder
  
  
Platform Developer I
  
  
Agentforce Specialist
  
  
Integration Architect
  
  
Sharing & Visibility Designer
  
  
**Preferred Certification**
System / Application Architect
  
  
CRM Analytics Consultant
  
  
**Leadership Qualities & Core Values**
To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Technical Architect must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust.

**Performance Evaluation & ROI:**

**Pre-Sales & Prototyping:**
Participate in automotive discovery workshops, technical deep-dives, and rapid POC development—using AI tools to prototype Vehicle Console configurations, dealer portal experiences, and Agentforce automotive agents for prospective clients.

The individual will drive disciplined execution against quarterly objectives while bringing applied innovation to every solution, ensuring Micron continues to lead in how AI is used across engineering.

Architecture and Execution

* Rapidly prototype and evaluate new approaches, scaling those that prove value into production.
* Bring emerging AI technologies and industry practices into ITP where they can measurably improve engineering outcomes.

Technical Leadership and Influence

* Number of AI systems rolled out into production across ITP.

The
**Principal Architect, Network Observability & AI**
will join the Data Insights and Visualization team to contribute to the intersection of business intelligence (BI), telemetry visualization, and modern artificial intelligence. This role will contribute to the development of generative, conversational, and agentic AI capabilities into our existing telemetry platforms and new initiatives. By exploiting the advanced features of our commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) tools alongside custom, home-grown solutions, you will transform raw network data into immediate, actionable insights for our business and operational value teams.

* Architect unified dashboard platforms that convert complex telemetry into simplified, AI-driven visual scores for leadership and operational teams.
* Design, build and deliver end-to-end telemetry analytics and interactive dashboards that combine network flow, metrics, logs, traces, and business context to reduce time-to-insight and time-to-resolution.

* Build reusable visualization components, templates, and libraries to support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, SD‑WAN, and core application observability.

* Provide technical mentoring and project leadership to local peers.

* Collaborative team player able to coordinate cross-functional work and deliver on time.

* 6+ years building observability and data normalization across complex telemetry types (logs, metrics, traces, flows) and proactive alerting/AIOps integration.
* 8+ years developing complex multi-source data pipelines using data engineering tools such as Dataiku, Databricks.
* Proven experience building actionable dashboards and role-based views for executives, product owners, and engineers.
* Experience embedding visualizations in web applications and building reusable visualization components.
* Proficiency with one or more general-purpose programming languages and web frameworks JavaScript (React/Vue), Python (Django/Flask), Java, or similar.
* 4-year college degree majoring in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business Intelligence, or similar.

****Secondary Skills (nice To Have)****

* Engineer or specialist level developer certifications (AWS, Python, SQL) or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Familiarity integrating agents with ITSM/incident platforms (ServiceNow or similar) and network automation tools (Ansible, or similar).

Collins Aerospace is seeking a dynamic, customer-focused technical leader to modernize and integrate its enterprise engineering tools ecosystem, reduce complexity, and enable connected digital engineering solutions that drive engineering excellence.
  
  
In this highly impactful role, you will operate at the intersection of Systems Engineering, Software Development, and Digital Engineering, providing technical leadership in architecting, integrating, and optimizing enterprise engineering applications and platforms.

* Lead the technical implementation, integration, and optimization of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) toolchains and Engineering Lifecycle Management applications.

* Emerging digital engineering technologies, including Digital Twins, Model-Based Enterprises, Integrated Digital Environments, and intelligent engineering automation.
* Modern approaches to software integration, engineering data interoperability, platform engineering, and DevSecOps.
* Opportunities to influence enterprise engineering platforms and contribute to Collins Aerospace's broader digital transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM discipline; alternatively, an Advanced Degree with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.

title: Senior Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (DryvIQ)
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India | Remote
  
  
**Hours: US Eastern Time Hours: 9am-5pm ET (7:30pm IST - 3:30am IST)**
**Department:**
Customer Experience / Professional Services
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
**Be the engineer customers trust to turn their hardest AI and data challenges into production solutions.**
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer at DryvIQ (part of Nasuni), you’ll lead the customer conversations and write the C#/.NET code that makes it real, from discovery workshop to Kubernetes deployment. You’ll own the outcome end to end, with the credibility to guide customers toward the right answer, not just the easy yes.
  
  
Enterprises cannot make confident use of AI when essential content is scattered across repositories, poorly classified, or difficult to govern. DryvIQ, part of Nasuni, helps organizations discover, classify, govern, and manage enterprise information across more than 40 cloud and on-premises repositories and 550+ file formats.
  
  
We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who combines strong C#/.NET engineering with practical customer consulting. You will translate complex business challenges into deployed, supportable solutions that improve content intelligence, information governance, and AI readiness.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering and customer-delivery role, not a pre-sales-only or purely advisory position.
  
  
Your Scope and Impact
  
  
Own the technical delivery of assigned complex enterprise customer engagements, from requirements discovery through production validation and handoff. Make customer-specific design decisions within supported platform capabilities and established engineering standards.
  
  
Partner with customer stakeholders and Nasuni's Professional Services, Project Management, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Lead customer discovery workshops; turn operational needs, security constraints, and business objectives into solution designs and acceptance criteria.
* Configure and deploy DryvIQ capabilities for content discovery, classification, lifecycle management, governance, migration, and policy-driven automation where relevant to the engagement.
* Build, test, and troubleshoot C#/.NET integrations, Kubernetes (K8s), REST API connections, scripts, and supported custom workflows.
* Decide when standard configuration meets the need and when approved customization or product escalation is appropriate.
* Provide technical effort estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation risks to support services scoping and statements of work.
* Validate classification results using representative samples, false-positive and false-negative analysis, precision/recall, and business-owner feedback.
* Diagnose operational issues across connectors, authentication, permissions, long-running jobs, and deployment environments; verify production readiness.
* Follow code review, security, QA, release, documentation, and customer handoff practices; turn recurring solutions into reusable patterns.
* Use approved AI-assisted tools for development, testing, and analysis while validating outputs for correctness, security, and maintainability.

Expected Outcomes and Impact
  
  
Deliver customer-approved solutions that meet documented acceptance criteria, operate reliably, protect sensitive content, and can be supported after handoff. Help shorten time to customer value and improve delivery repeatability.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Hands-on professional C#/.NET engineering, (.NET 8 or above), REST API development or integration, and production troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated ownership of enterprise software implementation or customization, including requirements, development, testing, and deployment.
* Strong Linux and Docker experience.
* Ability to explain technical tradeoffs to customer IT and business stakeholders, manage risks, and coordinate delivery across teams.
* Strong technical documentation, problem-solving, secure engineering judgment, and customer communication.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Kubernetes (K8s)
* PowerShell or Python automation.
* Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Purview, or enterprise content repositories.
* Content classification, information governance, enterprise content management, or migration.
* Cloud or hybrid deployments and large-scale file processing.
* AI-assisted coding, testing, or debugging with appropriate output validation.

**Ideal Candidate Differentiators**

* Experience balancing configuration and custom engineering across multiple customer engagements.
* Measurable improvements to classification quality, solution reliability, or customer adoption.
* Reusable integration assets, deployment patterns, or responsible AI-enabled workflows.

Experience Guidelines
  
  
**Part engineer, part trusted customer advisor, fully accountable for customer outcomes.**
Join Nasuni’s Hyderabad Innovation Center as a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, where you’ll take enterprise customers’ messy content and AI-readiness problems, design the solution, build it in .NET, deploy it on Kubernetes, and see it through to production. If you’re equally comfortable in a code editor and in front of a customer, this is your role.
  
  
Leading the customer discovery to deployment and implementation of DryvIQ Solutions. Typically 5–9 years of relevant software engineering or technical consulting experience or solution architecting, including meaningful hands-on customer-facing implementation work. Equivalent evidence of ownership and results is welcome; prior DryvIQ experience is not required.
  
  
Location and Working Model
  
  
Remote, preferred local to Hyderabad. Collaboration with global teams and US customer working sessions is required. Periodic customer-site travel to the United State is expected.
  
  
**About Nasuni**
Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits.
  
  
As a Vista Equity Partners-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni helps enterprises turn complex file environments into secure, governed, and AI-ready information. DryvIQ adds content intelligence and automated governance across connected cloud and on-premises repositories.
  
  
Join our Hyderabad India Innovation Center and help solve challenging customer problems at the intersection of software engineering, data governance, and AI readiness.
  
  
Collaborate with customer-facing, product, and engineering colleagues across regions, learn from complex enterprise deployments, and contribute solutions that can improve delivery for future customers. Vista Equity Partners' global software ecosystem provides opportunities for cross-company learning, leadership development, and AI innovation.
  
  
Your engineering work will connect directly to measurable customer outcomes. #BI-Remote
  
  
**Benefits**
As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career, including competitive compensation programs, flexible time off and leave policies, comprehensive health and wellness coverage, hybrid and flexible work arrangements, employee referral and recognition programs, professional development and learning support, an inclusive and collaborative team culture, modern office spaces with team events and perks, and retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations.
  
  
To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees, or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
  
  
Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment.
  
  
*This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, “Nasuni”) from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.*

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Development Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.
* Designing and maintaining optimized data layers using the GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL engine) to support high-throughput analytics and data consumers.
* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event-driven microservices and high-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll need to have..**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* Six to eight years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.
* Experience with DevOps CI/CD processes to automate build and deployments.
* Experience mentoring and coaching diverse teams.
* Experience in identifying and analyzing and finding RCA for Errors and working with cross functional teams like SRE and backend team
* Experience with analytical tools and DBs like Postgres, Looker , ELK, ETL tools
* Recognizing, tracking, and communicating issues, accomplishments, milestones to the team and business partners.

****Job Description****
**R3- Senior Specialist, Software Engineering**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centres are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
****Role Overview****
We are seeking a Senior Specialist in SAP General Ledger and Operating Expense Management Software Engineer (Product Costing) to join our ERP Finance Delivery team within the SAP Platform group under the Enterprise Information Technology(EIT) Organization. As the Senior Specialist(R3), you will be responsible for product delivery, taking ownership of the support, and optimization of our Global SAP platforms. Operating with a high degree of autonomy and strategic foresight, you will go beyond daily coordination to proactively drive operational and delivery excellence. You will partner and collaborate closely with cross-functional product line teams, application operations, and platform engineers to design and deliver robust, scalable, and secure enterprise capabilities. Leveraging your advanced problem-solving skills, you will navigate complex technical challenges, mitigate operational risks, and provide technical mentorship and coaching to team members, ensuring our digital transformation initiatives are successfully executed and aligned with broader organizational objectives.
  
  
****What Will You Do In This Role****

* Be a team member in the SAP Platform in FI/CO area, and lead the SAP platform in the Product Costing area.
* Possess a detailed understanding of SAP FI/CO, including General Ledger (FI-GL/FA) and Operating Expense Management (CO-CCA, PCA, IO, PA).
* Collaborate closely with Finance Value Team to convert user stories to functional specification for product development.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and technical teams to prioritize and work independently on the delivery of SAP enhancements and new functionalities.
* Be able to analyse/design complex system solution, setup system configuration and perform testing as part of product team delivery in a ECC 6.0 and S4 Global instance.
* Ability to visualize end-to-end integrated business processes and impacts across key areas such as Financial Business Management, Order to Cash, Source to Settle, Supply Chain Management, Tax, and Financial Supply Chain.
* Stay up to date with the latest developments in SAP functionality and identify opportunities for process improvements and automation.
* As part of the regional onsite team, to provide expert level support to production support/operations team to ensure minimum disruption to our business continuity (e.g Financial closing, Costing Run).
* Responsible for SAP configuration changes and developments align with business requirements, industry standards, and regulatory compliance.
* Adhere to change control processes and methodologies to minimize system disruptions and ensure system stability.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, including finance, supply chain, and other functional areas, to understand their needs and align SAP solutions accordingly.
* Work closely with Product tech/value team lead to prioritize, providing insights and recommendations on leveraging SAP capabilities to drive business growth and operational excellence.
* Work in a matrix environment and reporting to Product tech leads in a global setting. Participate in review of own work and leads review of colleague’s work as appropriate.

****Primary Skills (must-have)****

* Master’s or bachelor’s Degree is required. Concentration in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field is preferred.
* 7+ years of SAP solution delivery experience in the area of FI-GL, CO-CCA/PCA/IO/PA/PC. - required.
* Detailed understanding of SAP FI/CO and expert-level understanding of SAP Controlling Product Costing (CO-PC, Material Ledger, Actual Costing), particularly in large-scale pharmaceutical manufacturing environments – required.
* Product Cost Planning, Pharma manufacturing integrate CO-PC with PP/PP-PI, MM and FI across large-scale sites, Period-end closing.
* Cross-functional business process experience
* Knowledge of interface development E.g. Idoc, BAPI, Middleware (BTP)
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact directly with business process owners and business stakeholders. – required.
* Practical experience with single ECC/S4 instance in a large scale corporation with global presence. – preferred
* Knowledge of localization within Asia/Europe/US region – preferred
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA will be an advantage.
* Life Sciences Industry experience - preferred
* Proficiency with product life cycle tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Jira Xray. – preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills; the ability to work well with people from different disciplines/timezone with varying degrees of technical experience; competence in clear concise and tactful communication with senior management, clients, peers and team members - preferred
* Agile software development and DevOps settings - preferred

****Primary Skills (must-have)****
SAP FI(GL, FA), SAP CO(CCA,PCA, IO, PS, CO-PA, CO-PC), ECC 6.0, S/4
  
  
****Secondary Skills (nice To Have)****
ServiceNow, Jira, Jira Xray, BTP middleware, SAP Joule
  
  
****Who We Are****
We are known as Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
****What We Look For****
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. description:
**Description**
Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.

Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
  
  

* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly.

Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  
  

* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.

Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
  
  
Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
  
  

* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.

Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
  
  
Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Principal Solution Architect , CS3
description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
**Mission Statement Of Customer Success, Solutions And Services (CS3)**
Empower our clients to achieve exceptional outcomes by proactively driving their success with our products and services, providing expert advice and timely service, and delivering innovative solutions tailored to their unique needs.
  
  
The CS3 team is dedicated to building lasting partnerships that create value, foster trust, and ensure our clients maximize the full potential of our products and services to achieving the outcomes they desire. By executing against this mission, we intend to exceed our clients’ expectations and develop a community of advocates
  
  
**Job Description**
Arcesium seeks a talented and motivated Technical Client Solutions Architect to join our CS3 team. This person will draw on their technical expertise to execute cross-cutting solutions that helps integrate and scale the Arcesium technology platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for engaging with customers to provide strategic and tactical guidance to them to increase the value they acquire from Arcesium suite of products.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Understand the capabilities of the Arcesium technology platform and design and implement solutions that will help integrate the platform and unlock scale. Ability to showcase product demo + work out solutions for business use cases using best product-fit
* Develop comprehensive solution architectures that meet functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring alignment with industry standards and best practices
* Work with internal cross-functional teams (product, sales, account management, support, operations, etc.) to ensure customer’s solutions/issues are addressed. Build and maintain relationships, and create trust with internal stakeholders from the Engineering, Services (Operations) and Product organization.
* Create prototypes and proof-of-concept implementations for complex solutions to validate design approaches
* Must be comfortable discussing the technical solution strategies and enterprise roadmap with people at all levels of our organization and CxO to project-level teams in our clients
* Strong ability to build the value proposition and solution documents, and in some cases, the business case for a corporate client
* Evaluate how customers manage their Arcesium product & identify efficiency and effectiveness gains (process & tools)
* Work closely with Customer Success Manager to derive data driven insights/intelligence to run focused and result-oriented customer engagement programs.
* Manage risks pre-emptively, while using metrics to drive projects forward and escalate risks to stakeholders.
* Recommending process improvements to support growth and other internal goals.

**What You'll Need**

* A formal degree in Computer Science or a related discipline with 7-12 years of experience in building technology solutions.
* Good understanding of API, distributed systems architecture and/or Data Products (Spark, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Snowflake), ETL pipelining and DevOps philosophy.
* Programming experience in Python or any similar programming language is a must
* Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to learn quickly, and the openness to try different tools, technologies & concepts
* Good understanding of working with distributed teams.
* The ability to be self-motivated and to think independently while being a team player
* Proficiency in using Project Management and Communication tools

**Recruiting Security**
Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).
  
  
*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention.
