We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Staff Software Engineer – AI Native Development**
AI Security Incubation & Innovation
  
  
Security and Risk Engineering
  
  
**About The Team**
The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.
  
  
This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Staff Software Engineer – AI Native Development, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for the architecture, design, delivery, and evolution of major AI-powered software systems and subsystems.
  
  
You will combine deep full-stack software engineering expertise with strong AI/ML-native development skills to solve complex, ambiguous problems and build production-grade systems at scale. You will own significant technical areas end-to-end—from user experiences and APIs to distributed services, data and retrieval systems, AI/ML capabilities, and cloud infrastructure.
  
  
Beyond your individual contributions, you will provide technical direction across a broader engineering area, make critical architecture and design decisions, establish engineering standards, and influence multiple engineers and teams. You will help shape how we build AI-native products and establish the technical foundation for the next generation of intelligent enterprise applications.
  
  
This is a role for an engineer who can operate effectively at both architectural altitude and implementation depth—someone who can define the direction, make the difficult technical decisions, and still dive into the code when needed.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* A major product or technical subsystem end-to-end, including its architecture, design, implementation, scalability, reliability, security, and ongoing evolution.
* The technical vision and architecture for your area, including key design decisions and interfaces with other systems and teams.
* The quality and business/technical outcomes of your subsystem, with measurable targets for reliability, performance, AI quality, latency, cost, and customer impact.
* The architecture and engineering practices required to build AI-native applications at production scale.
* Technical direction for engineers working within your area, providing guidance through architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on technical leadership.
* The evolution of AI/ML capabilities such as agentic workflows, retrieval, model integration, evaluation, and intelligent automation within your product area.
* The technical strategy for balancing AI capability, engineering complexity, reliability, security, latency, and cost.

**What You'll Do**
**Technical & Architectural Leadership**

* Take highly ambiguous and complex problems and turn them into clear technical strategies, architectures, and executable plans.
* Own the architecture of major systems or subsystems and drive them from concept through production at scale.
* Make sound technical decisions under uncertainty and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
* Define system boundaries, interfaces, APIs, data flows, and integration patterns across multiple services and teams.
* Drive architecture and design reviews and establish a high engineering bar for scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Identify architectural risks and technical debt and drive long-term improvements across your area.
* Influence technical direction beyond your immediate team through strong technical judgment and collaboration.

**Full-Stack Engineering**

* Remain hands-on in building complex software across the stack, from frontend experiences and APIs to backend services, data systems, AI services, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design scalable full-stack architectures using technologies such as React, TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, and modern cloud-native platforms.
* Build distributed services, event-driven systems, APIs, databases, caching, messaging, and scalable data pipelines.
* Ensure systems are observable, resilient, secure, and operationally excellent in production.
* Lead by example through high-quality implementation, testing, debugging, code reviews, and engineering practices.

**AI/ML-Native Development**

* Define and drive the adoption of AI-native architectures and engineering patterns across your technical area.
* Design and build production-grade LLM and agentic systems, including:

+ Multi-agent orchestration
+ Tool and function calling
+ Planning and reasoning loops
+ Context and memory management
+ Retrieval and grounding
+ Failure recovery and resilience
+ Human-in-the-loop workflows

* Integrate frontier models from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent platforms, making informed decisions around model capability, cost, latency, and reliability.
* Design RAG and retrieval systems using embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, re-ranking, and enterprise data sources.
* Establish robust AI evaluation strategies and measurable quality metrics for AI-powered functionality.
* Drive AI observability covering model quality, latency, cost, failures, hallucination/error rates, and system behavior.
* Establish appropriate AI safety, security, governance, privacy, and guardrail mechanisms for production systems.
* Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine how and where they can create meaningful product or engineering value.

**Technical Leadership & Influence**

* Provide technical direction and mentorship to engineers across the workstream.
* Lead complex engineering initiatives through influence rather than organizational authority.
* Mentor senior and emerging engineers on architecture, system design, full-stack development, and production AI practices.
* Partner closely with product, design, platform, data, security, and other engineering organizations to translate customer problems into scalable technical solutions.
* Facilitate technical alignment across teams and resolve architectural disagreements through data, experimentation, and sound engineering judgment.
* Establish reusable patterns, frameworks, libraries, and engineering practices that improve productivity across teams.
* Help define the organization's approach to AI-native software development and AI-assisted engineering.

**AI-Assisted Development**

* Identify opportunities to use AI across the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review.

**What You Bring**

title: Manager - AI Delivery Product
description:
**About Firstsource**
F irstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes.
  
  
**Job Brief**
We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Lead AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-scale AI products. This role combines technical leadership with deep engineering expertise, requiring active involvement in product feature architecture, full-stack application development, AI/ML model integration, code reviews, release management, and engineering best practices within our AI Product Engineering team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Cloud Technologies, and modern full-stack development, with a proven ability to lead technical teams while remaining actively engaged in coding. They should be passionate about building scalable, production-ready AI products, mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and collaborating with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to transform product requirements into robust, high-performance AI-powered product features.
  
  
**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* 7 - 8+ years of hands-on software development experience with strong coding expertise.
* Strong programming experience in Python (Mandatory).
* Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, AI Agents, and Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with Vector Databases and Enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, or equivalent.
* Proven experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade applications.
* Strong expertise in Full Stack Development: Backend (Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django) and Frontend (React.js, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3).
* Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and Microservices.
* Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
* Hands-on experience building, training, fine-tuning, and deploying Machine Learning models.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and XGBoost.
* Experience deploying AI/ML solutions into production environments and implementing MLOps practices.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure Cloud Platforms (Mandatory).
* Experience with cloud-native development, containerization, and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, scalability, performance optimization, and security best practices.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable full-stack applications using Python and modern front-end frameworks.
* Build and deploy Machine Learning and AI-powered solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Actively contribute to coding, code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization activities.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications.
* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures following industry best practices.
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and MLOps processes.
* Deploy, monitor, and optimize applications and ML models on AWS and/or Azure.
* Ensure high standards of code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers.
* Drive continuous improvement in architecture, development processes, security, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Mentor and guide team members on technical design, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance products and platforms.
* Work in Agile teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and successful delivery of project milestones.
* Own and evolve specific modules/features within Firstsource's AI product suite, maintaining a technical backlog in partnership with Product Management.
* Conduct usability, performance, and scalability testing across product releases and drive iterative improvements based on internal and client feedback loops.
* Support release planning, versioning, and product documentation for engineering and support teams.

**Experience & Education**

* 8-12 years of overall experience.
* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an Engineering discipline.

title: Lead Engineer (Manager), Microsoft Power Platform
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.
  
  
This is a hands-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a hands-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop custom solutions using C#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches.
* Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well-designed solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

**What Success Looks Like**
Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.
  
  
They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.
  
  
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Software Development Engineer III, Associate Experience, Amazon Customer Service
description:

Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer III to join the Associate Experience team. You will define technical strategy and drive cross-functional alignment to evolve our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will set engineering best practices, raise the technical bar across the team, and mentor engineers at all levels. You should thrive on solving ambiguous, complex technical problems, designing scalable and highly available solutions, and feel strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.
  
  
We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.

Lead the design, architecture, and delivery of software services and tools that solve complex, ambiguous business and operational problems, with a focus on simplicity, scalability, and long-term maintainability
  
  
Own the technical roadmap for critical systems, driving optimization and evolution for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale
  
  
Make high-judgment technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with minimal guidance, setting precedents that influence team-wide standards
  
  
Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks across projects, driving resolution and escalating strategically when appropriate
  
  
Lead design reviews and drive technical alignment across engineering and cross-functional teams, influencing direction beyond immediate team boundaries
  
  
Define and enforce effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources, ensuring high-quality delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams
  
  
Define, track, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement at a portfolio level
  
  
Drive engineering process improvements and operational excellence, establishing best practices that raise the bar across the broader organization
  
  
Mentor and develop engineers at all levels through technical guidance, code reviews, architecture discussions, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards
  
  
Author and champion clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership, team knowledge sharing, and organizational learning

The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support.

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Python Architect/ Senior Python Engineer / Python Technical Lead
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad (Work from Office) OR Remote – Anywhere in India

**Experience:**
7+ Years (Minimum 5 Years in Production Python Development)

**Employment Type:**
Contract / Contract-to-Hire

**Company:**
YemPover Inc.

**Apply:**
hr@yempover.com

About the Role

YemPover is looking for a highly skilled, hands-on
**Senior Python Engineer / Python Technical Lead**
with deep expertise in Python architecture, reusable framework development, concurrency, performance optimization, and enterprise data processing.

This is a
**Python-first engineering role**
, not a traditional PySpark, Databricks, or AWS Glue developer position.

The ideal candidate must be capable of independently designing, coding, testing, and maintaining complex Python frameworks that process large datasets and integrate with Snowflake and dbt.

Key Responsibilities

* Architect and develop scalable, reusable, multi-module Python frameworks for enterprise data ingestion, validation, transformation, and loading.
* Design Python pipelines to efficiently process thousands of files from AWS S3 and load them into Snowflake.
* Implement robust concurrency using
  **asyncio, multiprocessing, and asynchronous I/O**
  , with appropriate resource management.
* Build extensible Python architectures using design patterns, interfaces, dependency injection, typing, and modular components.
* Develop reliable ingestion workflows incorporating
  **idempotency, retry mechanisms, schema-drift handling, error recovery, and audit logging**
  .
* Implement efficient Snowflake bulk-loading strategies using staging tables, COPY INTO, and MERGE.
* Optimize application performance through profiling, memory management, efficient data structures, and parallel processing.
* Establish engineering best practices through pytest, unit/integration testing, mocking, code reviews, CI/CD, and documentation.
* Work closely with data engineering teams to determine appropriate boundaries between Python processing and Snowflake SQL/dbt transformations.
* Take end-to-end ownership of Python architecture, implementation, testing, and production reliability.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**1. Advanced Python Engineering**

* 5+ years of hands-on production Python development.
* Strong understanding of Python internals, including generators, decorators, context managers, descriptors, typing, memory management, and the GIL.
* Experience developing complex, multi-module Python applications, reusable libraries, SDKs, or extensible frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Python 3.12+ and modern development practices.

**2. Concurrency & Performance**

* Production experience with asyncio and/or multiprocessing.
* Strong understanding of CPU-bound versus I/O-bound workloads.
* Experience with profiling, memory optimization, batching, and high-throughput processing.

**3. Snowflake & Data Engineering**

* Hands-on Python integration with AWS S3 and Snowflake.
* Understanding of Snowflake stages, COPY INTO, MERGE, and bulk-loading patterns.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of dbt-based transformations.
* Experience with Pandas, Polars, PyArrow, DuckDB, or equivalent data-processing libraries.
* Experience with schema validation using Pydantic or Pandera.

**4. Python Framework Design & Reliability**

* Experience designing extensible ingestion or data-processing frameworks.
* Strong understanding of idempotency, retry mechanisms, exception handling, and schema evolution.
* Ability to design reusable modules, adapters, validators, and processing interfaces.

**5. Testing & Engineering Practices**

* Strong experience with pytest, mocking, fixtures, unit testing, and integration testing.
* Git, CI/CD, Docker, dependency management, and Python packaging.
* Familiarity with modern tooling such as uv, ruff, mypy, and pyright.

Preferred / Added Advantage

* AWS S3, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, ECS, and event-driven architecture.
* Airflow, custom DAGs/operators, and dbt.
* Kafka/Kinesis and idempotent event consumers.
* Cython, Numba, Rust/PyO3, or advanced Python runtime optimization.
* MCP servers, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, or LLM API integrations.

What We Are Specifically Looking For

We are seeking a
**hands-on Python architect-level engineer**
, not someone whose experience is primarily limited to configuring cloud services or developing PySpark/Databricks pipelines.

Candidates must be able to:

* Explain and demonstrate Python architecture at the code and module level.
* Independently design a framework to validate and load thousands of S3 files into Snowflake.
* Implement concurrency, error handling, retries, idempotency, and schema validation.
* Clearly articulate when processing belongs in Python versus SQL/dbt.
* Demonstrate personal ownership of complex Python production systems.

**Strong Python coding and architectural reasoning are mandatory.**

Interview Process

Technical screening will include Python architecture design, concurrency and performance concepts, Snowflake ingestion patterns, and a hands-on Python coding exercise.

Apply Now

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at hr@yempover.com.

title: Specialist SAP Architect, Global Trade Services
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
  
  
**About The Role**
Role Description:
  
  
In this vital role, you will be responsible for leading, architecting, designing, and implementing SAP GTS solutions with a focus on Compliance and Customs processes and capabilities. As a Specialist SAP Architect within our global Digital, Technology, and Innovation (DTI) team, this role will help guide the transition from our worldwide ERP instance on Global Trade Platform (GTS), along with the successful migration of the S4 feeder systems. This position requires deep expertise in SAP GTS module with a good understanding of cross functional integration with SAP other modules. Are you an SAP analyst with deep technical experience in Compliance and Customs processes? Come join a team that is passionate about innovation and making life better with technology!
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Design and configure the GTS module to meet business requirements and implement processes around Compliance and Customs Management.
* Ensures solutions developed are aligned to enterprise architecture standards, guidelines and principles by leverage common technology platforms and services.
* Ensures seamless integration between GTS and connected with S4 SAP modules (FI, MM, OTC, TM, ATTP, and EWM) as well as third-party systems.
* Participate in GTS implementation projects as part of the GTO product team, including blueprinting, gap analysis, testing, go-live, and post-production support. Provide mentoring to team members.
* Creation and maintenance of critical documentation such as technical assessments, configuration specs, functional designs, test cases, and user manuals. Ensures compliance with pharmaceutical industry standards and regulations.
* Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to deliver and sustain Amgen's SAP GTS module integrated with SAP S4 ecosystem utilizing the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
* Develop innovative solutions that drive speed to value via AI/ML and leading practices.
* Ability to translate business requirements into design options that are cost effective, efficient, re-usable that align with defined architectural principles and standards.

Basic Qualifications and Experience:
  
  

* Master’s degree in computer science or Legal majors and 4 to 6 years of SAP implementation experience in specific to SAP GTS module.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or Legal majors and 6 to 8 years of SAP implementation experience specifically in SAP GTS Module
* Diploma in computer science or Legal majors and 10 to 12 years of IT or years of SAP implementation experience specific to GTS Module

Functional Skills:
  
  
**Must-Have Skills:**

* Strong hands-on experience in configuring and integrating all aspects of SAP GTS solutions for global deployments; focus on SPL Screening ( all Business Partners including Banks), Legal Control including Product classification and License management, Customs Management for Imports and Exports, Intrastat Reporting etc
* Understand Customs processes with Customs Invoices and field mappings background knowledge. Experience with S/4HANA Billing types and Invoice outputs customizations and Foreign trade process in S4 to be integrated with GTS.
* Demonstrated understanding of Global Legal Regulations as applied in GTS processes. Background to include experience in SAP best practices for Compliance and Customs management processes.
* Collaborate with integrated agile product teams to ensure seamless integration between SAP GTS and other SAP S4 modules (e.g. OTC, TM, FI and Tax) and external systems. Perform mentoring to team members.
* Ability to design and implement solutions based on business requirements, including debugging and root cause analysis.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Proficiency in S/4 OTC and pricing and billing processes integration GTS Customs management
* Good understanding of Cross functional interdependencies, S/4 Physical & Financial flow and S/4 Advance Intercompany and changes impact on GTS module
* Experience working in an agile environment and familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
* Knowledge in Master Data Governance tool (MDG).

Professional Certifications:
  
  

* SAP Certified Application Associate in SAP Global Trade Services. Preferred S4 OTC experience.
* Agile Certified Practitioner (preferred)

Soft Skills:
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance.

title: Senior Specialist, MEEHS Solution Architecture
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health & Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Role Overview**
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build-versus-buy options, guide proof-of-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the MEEHS target architecture Develop current-state, transition-state, and target-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.
* Establish trusted information models Define canonical data models, business vocabularies, identifiers, metadata standards, master and reference data alignment, and contextual relationships across projects, facilities, systems, equipment, documents, work processes, risks, and controls.
* Advance digital-thread capabilities Conceptualize and assess digital-thread use cases connecting engineering design, project controls, construction, commissioning and qualification, asset handover, site operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS information.
* Assess feasibility and shape investments Evaluate business value, technical feasibility, architecture fit, data readiness, integration complexity, cybersecurity, compliance, operating impact, cost, vendor capability, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Enable insights and AI readiness Create governed data foundations that support operational dashboards, KPI reporting, predictive insights, AI-assisted search, knowledge retrieval, machine-learning use cases, and future agent-enabled workflows. Design and build visualization layer using Power BI.
* Provide delivery leadership Convert approved concepts into solution designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, data contracts, implementation roadmaps, technical work packages, non-functional requirements, test strategies, deployment plans, and support models.
* Guide platform and vendor decisions Lead technical evaluations of COTS, SaaS, cloud, data, integration, analytics, and AI technologies; assess vendor roadmaps and architecture claims; and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Embed security, privacy, and compliance Incorporate secure-by-design, least-privilege access, identity federation, encryption, logging, monitoring, data classification, privacy, records management, GMP/GxP, validation, and audit-readiness requirements.
* Partner through a product mindset Work with Product Managers to connect user needs and business outcomes to capabilities, roadmaps, backlogs, release increments, adoption measures, product health, value realization, and total cost of ownership.

**What You Should Have**
**Primary Skills**
**TOGAF**

* API Architecture (REST, OData, Web Services)
* Data Architecture (Lakes, Lakehouse, Warehouse)
* Enterprise System Integration

**AI/Machine Learning Architecture**

* Secondary Skills CAD/BIM Platforms (Autodesk, Bentley)
* CMMS / Asset Reliability Platforms
* EHS Platforms (Enablon, Sphera, Cority, Intelex)
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 years of IT experience, including substantial experience in system architecture, solution architecture, enterprise integration, application modernization, and data-platform design.
* Demonstrated experience creating solution, integration, application, data, cloud, security, and deployment architectures for complex enterprise environments.
* Experience designing interoperability across COTS, SaaS, vendor-hosted, cloud, hybrid, and enterprise platforms using reusable integration and information patterns.
* Experience architecting data hubs, data platforms, warehouses, lakes or lakehouses, semantic models, metadata and lineage capabilities, data quality controls, and governed analytical consumption.
* Experience progressing concepts from discovery and feasibility assessment through proof of concept, pilot, implementation, rollout, operational transition, and lifecycle management.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, infrastructure, integration, data and analytics, procurement, service management, vendors, and managed service teams.
* Pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing experience is preferred. Experience in other industrial manufacturing sectors supporting engineering, maintenance, asset reliability, construction, manufacturing operations, or EHS will also be considered.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Architecture methods and modeling Capability mapping, domain architecture, reference architectures, architecture principles, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, design reviews, and modeling approaches such as ArchiMate or UML.
* Integration and interoperability API-first and event-driven architecture; REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OData, webhooks, message queues, event streaming, API gateways, iPaaS, middleware, ETL/ELT, managed file transfer, and data contracts.
* Data architecture and governance Relational and NoSQL models, warehouses, lakes and lakehouses, data products, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata catalogs, lineage, quality, stewardship, retention, archival, and role-based access.
* Cloud and platform architecture Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud services; SaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless services, hybrid integration, network patterns, availability, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, observability, and environment strategy.
* Digital engineering and MEEHS domains Engineering information management, CAD/BIM, project controls, common data environments, asset information, CMMS, condition monitoring, predictive reliability, EHS systems, electronic work permits, risk assessments, project-to-operations handover, digital threads, and digital twins.
* Analytics and AI enablement Power BI or comparable business intelligence platforms, analytical data preparation, feature-ready datasets, vector and semantic retrieval concepts, knowledge graphs, responsible AI controls, data provenance, model monitoring, and human oversight.
* Cybersecurity and identity Zero Trust, secure-by-design, IAM, SSO, MFA, RBAC, PAM, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, certificates, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, threat modeling, audit logging, and secure vendor connectivity.
* Regulated delivery and operations SDLC, Computer System Assurance, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 principles, GMP/GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 concepts, ALCOA+ data integrity, change and release control, traceability, periodic review, incident and problem management, and audit readiness.

**Non-Technical Skills And Competencies**

* Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect business capabilities, processes, applications, integrations, information, technology, controls, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
* Product-centered mindset with a focus on user needs, business value, reusable capabilities, roadmap sequencing, adoption, product health, lifecycle sustainability, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts clearly to business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, quality and security partners, vendors, and senior leadership.
* Ability to facilitate discovery, architecture workshops, trade-off decisions, design reviews, feasibility assessments, and cross-functional alignment using clear decision criteria.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through ambiguity without losing delivery discipline.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage conflicting priorities, constructively challenge assumptions, and build alignment within a global matrix organization.
* Inclusive and collaborative leadership style that invites diverse perspectives, shares knowledge, develops others, and establishes trust across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Certifications**

* TOGAF, ArchiMate, or a comparable enterprise and solution architecture certification.
* Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
* DAMA Certified Data Management Professional, Databricks Data Engineer, or comparable data architecture and governance certification.

**Working Hours and Expectations**

* This is primarily an office-based position. The successful candidate is expected to work on-site a minimum of three days per week to support effective architecture collaboration, stakeholder engagement, design workshops, knowledge sharing, and team development.
* Collaborate across global time zones and provide reasonable overlap for scheduled meetings with manufacturing sites, enterprise teams, vendors, and product stakeholders.
* Participate in planned architecture workshops, proof-of-concept activities, releases, cutovers, disaster-recovery exercises, and occasional off-hours support for critical implementation or production events in accordance with established procedures.
* Occasional travel may be required to support manufacturing sites, project teams, vendor engagements, architecture workshops, or implementation activities.

**Performance Measures**

* Delivery of approved current-state, transition-state, and target-state architectures, reference patterns, architecture decisions, implementation roadmaps, and technical work packages aligned with agreed scope and outcomes.
* Successful interoperability outcomes demonstrated through secure, reliable, supportable, and reusable integrations between platforms and critical enterprise systems.
* Progress in establishing central data hubs with trusted ingestion, transformation, metadata, lineage, quality, semantic modeling, access, and consumption capabilities.
* Business acceptance and measurable use of governed data for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and prioritized AI use cases.
* Feasibility assessments and architecture recommendations that provide clear options, trade-offs, dependencies, cost and risk considerations, and executable next steps.
* Compliance with architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, GMP/GxP, validation, data integrity, records, operational resilience, and audit-readiness requirements.
* Reduction of duplicate integrations, fragmented data flows, unsupported technologies, manual reconciliation, technical debt, vendor dependency, and lifecycle risk through documented architecture actions.
* Consistently demonstrates strong work ethic, ownership, accountability, integrity, and sound judgment while fostering inclusive, respectful, and collaborative behavior, sharing knowledge, seeking diverse perspectives, and contributing positively to cross-functional team outcomes.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing medicines and vaccines for many of the world’s most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to advance innovative health solutions for people and animals around the world.

We seek a pragmatic and forward-looking architect who combines technical depth with product thinking and delivery focus. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.

title: BCM-Technical Architect-Banking Domain-Manager-GDSF02
description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to support Banking and Digital Banking transformation programs. The role requires expertise in Core Banking platforms, Digital Banking architecture, API-led integration, cloud-native solutions, enterprise architecture and banking modernization. The successful candidate will define end-to-end technology architecture, solution blueprints, integration frameworks, transformation roadmaps and modernization strategies for Retail, Corporate and Transaction Banking platforms.
  
  
**Technical Architect – Digital Banking**
**Experience:**
9 to 15 Years

* Work closely with Business Architects, Product Owners, Delivery Leaders, Infrastructure Teams, Security Teams and Enterprise Architects.

* Guide implementation teams on architecture standards and good practices.
* Lead technology evaluation, platform selection and proof-of-concept activities.
* Participate in customer workshops, architecture discussions, RFP responses, solution demonstrations and advisory engagements.
* Ensure alignment with regulatory, compliance, security and operational risk requirements.
* Drive architecture decisions for cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

**Manager Responsibilities**

* Allocate work, supervise and mentor solution architects, leads, developers and analysts, and ensure teams have the tools and support needed to deliver successfully.
* Lead geographically distributed teams and coordinate delivery across business, product, engineering, infrastructure and security stakeholders.
* Engage effectively with CXOs, Business Heads, Product Owners and Enterprise Architects, and communicate architecture decisions with clarity.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* Strong experience in Banking Architecture and Digital Banking ecosystems, including enterprise-scale solution design.
* Experience defining architectural patterns and standards for banking transformation, platform modernization and legacy modernization initiatives.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman and Banking Industry Architecture Network (BIAN).
* Experience with one or more Core Banking platforms: Finacle, Temenos T24, Oracle Flexcube, Mambu, FIS or Fiserv.
* Strong experience in API-led architecture, Digital Banking integrations and API Management platforms.
* Strong architecture experience in Cloud Transformation Programs, CI/CD and DevSecOps architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise data architecture for banking programs, including relational and NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of banking data models, transaction processing architecture and security standards.

**Functional And Consulting Skills**

* Deep understanding of banking processes and operating models.
* Excellent consulting, stakeholder management and architecture communication skills.
* Strong experience in business process transformation and target operating model design.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to challenge solution approaches and recommend strategic alternatives.
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams and mentoring architects, leads, developers and analysts.

**Banking Domain Experience**

* Experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Retail Banking; Corporate Banking; Digital Banking
* Lending and Loan Origination; Deposits and CASA; Payments and Cards
* Transaction Banking; Cash and Liquidity Management; Trade Finance
* Treasury and Capital Markets; Wealth Management
* KYC and Customer Onboarding; Regulatory Reporting and Compliance
* Open Banking and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS); API Banking and Fintech Ecosystem Integration

**Ideally, You’ll Also**
Be a hands-on architecture leader who combines banking domain knowledge, technology delivery experience and consulting capability to bridge business and technology teams and deliver scalable transformation outcomes.
  
  
**What We Look For**

* 9 to 15 years of relevant experience in banking technology, enterprise architecture or Digital Banking transformation.
* Hands-on architectural experience across large-scale banking transformation programs.
* Ability to define end-to-end technology architecture, target states, roadmaps and integration frameworks.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management and communication skills across senior business and technology audiences.
* Ability to lead architecture governance, solution reviews and delivery teams in complex environments.
* A collaborative, outcome-focused approach with strong analytical and problem-solving capability.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Python, Cloud & GenAI)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
  
  
We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity.
  
  
The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact.
  
  
As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity.
  
  
API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership.
  
  
System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures.
  
  
Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards.
  
  
Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication.
  
  
Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads.
  
  
Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs.
  
  
Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles.
  
  
Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery.
  
  
Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns.
  
  
LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization.
  
  
RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality.
  
  
AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks.
  
  
Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management.
  
  
Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  
  
Mentoring & Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs and code, raise engineering quality across the team, and help engineers adopt modern Python, cloud, and AI engineering practices.
  
  
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, platform teams, security, architecture, product management, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
Technical Communication: Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and capabilities to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders with clarity and precision.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Experience: Typically 7+ years of software, platform, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including significant hands-on ownership of production systems and technical architecture. Demonstrated experience building production cloud-native applications on GCP and working with Generative AI or ML systems is required. Experience may span traditional software/platform engineering and newer AI engineering; candidates are not expected to have spent an unrealistic number of years specifically working with Generative AI.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently design complex systems, lead technical execution across multiple engineers or teams, influence architecture, and convert emerging technologies into reliable enterprise capabilities.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong production software engineering fundamentals. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asyncio, pytest, and modern Python tooling. Familiarity with Java, Go, TypeScript, or another production language is advantageous.
  
  
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, API design, distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous programming, software architecture, automated testing, debugging, Git, and engineering best practices.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Build, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns including containerization, serverless, event-driven design, service mesh, autoscaling, and infrastructure as code. Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, inference, and modern foundation-model architectures.
  
  
Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable modern ML/AI frameworks.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience designing and building production applications using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic AI patterns.
  
  
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging for production systems.
  
  
**TransUnion Overview**
At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

Sr Developer, Software Development
