title: Software Engineering PMTS (Apache, Kafka, Terraform)
description:
**Description**
You will be a Principal Engineer (PMTS) leading the Monitoring Cloud Events team in Hyderabad, India. Our team builds systems that handle huge amounts of data for Salesforce. We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Be Doing**

* Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online.
* Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work.
* Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need.
* Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world.

**Tech Stack**

* Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments.
* Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing.
* Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines.
* Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage.
* Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling.
* Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets.
* Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage.
* Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups.
* Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing.

**You’re Our Person If…**

* You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams.
* You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data.
* You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines.
* You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid.
* You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers.
* You are a great "service owner," meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly.

**Even Better If…**

* You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs).
* You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones.
* You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems.

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

title: Solution Architect - SCON
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Global Cyber Solution Hub**
Cyber Defense & Resilience Solution Architect
  
  
**Global Consulting Services**
Deloitte’s Global Consulting Services professionals support our global businesses to drive impact and create enduring value for clients in Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) and Technology & Transformation (T&T). We deliver purpose-driven services and solutions and provide a consistent, best-in-class "One Deloitte" experience around the world.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level: Senior Consultant**
The Cyber Defense & Resilience Solution Architect will join the Global Cyber Solution Hub and support Deloitte member firm teams on strategic and complex Cyber opportunities. The role will help pursuit teams turn business and technical requirements into practical Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions. It will bring relevant leading practice methods, assets, alliance relationships, and delivery experience into the pursuit process.
  
  
This is an internal advisory role. The Solution Architect will work with pursuit teams, Cyber Defense & Resilience leaders, specialists, and delivery teams across the Deloitte network. The primary focus will be shaping differentiated solutions across areas such as security operations, managed detection and response, threat detection engineering, cyber incident response, technology resilience, attack surface management, and cyber recovery. This aligns with Deloitte's Cyber Defense & Resilience offering that helps clients detect, respond to, recover from, and build resilience against cyber threats.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
**Solution shaping and technical win strategy**

* Shape Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions for strategic and complex pursuits, including the operating model, delivery approach, service architecture, and technical win themes
* Work with pursuit teams to understand the opportunity and define the role Cyber Defense & Resilience should play in the overall solution
* Use Deloitte methods, assets, and tools to structure a differentiated solution
* Develop the scope, key assumptions, effort estimate, transition approach, and staffing model
* Collaborate with pricing specialists so the commercial model reflects the solution and delivery approach
* Review solution designs for feasibility, differentiation, and fit with the client need
* Support Deloitte firm teams as they prepare for solution workshops, proposals, demonstrations, and oral presentations
* Help teams articulate outcomes related to threat detection, response effectiveness, operational resilience, incident readiness, and business continuity

**Cyber Defense & Resilience domain leadership**

* Bring experience across security operations, attack surface management, threat intelligence, managed detection and response, incident response, cyber recovery, and resilience capabilities
* Support development of operating models for SOC modernization, MXDR, and managed security services
* Help pursuit teams evaluate technology ecosystems and alliance opportunities that strengthen the defense and resilience proposition
* Identify opportunities to incorporate AI, automation, orchestration, and advanced analytics into Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions
* Review proposed service levels, performance measures, operating procedures, and governance approaches to support sustainable operations

**Cross-cyber integration**

* Identify where Cyber Defense & Resilience should connect with Enterprise Security, Digital Identity, Cyber Operate, or our other offerings
* Help teams bring Cyber into broader transformation pursuits when there is a clear client need
* Review priority opportunities identified through the intake process and shape the Cyber Defense & Resilience scope where it adds value
* Consider how the solution will move from advisory and implementation activities into ongoing operations and managed services
* Connect resilience and recovery requirements with broader technology transformation and business continuity objectives

**Global coordination and pursuit support**

* Act as a force multiplier for Deloitte firm pursuit teams by bringing Global assets, proof points, and operational experience into the opportunity where appropriate
* Connect teams with Cyber Defense & Resilience specialists, delivery centers, and alliance resources
* Build working relationships with offering leaders and technical specialists across the Deloitte network
* Coordinate existing expertise and materials rather than recreate work already available elsewhere in Deloitte
* Keep assumptions, dependencies, transition considerations, and open decisions clear so the Deloitte firm team can approve the final approach

**AI-enabled solution development**

* Use approved AI tools to support research, solution workshops, and development of proposal content
* Assess how AI, automation, and intelligent operations could improve the security solution or delivery model
* Support development of solution concepts into demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and operational use cases
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI-driven detection, response, threat analysis, and operational efficiencies into solution architectures
* Apply professional judgment when reviewing AI-generated content and remain accountable for the quality of the final work

**Assets and offering development**

* Turn successful pursuit approaches into reusable solution patterns, playbooks, operating models, and reference architectures
* Capture qualifications and proof points that can support future opportunities
* Contribute Cyber Defense & Resilience content to sales materials and other Global Cyber priorities
* Feed pursuit insights back to Global Cyber Defense & Resilience leadership to help improve the offering
* Maintain reusable content in line with confidentiality, intellectual property, and data-handling requirements

**The Team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help organizations strengthen their ability to detect, respond to, recover from, and adapt to cyber threats. The portfolio includes security operations, attack surface management, threat detection and response, cyber incident readiness and recovery, managed extended detection and response (MXDR), threat intelligence, and technology resilience services. Deloitte helps organizations modernize security operations, improve incident preparedness, accelerate response, and build resilience across business and technology environments.
  
  
The Global Cyber Solution Hub supports Deloitte member firm teams on priority opportunities across the Cyber portfolio. This global team helps teams shape solutions, locate relevant expertise, and reuse proven materials. Deloitte member firms remain responsible for the client relationship, approvals, and final deliverables.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Must have skills / project experience / certifications
  
  

* 5 to 8 years of experience in cyber consulting, security operations, incident response, cyber resilience, managed security services, or a solution architect or presales architect role
* Experience supporting large or complex pursuits
* Depth in one or more Cyber Defense & Resilience domains, such as SOC transformation, MXDR, threat detection and response, cyber threat intelligence, attack surface management, incident response, cyber recovery, or technology resilience
* Demonstrated ability to shape a solution from operating model and service architecture through delivery model and estimate
* Ability to explain and defend a technical approach with senior pursuit stakeholders and technical specialists
* Commercial fluency, including an understanding of managed services pricing models, margin considerations, and deal constructs
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce proposal-ready content and a clear presentation narrative
* Experience working across geographies and with distributed teams
* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities

**Skills**
**Good to have skills / project experience / certifications**

* Practical use of approved AI tools in proposal drafting, research, or solution development
* Familiarity with Deloitte methods and the Global Cyber offering portfolio
* Experience with leading cyber defense technologies, security operations platforms, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, cloud-native security tooling, or attack surface management solutions
* Experience with managed security services and transition-to-operate programs
* Experience working with global delivery centers or distributed teams
* Relevant credentials such as CISSP, GIAC certifications, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GCFE, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Security certifications, or equivalent technical certifications
* Experience incorporating automation, orchestration, AI, and analytics into security operations

**Education:**

* BE, B.Tech, MCA, M.Sc. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or an equivalent degree from an accredited university

**Location:**

* Deloitte US-India Offices, based on applicable talent and business requirements

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Principal Architect - Agentic AI Platform
description:
**Principal Architect - Agentic AI Platform**

Principal Architect - Agentic AI Platform

Role Profile Hands-on builder-architect with 0->1 SaaS / AI product experience and startup exposure

Location India (preferred: Gurugram/ Hyderabad)

Experience 8-10 years overall; strong recent Generative AI / Agentic AI experience

Employment Type Full-time

**About CustomerInsights.AI**

CustomerInsights.AI builds analytics and AI infrastructure for pharmaceutical commercial organizations. Founded in 2018 by pharma and analytics leaders, CIAI works across sales, marketing, market access, patient services, and commercial operations for clients ranging from emerging biotech to some of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the world.

Our platform-led delivery model develops reusable data, analytics, and AI capabilities that help organizations reconcile fragmented data, strengthen data governance and lineage, and make complex commercial information accessible through scalable applications and intelligent workflows.

**Role Overview**

CustomerInsights.AI is looking for a
**Principal Architect - Agentic AI Platform**
to help lead the next phase of architecture evolution for ciATHENA, our enterprise Agentic AI platform for Life Sciences Commercial. This is a hands-on architecture leadership role focused on evolving ciATHENA from a growing set of AI-enabled capabilities into a scalable, modular, secure and production-grade enterprise AI platform.

We are specifically looking for a
**0->1 product builder**
who has helped design and build SaaS and/or AI products from an early stage through production. The ideal candidate will have worked in a startup, scale-up, product incubation or similarly entrepreneurial environment where architecture decisions had to be made with incomplete information, evolving requirements, limited resources and a strong bias toward execution.

The successful candidate is expected to move comfortably between whiteboarding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production architecture, and to work directly with engineering teams to implement key architectural changes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the current-state assessment and target-state architecture for ciATHENA.
* Define architectural principles and reference patterns across agent orchestration, multi-agent workflows, LLM/SLM integration, model abstraction and routing, RAG and enterprise knowledge architectures, memory/state, tool/function calling, human-in-the-loop workflows, AI evaluation, observability, security and governance.
* Drive architecture evolution of key platform capabilities including Agent Registry, Knowledge Spine, orchestration services and AI runtime components.
* Establish reusable platform patterns so new ciATHENA modules and client implementations do not require custom architecture each time.
* Define clear service boundaries, APIs, event patterns and integration standards across the platform.
* Design scalable and resilient patterns for multi-tenancy, session/state management, asynchronous processing, failure recovery, model fallbacks and distributed workloads.
* Work closely with existing Data Engineering and DevOps teams to ensure architecture is production-ready and deployable across CustomerInsights.AI-hosted and customer VPC environments.
* Define integration patterns with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Veeva/Salesforce and enterprise data ecosystems.
* Partner with security and infrastructure teams on RBAC/RLS, SSO, auditability, tenant/data isolation, secrets management and enterprise security controls.
* Establish architecture standards around LLM independence and model portability, minimizing unnecessary dependency on any single model provider.
* Guide decisions around model selection, model routing, commercial LLMs, open-source models and smaller language models.
* Participate in architecture reviews and provide technical direction to AI, backend, platform and product engineering teams.
* Translate product and customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off implementations.
* Mentor senior engineers and help raise the architecture and engineering bar across the organization.
  

**Must-Have Experience**

* Demonstrated 0->1 experience building SaaS, AI or data products rather than only maintaining or modernizing mature platforms.
* Experience working in a startup, scale-up, founding/early engineering team, internal incubation group or entrepreneurial product environment with significant ownership over architecture and engineering decisions.
* Experience taking products from concept / prototype -> MVP -> production -> scale.
* 8-10 years of software engineering / architecture experience, including ownership of complex cloud-native or distributed systems.
* Strong hands-on engineering background with evidence of personally building, prototyping and troubleshooting production systems.
* Ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions balancing speed to market, scalability, technical debt, security, reliability and cost.
* Comfort operating in environments where requirements are evolving and architectural boundaries are still being established.
* Experience creating reusable platform capabilities rather than solving each customer or use case independently.
  

**Generative AI / Agentic AI Depth**

Hands-on experience designing and implementing production systems involving several of the following:

* LLM-based applications and Agentic AI architectures
* Multi-agent systems and workflow orchestration
* Tool/function calling, structured outputs and agent planning
* RAG, vector search and enterprise knowledge architectures
* Context engineering, agent memory and state management
* Model gateways, model routing and model fallback patterns
* AI guardrails, observability, tracing and evaluation frameworks
* Frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LlamaIndex or similar
  

**Engineering & Platform Depth**

* Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, state management, caching, resilience, scalability and multi-tenancy.
* Strong cloud architecture experience, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Strong coding proficiency, preferably Python, with the ability to build and validate production-quality prototypes.
* Ability to conduct architecture, design and code reviews at a Staff / Principal engineering level.
* Comfort debugging across application, AI, data and cloud layers.
* Experience evaluating emerging AI technologies through hands-on experimentation rather than relying solely on vendor documentation.
  

**Data & Enterprise Integration Experience**

* Working knowledge of Databricks, Snowflake, SQL/relational systems, vector databases, enterprise APIs, data warehouses/lakehouses, semantic layers and metadata/catalog architectures.
* Ability to design how enterprise data should be safely and efficiently exposed to AI agents without functioning as the primary Data Engineer.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise identity, data and application ecosystems.
  

**AI Governance & Enterprise Readiness**

* Experience designing systems with authentication/authorization, RBAC/RLS, audit logging, tenant isolation, data privacy, AI guardrails, model governance, traceability, human oversight and monitoring/observability.
* Experience in regulated industries such as Life Sciences, Healthcare or Financial Services is a plus, but deep product and engineering capability is more important than domain pedigree.
  

**Profile We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for a builder-architect, not a traditional enterprise Solution Architect.**
The ideal candidate has likely spent part of their career in a startup, AI-native company, product organization, founding/early engineering team or internal incubation environment where they helped create something new from the ground up. They should combine the architectural depth of a Principal Engineer with the execution mindset of an early-stage product builder.

* AI-native startups and B2B SaaS startups / scale-ups
* Enterprise AI product companies and cloud/data platform organizations
* Founding or early engineering teams
* Internal incubation / innovation teams within larger technology companies
* Principal / Staff engineering roles with significant product ownership

title: GenAI Engineers
description:
**About the role**

IntVerse Inc. is hiring multiple GenAI Platform Engineers to design, build, and operate an enterprise agentic AI platform within the SAP ecosystem for a global client. You’ll own the control plane — orchestration, gateways, agent lifecycle, knowledge stores, governance, and observability — and define how AI agents are built, evaluated, and safely run at scale. These are offshore roles based in India, working with global delivery and client teams.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build, and operate Control Plane components: Master Orchestrator, API Gateway, Agent Gateway(s), and Agent Lifecycle Manager
* Implement scalable event-driven workflows on Kafka — topic structure, retention, and partitioning strategy
* Design and operate agent runtimes and sandboxes: deployment, isolation, secrets distribution, versioning
* Build and maintain the Agent Registry, Agent Marketplace, and governed intake/approval flows integrated with a policy engine
* Integrate and manage knowledge stores — vector DB, knowledge graph, search index, object store — including retention, encryption, and access patterns
* Implement secrets management and policy enforcement (HashiCorp Vault or equivalent) with full auditability into SIEM/audit logs
* Build secure connectors to external tooling via an MCP Gateway (issue trackers, test automation, process modeling, RPA, ERPs) and manage multi-protocol integrations (gRPC, REST, webhooks, A2A)
* Implement observability — metrics, traces, logs, Grafana dashboards — and own SLOs/SLA monitoring for platform services and agents
* Build CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release processes for platform services and agent images
* Define agent quality metrics (accuracy, grounding, tool-use correctness, latency, cost); implement regression testing, golden datasets, and drift detection across agent and model versions
* Configure confidence thresholds, approvals, and escalation paths; capture SME feedback to continuously improve agent behavior
* Manage prompt/model versioning, A/B and canary releases, rollback strategies, and runtime policy enforcement
* Produce architecture docs and runbooks, own incident-response playbooks, and mentor engineers on secure agent development
* Partner with security, compliance, and product teams on governance, RBAC, approval flows, and chargeback/usage reporting

**What you bring**

* 5+ years building and operating distributed platform or infrastructure services (platform engineering, SRE, or backend)
* Strong production experience with event-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka or equivalent)
* Proficiency deploying and operating services on Kubernetes or similar
* Experience designing API Gateways and microservices (REST/gRPC)
* Hands-on Python for orchestration and microservices
* Secrets management and enterprise policy enforcement (HashiCorp Vault or equivalent)
* Observability and tracing (Prometheus/Grafana)
* SQL and NoSQL stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, Redis) and object storage (S3)
* Vector databases or embedding pipelines (Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone) and knowledge graph technologies (Neo4j or RDF)
* OpenSearch/Elasticsearch for indexing and search
* LLM integration patterns and RAG architectures
* Hands-on LLM/agent evaluation frameworks — automated testing, SME review loops, quality baselining, drift monitoring
* Experience implementing HITL systems for AI validation, exception handling, and decision augmentation
* Strong understanding of model, prompt, and agent governance — controlled rollouts, responsible AI risks, cost/token optimization
* Security best practices, RBAC, audit logging, and enterprise compliance
* Excellent communication; experience working cross-functionally with product and security teams

**Preferred**

* Policy engines or governance tooling (OPA or custom frameworks)
* Enterprise SSO/AD integration and identity federation
* MCP-style gateway integrations with Jira, SAP Signavio, test automation frameworks
* Regulated-environment experience (GDPR, HIPAA) or large enterprise governance programs
* Ownership of platform SLAs and chargeback/reporting systems

**Key deliverables**

Architecture diagrams and sequence flows; CI/CD pipelines and Helm manifests; runbooks; automated tests for orchestration logic and integration adapters; agent development and onboarding documentation; agent evaluation scorecards and dashboards; HITL workflow and escalation designs; model and prompt governance documentation.

**Work arrangement**

Offshore — India. Multiple positions available. Collaboration with global delivery and client teams across time zones.

**How to apply**

Apply via LinkedIn or send your resume to hello@intverse.io with “GenAI Platform Engineer” in the subject line.

* *IntVerse Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Gen AI Expert
description:

**Generative AI Systems Expert**

  4+ years of dedicated experience building and shipping LLM systems in production. You understand model selection, RAG architecture, fine-tuning strategies, inference optimization, and cost management. You make pragmatic trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and cost.

  You've shipped LLM systems at scale. You are deeply comfortable with tokenization, context windows, vector database optimization, handling hallucinations, and system failures.
* **Independent Operator:**
  You own AI features end-to-end—from problem definition through evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. You unblock yourself and make good decisions with incomplete information.
* **Quality & Evaluation-Minded (Highly Valued Plus):**
  You possess a rigorous engineering background with a strong appreciation for testing. You understand how to handle non-deterministic outputs through deterministic test design, evaluate model performance (F1, precision, recall), and build/use automation frameworks to prevent regressions.
* **Team Amplifier:**
  You mentor engineers on AI best practices, participate in code reviews, and help scale GenAI adoption across the organization.
* **Continuous Experimenter:**
  You A/B test approaches, iterate based on production data, and stay current with the rapid evolution of LLMs.

**GenAI Core & Architecture (Must-Have)**

* **LLM Ecosystem:**
  Deep experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face), model trade-offs, and selection.
* **Retrieval:**
  RAG pipeline architecture and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS).
* **Optimization:**
  Prompt engineering, fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), and inference optimization.
* **Operations:**
  Cost/latency management, hallucination detection, and mitigation.
* **Advanced Patterns:**
  Agentic patterns, multi-step reasoning, and building for reliability under uncertainty.
* **Education:**
  Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent professional experience. A practical portfolio demonstrating GenAI/ML implementation is valued highly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Build:**
  Design and implement end-to-end GenAI systems—RAG pipelines, fine-tuning strategies, and prompt optimization. Make pragmatic choices between model options, latency/cost trade-offs, and production constraints.

  Own the deployment of AI features. Architect the system to ensure reliability, scalability, and proper handling of edge cases (hallucinations, rate limits, failures) using robust validation strategies.
* **Measure & Evaluate:**
  Instrument systems with telemetry. Run A/B experiments comparing AI approaches. Establish metrics dashboards to track both system performance and model accuracy/alignment over time.
* **Collaborate:**
  Mentor engineers on AI best practices. Participate in code reviews. Help the team adopt and scale GenAI capabilities safely and effectively.

Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Materials and Structural Analysis Semiconductor R&D organization brings together around 400 engineers developing electron microscopy solutions and applications. Our global teams in Eindhoven, Brno, Hillsboro, Hyderabad, and Bordeaux combine expertise in hardware, software, and scientific applications to help customers make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer.
  
  
Within this organization, the Cortex value stream develops software for semiconductor data workflows, including tools to organize, explore, and visualize microscopy data. We’re looking for a
**Software Architect**
to own the end-to-end technical integrity and evolution of Cortex across its frontend, services, infrastructure, and integrations.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You’ll build a clear understanding of the existing Cortex architecture, document its principles and key decisions, and guide its evolution as the product and its ecosystem grow. Working with engineering teams and architects across sites, you’ll help ensure Cortex remains scalable, secure, maintainable, and cohesive across Core and Contributor applications.
  
  
You’ll connect architecture decisions across frontend, backend, and DevOps, helping teams make sound trade-offs and avoid siloed designs. You’ll also coordinate with Athena, SDP, and DAP architects and technical leads to support the evolution of Central Cortex and its plugin ecosystem.
  
  
What will you do?
  
  

* Learn, document, and communicate the current Cortex architecture, including its key components, dependencies, integrations, and constraints.
* Own and guide cross-stack architectural decisions across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data, infrastructure, and deployment.
* Define and maintain architecture principles, standards, and patterns that support Cortex’s product and engineering needs.
* Shape architecture for microservices, distributed systems, REST APIs, containerized applications, and cloud and on-premise environments.
* Guide frontend architecture, including microfrontend and plugin approaches, Web Components, and integration across Core and Contributor applications.
* Ensure architecture addresses scalability, performance, resilience, maintainability, observability, and cybersecurity.
* Guide authentication and authorization, data architecture, and secure development practices, including SBOM, SCA, and SAST considerations.
* Shape CI/CD architecture and deployment practices in collaboration with development and DevOps teams.
* Review major technical changes and designs, identify cross-system risks, and help teams make informed trade-offs.
* Coordinate with Athena, SDP, and DAP architects and technical leads on integration points and shared architectural concerns.
* Support the evolution of Central Cortex and the Contributor plugin ecosystem.
* Identify and prioritize technical debt with engineering teams, and help develop a practical strategy for addressing it.
* Encourage cohesive decisions across frontend, backend, and DevOps, and resolve architectural gaps between teams.
* Communicate architectural choices and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and management.
* Influence without direct authority, challenge designs constructively, and mentor engineers and technical leads.
* Regularly revisit architectural assumptions as Cortex, its user needs, and its technical environment evolve.

You’ll work with a distributed, cross-functional organization that includes colleagues in Bordeaux, Hillsboro, the Netherlands, and the Czech Republic. The role is based in Hyderabad and reports to the Functional Group Lead.
  
  
How will you get here?
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Significant experience designing and evolving software architectures for complex products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and REST/API architecture.
* Experience architecting containerized applications and working with Kubernetes.
* Experience with cloud and on-premise architecture.
* Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, data architecture, scalability, and performance.
* Understanding of both modern frontend architecture and backend/service architecture.
* Experience with microfrontend or plugin architectures and Web Components.
* Experience designing observability and CI/CD capabilities as part of a broader system architecture.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices and tooling, including SBOM, SCA, and SAST.
* Strong system-thinking skills and the ability to analyze dependencies, risks, and trade-offs across a product.
* Experience documenting architecture, principles, decisions, and technical direction.
* Strong technical communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain architecture to engineers and management.
* Ability to influence across teams, challenge designs constructively, and collaborate in a global or matrix organization.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting the evolution of an established product architecture while enabling new capabilities and integrations.
* Experience with scientific software, imaging, data-intensive applications, or semiconductor workflows.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms and integrations such as Athena, SDP, or DAP.
* Experience guiding technical debt strategy and mentoring engineers or technical leads.
* Experience working in a distributed, cross-functional Agile organization.

title: Senior AI/ML Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Senior AI / ML Architect – Model Training, Fine-Tuning & Hosting Job Summary We are seeking a Senior AI / ML Architect with 10–15 years of experience and strong hands-on expertise in machine learning, deep learning, LLM model training, domain-specific fine-tuning, cloud deployment, and model hosting. The primary focus of this role will be to train and fine-tune open-weight AI/ML models using domain specific enterprise data and build scalable infrastructure to host, serve, manage, and monitor these models in production. This is a highly hands-on role requiring strong practical experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LoRA, QLoRA, GPU infrastructure, cloud platforms, model serving, and MLOps tools. The candidate should be an experienced technical architect who can make architecture decisions while remaining deeply involved in implementation and troubleshooting.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect and implement solutions for training and fine-tuning ML and LLM models using domain-specific enterprise data.
* Evaluate and select appropriate open-weight models based on domain requirements, model capability, size, performance, licensing, infrastructure requirements, and cost.
* Build end-to-end pipelines for training data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, model packaging, deployment, and monitoring.
* Perform hands-on LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning of open-weight models.
* Configure and optimize fine-tuning parameters including rank, alpha, target modules, learning rate, batch size, sequence length, quantization, and training strategy.
* Work with domain-specific datasets to perform data cleaning, transformation, instruction formatting, dataset curation, synthetic data generation, deduplication, and quality validation.
* Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Accelerate, and related frameworks.
* Build scalable GPU-based training environments on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Plan and optimize GPU infrastructure for model training and inference, including A100, H100, L40S, or equivalent GPU environments.
* Deploy and host trained models using production-grade inference frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or TGI.
* Design scalable model-serving architectures supporting real-time inference, high availability, throughput, latency, and cost optimization.
* Manage the complete model lifecycle, including model versioning, registry, deployment, rollback, monitoring, upgrades, and retirement.
* Implement MLOps pipelines using tools such as MLflow, W&B, Kubernetes, Docker, Ray, and CI/CD platforms.
* Monitor model and infrastructure performance, including model quality, latency, throughput, GPU utilization, memory utilization, failures, and cost.
* Implement model evaluation and regression frameworks to validate that fine-tuned models deliver measurable improvement over baseline models.
* Troubleshoot model training, GPU, inference, deployment, and production issues.
* Work closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Cloud Engineers to operationalize models.
* Establish reusable architecture patterns and engineering standards for domain-specific model training and hosting.
* Provide technical leadership and mentor engineers working on ML/LLM training and deployment.

**Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of overall technology experience.
* Strong experience in ML/AI engineering, Deep Learning, and production model development.
* 4+ years of applied ML/DL experience preferred.
* 2+ years of experience working with LLM/GenAI models in production preferred.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with model training/fine-tuning and cloud-based model deployment.
* Strong architecture and technical leadership experience.
* Ability to work directly with engineering teams and remain hands-on with implementation.

**Required Skills**

* Primary Skills

* Model Training & Fine-Tuning — Non-Negotiable

* Strong hands-on experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proven experience training and fine-tuning LLM/Deep Learning models using domain specific data.
* Strong hands-on expertise in LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience with PEFT, SFT, TRL, Accelerate, or equivalent frameworks.
* Experience with open-weight models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral/Mixtral, Gemma, DeepSeek, or Phi.
* Strong understanding of training datasets, hyperparameters, GPU utilization, model evaluation, and training optimization.

* Model Hosting & Cloud Deployment — Non-Negotiable

* Strong hands-on experience deploying and hosting ML/LLM models on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with GPU-based cloud infrastructure and capacity planning.
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or TGI.
* Ability to design scalable and reliable model-serving infrastructure for production workloads.

* MLOps & Model Lifecycle Management — Non-Negotiable

* Hands-on experience implementing ML/LLM lifecycle management from experimentation through production.
* Experience with MLflow, W&B, model registries, CI/CD, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.
* Ability to establish automated pipelines for training, evaluation, deployment, and retraining.
* Strong understanding of production model monitoring and operational management.

* Secondary Skills

* Data & Evaluation

* Python and SQL.
* Experience with large-scale data preparation and data pipelines.
* Experience creating domain-specific evaluation datasets and golden sets.
* Exposure to LLM evaluation, LLM-as-judge, and automated regression testing.
* Experience with multimodal models is a plus.

Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Role: ServiceNow Technical Architect – Conversational AI / GenAI
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Technical Architect – Conversational / GenAI with 6+ years of experience to lead the architecture and implementation of enterprise conversational AI capabilities on the ServiceNow platform.
  
  
The role will own NLU model design, Virtual Agent architecture, conversational workflows, Now Assist/GenAI integration patterns, AI Agent capabilities, and enterprise AI guardrails.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on ServiceNow experience combined with an understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, AI governance, human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
  
  
This role will work closely with ServiceNow engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Privacy, Risk, and AI Governance teams to ensure that conversational and agentic AI solutions are scalable, secure, testable, auditable, and aligned with enterprise AI governance standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Conversational Architecture
  
  
Own the architecture and technical design of ServiceNow Virtual Agent and conversational AI solutions.
  
  
Design and govern NLU intents, entities, utterances, conversation models, and conversational flows.
  
  
Define reusable architecture patterns for conversational experiences across multiple business functions.
  
  
Translate business requirements into scalable, testable, and governed conversational solutions.
  
  
Establish standards for conversational design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
  
  
Virtual Agent & NLU
  
  
Design and implement Virtual Agent topics, topic flows, NLU models, intents, entities, and conversation experiences.
  
  
Review and govern Virtual Agent topic design and implementation quality.
  
  
Optimize intent recognition, entity extraction, conversation completion, and resolution rates.
  
  
Define fallback and escalation mechanisms when conversational AI cannot confidently resolve a request.
  
  
Establish testing strategies for conversational accuracy, quality, and user experience.
  
  
GenAI / Now Assist Architecture
  
  
Design integration patterns for ServiceNow Now Assist and Generative AI capabilities.
  
  
Evaluate and implement LLM-based use cases within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
  
  
Define prompt engineering, prompt templates, context management, grounding, and response-generation patterns.
  
  
Design appropriate controls around AI-generated responses and AI-driven actions.
  
  
Ensure GenAI solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.
  
  
AI Guardrails & Responsible AI
  
  
Design AI guardrails to control inappropriate, inaccurate, unsafe, or unauthorized AI-generated responses/actions.
  
  
Define human oversight and human-in-the-loop mechanisms for high-risk AI use cases.
  
  
Establish approval gates for AI-generated content and actions where required.
  
  
Design fallback, escalation, exception-handling, and intervention mechanisms.
  
  
Ensure AI solutions have appropriate controls around data access, privacy, security, and authorization.
  
  
Define risk-based controls based on the nature and impact of each AI use case.
  
  
Auditability & Governance
  
  
Ensure conversational and GenAI solutions maintain a clear audit trail.
  
  
Define logging and monitoring requirements for AI prompts, responses, actions, approvals, exceptions, and human interventions where applicable.
  
  
Ensure AI implementations align with enterprise AI governance, security, privacy, compliance, and risk-management requirements.
  
  
Participate in AI governance, architecture review, security, privacy, and risk review forums.
  
  
Provide technical input for AI use-case risk assessments and approval processes.
  
  
Analytics & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Own conversational analytics and define KPIs for conversational AI performance.
  
  
Monitor metrics such as:
  
  
Intent recognition accuracy
  
  
Containment/resolution rate
  
  
Fallback rate
  
  
Escalation rate
  
  
User satisfaction
  
  
AI response quality
  
  
Task completion rate
  
  
Analyze conversation failures and user feedback to continuously improve NLU models and conversation flows.
  
  
Establish continuous improvement processes for Virtual Agent and GenAI capabilities.
  
  
Agentic AI & Automation
  
  
Evaluate opportunities for agentic workflows and AI-driven automation within ServiceNow.
  
  
Design controlled AI agents capable of executing business actions within defined authorization boundaries.
  
  
Define approval, validation, and human intervention points for agentic workflows.
  
  
Ensure agentic solutions have measurable success criteria and appropriate risk controls.
  
  
Collaborate with platform, workflow, integration, and security teams to implement agentic solutions.
  
  
Stakeholder & Architecture Engagement
  
  
Represent the conversational AI squad in architecture, AI governance, security, privacy, and risk review forums.
  
  
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand use cases and translate them into technical solutions.
  
  
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Privacy, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  
  
Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to development teams.
  
  
Mentor developers and establish best practices for conversational and GenAI development.
  
  
**Must-Have Skills & Experience**
ServiceNow
  
  
6+ years of overall IT / ServiceNow experience.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow Virtual Agent.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Virtual Agent Designer / NLU implementation.
  
  
Strong understanding of:
  
  
Virtual Agent topics
  
  
Topic flows
  
  
NLU intents
  
  
Entities
  
  
Utterances
  
  
Conversation design
  
  
Fallback and escalation flows
  
  
Experience designing and implementing conversational solutions on ServiceNow.
  
  
Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture and integration capabilities.
  
  
GenAI / LLM
  
  
Practical understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) integration patterns.
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering / prompt design.
  
  
Understanding of:
  
  
Prompt templates
  
  
Context management
  
  
Grounding
  
  
Retrieval-based approaches
  
  
Response validation
  
  
Hallucination mitigation
  
  
AI response evaluation
  
  
Experience integrating or working with enterprise GenAI capabilities, preferably ServiceNow Now Assist.
  
  
Ability to translate business requirements into governed and testable AI/conversational solutions.
  
  
AI Governance & Risk

Human-in-the-loop controls
  
  
Approval workflows
  
  
AI guardrails
  
  
Fallback mechanisms
  
  
AI auditability
  
  
Risk controls

Architecture & Stakeholder Management

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills & Experience**

Experience implementing AI-powered workflows using ServiceNow.

Agentic AI
  
  
Previous experience working on an agentic AI / AI-agent pilot or proof of concept.

Understanding of AI agent concepts such as:
  
  
Tool calling
  
  
Agent orchestration
  
  
Planning and reasoning workflows
  
  
Autonomous vs. human-approved actions
  
  
Agent permissions and boundaries
  
  
Multi-step task execution
  
  
Experience designing human approval checkpoints for high-impact AI actions.
  
  
AI Engineering
  
  
Experience with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Amazon Bedrock.
  
  
Knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures.
  
  
Understanding of vector databases and semantic search.
  
  
Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and response-quality measurement.
  
  
Knowledge of prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination, and other GenAI security risks.
  
  
ServiceNow Certifications
  
  
Preferred certifications include:
  
  
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Virtual Agent
  
  
ServiceNow AI / GenAI-related certifications
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities

title: Principal Engineer - AI Applications
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As a
**Principal AI Engineer**
, you will play a key role in designing and delivering highly scalable, next generation AI products within our
**AI Marketplace**
. You will work in a technically rich environment with talented peers, contributing to product strategy, architecture, and execution while influencing the evolution of Teradata’s AI capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Design, architect, develop, and maintain high quality systems, services, and applications with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineers and product partners to shape architecture and consistently deliver end to end features.
* Build and integrate robust RESTful APIs, ensuring security, data consistency, and maintainability.
* Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to implement efficient data models and service access patterns.
* Apply and experiment with AI/ML technologies, including agentic AI and large language models (LLMs).
* Use AI powered engineering tools to improve development quality, speed, and productivity.
* Mentor engineers, supporting them in technical planning, implementation, and best practices.
* Identify and resolve system performance bottlenecks, optimizing code, architecture, and infrastructure.
* Write unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews to uphold engineering excellence.
* Investigate production issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
* Stay current with emerging trends in engineering, AI/ML, and cloud-native technologies.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will be part of a high-performing engineering team building core components of Teradata’s AI platform. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, AI/ML specialists, product managers, cloud architects, and partner teams across the company. The role offers opportunities to contribute directly to Teradata’s AI product roadmap and technological direction.
  
  
**(Nonnegotiable Qualifications)**
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a recognized institution.
* 15+ years of experience in backend services, distributed systems, or data platform development.
* Strong proficiency in Java, Go, or Python for service development.
* Deep understanding of design principles, distributed system patterns, and service architecture.
* Hands-on experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and data modelling.
* Strong debugging, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with modern containerization and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of public cloud platforms.
* Experience with AI productivity tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot).
* Ability to work independently, drive workstreams, and deliver high quality outcomes.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**What You’ll Bring**
(Preferred qualifications)
  
  

* Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka.
* Experience experimenting with or implementing AI/ML technologies, Agentic AI, or LLMs.
* A track record of influencing architecture decisions and driving engineering best practices.
* The ability to mentor engineers and guide them through design, planning, and execution.
* A proactive mindset and comfort working in fast paced, dynamic environments.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for building impactful AI-driven products.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: India General Template (Copy)
description:
Accellor is an AI-native services firm focused on delivering measurable business outcomes through advanced AI, data, and engineering capabilities. We help global innovators and Fortune 100 enterprises modernize their architectures, scale operations, and operationalize intelligence across the enterprise.
  
  
Our core focus centers on transforming advanced AI from proofs-of-concept into production-grade systems. Spanning AI solutions, robust data services, enterprise applications, and product engineering — we tailor our offerings to the distinct operational needs of industries such as healthcare, life sciences, telecom, retail, financial services, and technology.
  
  
Operating as an extension of our clients' teams, we combine design thinking with technology-agnostic architectures to ensure faster time-to-value and seamless system interoperability. From initial strategy to full-scale deployment, we build intelligent, connected ecosystems that drive sustained enterprise value and redefine the future of transformation.
  
  
**Job Description**
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Own the architecture for backend services and platforms — microservices boundaries, API contracts, data models, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Make and document key technical decisions (build vs. buy, sync vs. async, consistency vs. availability trade-offs) and align teams around them.
* Set and enforce engineering standards: code quality, testing strategy, observability, and operational readiness.

People & Team Leadership
  
  

* Directly manage, mentor, and grow a team of backend engineers, including running 1:1s, setting goals, giving feedback, and supporting career development.
* Plan, distribute, and track work across the team — breaking down epics, sequencing delivery, and removing blockers so the team ships predictably.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and design coaching, raising the bar for the whole team rather than being the single point of delivery.
* Partner with product, architecture, and other engineering leads to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and realistic commitments.

Delivery & Engineering Execution
  
  

* Lead by example with hands-on contribution to high-impact and complex parts of the codebase.
* Design and operate microservices: service decomposition, API design (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), versioning, and backward compatibility.
* Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows using message queues and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar).
* Design data persistence and caching strategies across relational and NoSQL stores, with appropriate use of caching layers (Redis/Memcached) for performance and scale.

Scalability, Reliability & Security
  
  

* Ensure systems are designed for scale, resilience, and graceful degradation — load balancing, rate limiting, retries, circuit breakers, and idempotency.
* Drive observability across services: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting.
* Enforce backend security best practices: authentication/authorization (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), least-privilege access, secrets management, and secure handling of data in transit and at rest.
* Own production quality — on-call leadership, incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on remediation.

Collaboration & Governance
  
  

* Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams on CI/CD, containerization, and deployment strategy for backend services.
* Recommend and implement standards for code organization, service ownership, and technical governance across teams.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale.
* Demonstrated experience leading both projects and people — owning end-to-end delivery for a team, managing engineers directly, and mentoring juniors. You must be able to point to specific teams you’ve grown and projects you’ve driven to delivery.
* Languages & Frameworks: Deep expertise in at least one major backend stack (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, Go, Python, Node.js, or C#/.NET) and the ability to work fluently across more than one.
* Distributed Systems & Microservices: Strong, demonstrable experience designing and operating microservices and distributed systems in production.
* APIs: Hands-on expertise designing and evolving APIs (REST, gRPC, or GraphQL), including contracts, versioning, and documentation.
* Messaging & Async: Practical experience with message queues / event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.).
* Data: Strong SQL skills and solid experience with relational databases, plus working knowledge of NoSQL stores and data modeling for scale.
* Caching: Hands-on experience with caching strategies and tools (Redis, Memcached).
* Containers & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Networking: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals — HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, DNS, service discovery, and load balancing.
* Version Control & Practices: Strong Git/GitOps proficiency and a deep commitment to code review, testing, and CI/CD.
* Cloud: Demonstrable experience building backend systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

**Preferred**

* Experience with service mesh, API gateways, or platform/internal-developer-platform tooling.
* Experience with performance profiling, load testing, and capacity planning.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and partnering closely with DevOps/SRE.
* Exposure to AI-driven or data-intensive backend workloads, as Accellor increasingly integrates backend engineering with AI-powered platform delivery.

**Benefits**
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centres.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
Accellor prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training, Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Personal Accident Insurance, Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Disclaimer: -**
Accellor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic

title: Lead Consultant - Software Engineering
description:
**What You'll Do**
This role is part of the Integration team responsible for the enterprise Managed File Transfer capability. The Senior Consultant will serve as the technical SME and technical lead for the GoAnywhere platform, providing deep technical expertise while driving platform architecture, engineering standards, operational stability, and future strategy.
  
  
The position requires 15+ years of overall technology experience, with strong expertise in enterprise integration and Managed File Transfer platforms, particularly GoAnywhere. The individual will provide technical direction to the engineering team, lead complex solution and architecture decisions, and help establish and mature the GoAnywhere capability within GCH.
  
  
The role will also be instrumental in enabling upcoming transitions and positioning the team to support future enterprise integration requirements.
  
  
Core Technologies
  
  

* Managed File Transfer: GoAnywhere MFT
* Cloud: AWS
* Infrastructure as Code / Automation: Terraform
* DevOps / Source Control: GitHub
* ITSM: ServiceNow
* Planning & Collaboration: JIRA, Confluence
* Methodology: Agile
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, SDLC, security, infrastructure and enterprise integration practices

GoAnywhere Technical Leadership & Strategy
  
  

* Serve as the GoAnywhere technical SME and technical authority, providing direction and guidance to engineers supporting the platform.
* Define and drive the technical roadmap and future strategy for the GoAnywhere MFT platform, aligned with enterprise integration and technology direction.
* Lead architecture and solution design for complex Managed File Transfer and enterprise integration requirements.
* Establish engineering standards, design patterns, operational practices and reusable solutions for the GoAnywhere platform.
* Provide technical leadership for the transition of GoAnywhere capabilities and knowledge from HO to GCH, reducing dependency on individual expertise over time.
* Provide technical leadership and solution oversight for upcoming BEAM and SEA transitions, as well as future integration initiatives.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, security and integration teams to design scalable and supportable solutions.

Platform Engineering & Architecture
  
  

* Architect, administer and evolve GoAnywhere MFT environments across non-production and production environments.
* Lead complex installation, configuration, migration, patching and platform upgrade initiatives.
* Provide expertise across GoAnywhere projects, workflows, schedulers, monitors, partner configurations and secure file-transfer patterns.
* Design solutions leveraging secure transfer protocols including SFTP, FTPS and HTTPS.
* Provide technical oversight for AWS infrastructure supporting GoAnywhere, including EC2, Load Balancers, VPC, Route53, S3, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, Certificate Manager and CloudWatch.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform, including development of scalable and reusable modules and automation patterns.
* Drive appropriate use of GitHub and CI/CD practices for platform engineering and infrastructure changes.

**Who You Are**

* 15+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in enterprise integration, middleware, Managed File Transfer or related platform engineering.
* Deep hands-on expertise with GoAnywhere MFT in large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience providing technical leadership for enterprise platforms or integration services.
* Strong experience designing and supporting GoAnywhere on AWS.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience, particularly Terraform.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and secure file-transfer technologies.
* Experience with enterprise-scale platform upgrades, migrations, DR, security remediation and production support.
* Strong understanding of AWS infrastructure, networking, IAM, security, monitoring and resiliency concepts.
* Experience working with CI/CD, GitHub, ServiceNow, JIRA and Confluence.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues spanning application, infrastructure, network, database and integration layers.
* Experience influencing architecture and engineering decisions across multiple technical teams.

Leadership Qualities
  
  

* Recognized SME who can operate independently and provide technical direction to others.
* Able to move between strategic platform discussions and hands-on technical problem solving.
* Strong technical decision-making and ability to navigate ambiguity.
* Able to influence teams and stakeholders without requiring direct reporting authority.
* Strong communicator capable of explaining complex technical topics to both engineering and leadership audiences.
* Demonstrates ownership and accountability for platform stability, engineering quality and technical outcomes.
* Strong mentoring mindset with a focus on building capability within the broader team.
* Forward-looking and able to identify how the platform needs to evolve to support future enterprise integration needs.
