title: Chief Architect, Global Platforms
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning

**Position Details:**

* **Job Title:**
  Chief Architect, Global Platforms
* **Function/Department:**
  Technology
* **Location:**
  Hyderabad / Bangalore - Work from Office
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time
* **Experience Level:**
  20+ Years

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Global Head of Architecture, this leader will be responsible for leading the design and technology roadmaps for all the global technology and insurance platforms (following are examples)

1. Underwriting Platform, rating platform etc.,
2. Integration, API management, and BPM Platforms

S/he will also be responsible for evangelizing the adoption of these platforms in partnership with global CIO teams. S/he will govern global solution design levergaing these platforms

This position is a critical strategic role that will partner closely with Regional CIOs, Heads of Technology and Business Leaders to develop and execute our platform strategy.

**Objective**

* Drive purposeful thought leadership, strategy and execution for Chubb’s Core Platform Architecture Organization.
* Defining, implementing and communicating the vision of the platform architecture that supports and drives Chubb’s business strategies.
* Provide strategic engineering leadership, oversight, guidance and support to drive a competitive edge by leveraging cloud scale architectures and next gen technology solutions enabling differentiated business opportunities. A strong focus is required to roadmap technology and business capabilities into executables, improve efficiencies and reduce operating expenses.
* Requires a “transformational” leader with an entrepreneurial mindset, able to influence change at all levels of the organization and deliver globally to achieve results.
* Able to demonstrate how a Platform/Product operating model drives innovation, speed and efficiency in software delivery.

**Qualifications:**

The ideal candidate will come from a complex multinational organization and be a visionary leader in Platform/Product development and operating models. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business, or a related field. Master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

* 20+ years relevant work experience, including experience leading large, cross-functional teams across engineering, architecture and product development
* Knowledge of insurance underwriting products – Duck Creek preferred
* Strong knowledge of cloud native architectures, full stack application and product development
* Experience with taking a product to market on an internal or external cloud platform
* Experience working in or with large enterprises in Digital Transformation programs
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills; Data driven and results oriented.
* Experience in affecting large culture change.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to work with seamlessly with remote teams
* Experience delivering with an agile methodology.
* Capability to define a well thought out organizational strategy and execute on an associated operational plan.
* Exceptional strategic analysis, problem solving, issue resolution and decision-making skills.
* Leadership skills: individual leadership, change leadership, mentorship, motivation, coaching and development, and the ability to galvanize the support of others where possible.
* Highly detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to embrace change without frustration.
* Delivery of high-quality strategic large-scale projects.
* Ability to manage senior staff as well as manage staff remotely across multiple locations, time zones and cultures.
* Demonstrated track record and ability to influence external organizations.
* Self-directed, motivated, and managed; ability to deal with imperfect information, decision, and drive to successful conclusions.
* Experience leading re-organization and uniting teams to work collaboratively.
* Ability to handle constant pressure and juggle multiple demands.
* Flexibility with travel.
* Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries and geographies.
* Understanding of the agile software development processes and lifecycle with understanding of financial impacts.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating and driving safe, sound processes through review, evaluation, and management of effective controls.
* Great at mentoring, coaching as well as being a diversity champion.
* Demonstrated ability to work with a Team of executives for common purpose.
* Excellent organizational skills; must be able to manage disparate tasks, project plans and ad-hoc teams without solid lines of authority.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking and communication skills - must have ability to synthesize, develop and present clear and concise recommendations.
* Collaborative and team player, ensuring overall business success.
* Exceptional influencing skills with sound judgment and decision-making skills.
* A rounded knowledge of operations organizations in a large scale, complex organization is critical.
* Strong talent focuses and ability to successfully recruit and develop experts from leading organizations across the globe.
* Ability to communicate a compelling vision and inspire others to deliver on an ambitious, complex, global roadmap.
* Ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels within an organization, from the most technical engineer to the business / executive leader.
* Possess uncompromising ethics, unwavering integrity and understanding of risk & regulatory process, as well as outstanding communications and interpersonal skills.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!

Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* **Industry leader:**
  Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* **A Great Place to work:**
  Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024 and 2024-2025
* **Laser focus on excellence**
  : At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* **Start-Up Culture**
  : Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment plan their finances
* **Upskilling and career growth opportunities:**
  With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* **Health and Welfare Benefits:**
  We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Join Us**

* With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India’s journey
  **.**

**Application Process:**

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.

* **Step 1**
  : Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal / LinkedIn
* **Step 2**
  : Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* **Step 3**
  : Participate in Hacker Rank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* **Step 4**
  : Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

title: Solution Architect - Data
description:
**Delivery Transformation Office – Data Transformation Architect.**

We are seeking a
**Transformation Architect specializing in Data**
to lead the transformation of large-scale enterprise delivery programs for strategic clients. This role is ideal for a hands-on, client-facing architecture leader who can translate business challenges into modern data, analytics, and AI solutions.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience across
**enterprise data architecture, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, ETL/data integration, Azure Data Factory (ADF), AI/BI, and Azure/AWS cloud environments**
, along with the executive presence to consult with clients, shape solution roadmaps, and lead transformation from strategy through implementation.

**What You Will Do**

* Serve as a
  **client-facing Data Solution Architect**
  , partnering with client executives, technology leaders, data teams, and delivery organizations to define and execute enterprise data transformation strategies.
* Assess clients' current data ecosystems and develop
  **modernization roadmaps across data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud, and data engineering**
  .
* Architect scalable
  **data platforms and pipelines using technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure, and AWS**
  .
* Design modern data architectures that support
  **data ingestion, ETL/ELT, lakehouse architectures, data warehousing, analytics, BI, and AI use cases**
  .
* Help clients modernize legacy data platforms and migrate workloads to
  **cloud-based data ecosystems**
  .
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and clearly communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and pilot initiatives through production deployment and scaled enterprise adoption.
* Identify opportunities to apply
  **AI, advanced analytics, and BI**
  to improve decision-making, automation, productivity, and customer experience.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to ensure solutions are architecturally sound, secure, governed, scalable, and aligned with client objectives.
* Quantify and communicate the business value of transformation initiatives through measurable improvements in cost, performance, productivity, quality, and user experience.

**Transformation Focus Areas**

**Data & Analytics Modernization**

* Modern data platforms, lakehouse and data warehouse architectures
* Microsoft Fabric and Databricks
* ETL/ELT architecture and data integration
* Azure Data Factory pipelines and orchestration
* Data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and consumption
* Business intelligence, reporting, and advanced analytics

**Cloud Data Architecture**

* Azure-first data architectures with experience across
  **Azure and AWS**
* Cloud migration and modernization of legacy data environments
* Scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise data platforms
* Integration across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments

**AI & Business Intelligence**

* AI/BI strategy and architecture
* Generative AI and AI-enabled analytics
* Power BI and enterprise visualization
* Enabling AI/ML use cases through modern, governed data platforms
* Translating enterprise data into actionable business insights

**Delivery Transformation**

* Modernization of large-scale enterprise delivery environments
* Global and offshore delivery models
* Automation and productivity improvement
* Governance, quality, security, and operational excellence

**Core Skills & Experience**

**Data Architecture & Engineering**

* Strong experience designing
  **enterprise-scale data architectures and modern data platforms**
* Hands-on architectural experience with
  **Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks**
* Deep understanding of
  **ETL/ELT processes, data integration, data pipelines, and orchestration**
* Experience designing and modernizing
  **Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines**
* Understanding of modern architectural patterns including
  **lakehouse, data lake, and data warehouse architectures**
* Experience integrating structured and unstructured data across multiple enterprise systems

**Cloud**

* Strong experience with
  **Microsoft Azure**
  , particularly Azure-based data services
* Experience working with
  **AWS data environments**
  and/or designing multi-cloud solutions
* Experience migrating legacy data platforms and workloads to cloud-based architectures

**AI, Analytics & BI**

* Experience designing data platforms that support
  **AI, machine learning, GenAI, advanced analytics, and BI use cases**
* Strong understanding of how enterprise data architectures enable AI adoption
* Experience with
  **Power BI and/or Tableau**
* Ability to connect technical data strategy to measurable business outcomes

**Architecture & Delivery**

* Experience designing integrations using APIs, microservices, and enterprise data services
* Understanding of DevOps/DataOps, CI/CD, observability, security, and data governance
* Ability to take solutions from
  **discovery and architecture through POC, implementation, and enterprise-scale adoption**

**Qualifications**

* **8+ years of experience**
  in solution architecture, data architecture, data engineering, technology consulting, or enterprise transformation roles.
* Demonstrated experience architecting
  **large-scale enterprise data and analytics solutions**
  .
* Strong experience with
  **Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, ETL/ELT, ADF/data pipelines, and Azure and/or AWS cloud environments**
  .
* Experience leading
  **data modernization or cloud data transformation initiatives**
  from strategy through implementation.
* Strong enterprise consulting and client-facing experience, including the ability to lead discovery sessions and architecture discussions with senior technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations and business value for executive audiences.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional engineering, architecture, data, and delivery teams.
* Experience delivering measurable improvements across cost, scalability, performance, quality, and customer experience.

**Why This Role**

This role sits at the intersection of
**data strategy, architecture, AI, and enterprise transformation**
. You will work directly with strategic clients to modernize how they collect, manage, analyze, and activate data while building the foundation required for advanced analytics and AI.

You will have the opportunity to shape enterprise data roadmaps, architect modern platforms using technologies such as
**Microsoft Fabric and Databricks**
, lead cloud and data modernization initiatives, and take solutions from initial strategy through scaled implementation.

title: Principal Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
Job Description – Principal Salesforce Solution Architect

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Principal Salesforce Solution Architect with strong expertise in system design, enterprise architecture, and complex system integrations.

The ideal candidate should have a strong technical background in designing scalable enterprise applications across multiple technology platforms, along with a good understanding of Salesforce (SFDC) architecture and its integration capabilities.

We are looking for a technology-agnostic architect who can independently design end-to-end solutions, evaluate different technologies, define integration strategies, and solve complex enterprise integration challenges. The role is not limited to Salesforce-specific architecture.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture and system design for complex enterprise applications.
* Design scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions across multiple technology platforms.
* Define integration architecture and strategies for connecting Salesforce with ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, databases, legacy applications, and third-party systems.
* Identify and implement appropriate enterprise integration patterns based on business and technical requirements.
* Design RESTful APIs, SOAP services, microservices, event-driven architectures, and asynchronous integration solutions.
* Evaluate and recommend suitable technologies, frameworks, middleware, and integration platforms.
* Drive architectural decisions involving distributed systems, cloud-native applications, and enterprise platforms.
* Identify technical challenges and provide effective solutions for complex system-to-system integrations.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable integration frameworks, design principles, and technical governance.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, product owners, and technology leaders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership, conduct architecture reviews, and guide development teams on implementation best practices.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for scalability, availability, performance, security, and maintainability.

Required Technical Skills

* 12+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, technical architecture, or enterprise architecture.
* Strong expertise in system design, solution architecture, and end-to-end technical design.
* Good understanding of Salesforce (SFDC) architecture, platform capabilities, data models, APIs, security, and integration capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and architectural principles.
* Experience designing complex integrations across Salesforce and non-Salesforce platforms.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, SOAP services, API gateways, middleware, and messaging systems.
* Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, WSO2, IBM Integration Bus, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Understanding of API security, OAuth 2.0, authentication, authorization, and enterprise security standards.
* Ability to evaluate different technology options and design solutions for complex business and technical challenges.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect – Corporate Services Engineering
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
Corporate Services Engineering (CSE) supports a diverse portfolio of enterprise applications, platforms and services underpinning LSEG's corporate business functions.
  
  
We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on Solution Architect with a software engineering background and broad technology experience to help shape, simplify, integrate and modernise our technology landscape.
  
  
The role goes beyond traditional solution architecture. We need an architect who combines strategic thinking with practical engineering capability; someone who is equally comfortable defining an end-to-end architecture, exploring unfamiliar technologies, writing code, building prototypes, troubleshooting integrations and working directly with engineering teams to solve problems.
  
  
A key focus will be looking holistically across our technology estate, identifying opportunities to connect systems, simplify processes, establish reusable patterns, automate workflows and safely introduce AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will be naturally curious, adaptable and willing to work across different technologies and business domains. They will be comfortable operating outside their immediate areas of expertise, quickly developing an understanding of unfamiliar systems and taking a pragmatic, delivery-focused approach to engineering challenges.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Solution architecture and engineering
* Lead the design of secure, scalable, resilient and maintainable end-to-end solutions across CSE's diverse application and technology portfolio.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Business Analysts, engineers and other architects to understand functional and non-functional requirements and translate these into practical technical solutions.
* Define solution architectures spanning applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS, data, integrations, security and operational requirements.
* Apply strong software engineering principles to architectural decisions, ensuring solutions are technically sound, supportable and appropriate for their intended purpose.
* Remain actively involved throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing technical direction, resolving design challenges and supporting implementation.
* Take a hands-on approach where needed, including writing code, developing proof-of-concepts, evaluating APIs, testing integrations, troubleshooting technical issues and validating proposed solutions.
* Assess architectural trade-offs, balancing business outcomes, technical complexity, security, delivery timelines, cost and long-term maintainability.
* Work with delivery teams to estimate implementation effort, identify technical dependencies and determine the skills and resources required.
* Enterprise integration, simplification and automation
* Develop a holistic understanding of CSE's application landscape, including how systems interact, exchange information and support end-to-end business processes.
* Proactively identify opportunities to integrate applications, reduce manual processes, eliminate duplication and simplify the overall technology estate.
* Design and implement integration solutions using appropriate approaches, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging, data pipelines, middleware and other integration technologies.
* Establish and promote reusable integration patterns, common services and engineering standards that improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
* Evaluate opportunities to consolidate or retire redundant applications and capabilities, reducing operational complexity and technology costs.
* Support the development of connected enterprise workflows that span multiple platforms and business functions.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and implement automation opportunities, including scripting, workflow orchestration and system-to-system integration.
* Promote a build once, reuse where appropriate mindset, recognising that reuse may involve common design patterns, standards, components or technology.
* AI enablement and emerging technologies
* Identify practical opportunities to embed AI, intelligent automation and agent-based capabilities into enterprise applications and business workflows.
* Support the design and engineering of AI-enabled solutions, including integration with existing applications, enterprise data sources, APIs and workflow platforms.
* Understand and evaluate AI integration approaches such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent orchestration.
* Work with AI engineering, security, data and platform teams to ensure AI solutions are implemented safely, securely and in accordance with enterprise governance requirements.
* Consider data access, identity, permissions, privacy, auditability, human oversight and operational support when designing AI-enabled capabilities.
* Explore and validate emerging technologies through practical experimentation, proof-of-concepts and technical assessments.
* Ensure AI is applied to meaningful business problems rather than introduced as technology for its own sake.
* Technology standards, architecture governance and security
* Ensure solutions align with Corporate Technology and enterprise architecture principles, policies, technology standards and strategic roadmaps.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, security, privacy, infrastructure and other technology stakeholders to define and validate solutions.
* Identify architecture exceptions, technical risks and dependencies, recommending appropriate mitigations.
* Produce and maintain proportionate architecture documentation, including Solution Architecture Documents, system context diagrams, integration designs, data flows and deployment architectures.
* Present and defend architectural decisions at relevant governance forums, including Design Integrity Forums, Architecture Committees and Architecture Review Boards.
* Design solutions with security, resilience, performance, observability, disaster recovery, business continuity and operational supportability embedded from the outset.
* Promote standardised approaches and reusable engineering patterns while avoiding unnecessary complexity or governance overhead.
* Ensure solutions comply with the requirements of operating within a regulated financial services environment.
* Engineering collaboration and technical problem-solving
* Work directly with engineering teams across CSE, providing practical technical guidance, design support and assistance with complex engineering challenges.
* Be prepared to move between different initiatives, technologies and problem domains according to business and engineering priorities.
* Demonstrate a willingness to get hands-on with unfamiliar systems, investigate technical issues and contribute directly to solutions.
* Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews and solution evaluations where appropriate.
* Help engineers adopt good practices in software design, integration, security, automation, testing and operational readiness.
* Challenge unnecessary complexity, identify better ways of working and drive continuous engineering improvement.
* Build strong relationships across engineering capabilities, encouraging knowledge sharing, collaboration and reuse of successful technical approaches.
* Maintain awareness of evolving technologies, tools and architectural practices and assess their practical relevance to CSE.

Leadership responsibilities
  
  
**Individual Contributor – Senior Technical Leadership**

* Act as a trusted technical authority and engineering partner across CSE.
* Provide architectural leadership and technical direction without requiring formal line-management responsibilities.
* Influence technical decisions across multiple teams, projects and technology domains.
* Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing and practical collaboration.
* Demonstrate ownership, initiative and accountability for the successful implementation of solutions, not solely their design.

Critical deliverables
  
  
End-to-end solution architecture
  
  
Deliver solution designs appropriate to the scale and complexity of each initiative, including:
  
  

* Conceptual, logical and physical architecture.
* Application and system integration designs.
* Data flows and interface specifications.
* Security architecture, access controls and relevant configurations.
* Infrastructure, deployment and operational architecture.
* Non-functional requirements, including resilience, performance, monitoring, disaster recovery and business continuity.
* Technical risks, dependencies, architectural decisions and mitigations.

The role holder is accountable for the overall solution architecture and will collaborate with relevant Subject Matter Experts for specialist areas.
  
  
Practical engineering validation
  
  

* Proof-of-concepts, technical spikes or prototypes to validate architectural decisions where appropriate.
* Demonstrable assessment of integration feasibility, technical constraints and solution trade-offs.
* Practical technical support to engineering teams during implementation.

Technology integration and simplification
  
  

* Identified and delivered opportunities for improved application integration, automation and technology simplification.
* Adoption of common architecture patterns and reusable engineering approaches.
* Contributions towards application rationalisation and reduction of unnecessary technology complexity.

Architecture governance and delivery assurance
  
  

* Completion of required architecture reviews and approvals.
* Continued architectural involvement through implementation to ensure delivered solutions align with agreed designs and business outcomes.
* Effective transition into operational support, including consideration of service reliability and maintainability.

Impact
  
  
This role will influence the technical direction, integration and evolution of CSE's technology landscape.
  
  
The role holder will contribute directly to the quality, security, maintainability and efficiency of solutions delivered across the portfolio, influencing delivery cost, timelines, technical risk and operational complexity.
  
  
Beyond individual projects, the role will help establish a more connected, simplified and automated technology environment, enabling greater reuse, faster delivery and the safe adoption of emerging technologies, including AI.
  
  
Key KPIs
  
  

* Solution delivery: Architecture and technical design deliverables completed to agreed timelines, supporting successful project implementation.
* Engineering quality: Solutions meet agreed security, reliability, maintainability and non-functional requirements, with minimal avoidable architectural rework.
* Integration and automation: Demonstrable improvements in system connectivity, workflow automation and reduction of manual processes.
* Technology simplification: Contribution to application rationalisation, reduction in duplicated capabilities and elimination of unnecessary technical complexity.
* Standards and reuse: Increased adoption of agreed architectural patterns, reusable components and engineering standards.
* AI enablement: Practical contribution to the safe evaluation, design and implementation of AI-enabled solutions delivering measurable business value.
* Technical collaboration: Effective engagement with engineering teams, stakeholders and governance functions to resolve technical challenges and enable delivery.

Technical / job functional knowledge
  
  
Essential – Software engineering background
  
  

* Proven professional experience in software development or software engineering is mandatory. Candidates must have personally designed, developed, tested and delivered software solutions.
* Strong coding and scripting capability, with practical experience in one or more languages such as Python, Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript or equivalent.
* Ability and willingness to write, review, troubleshoot and understand code, rather than relying exclusively on engineering teams for technical implementation.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design principles, APIs, data structures, version control, testing, CI/CD and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience transitioning from hands-on software engineering into broader solution architecture or technical leadership responsibilities.

**Essential – Broad Architecture And Technology Experience**

* Experience architecting and delivering solutions across multiple applications, platforms and technology environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application integration, including REST APIs, authentication, messaging, middleware, event-driven integration and data exchange patterns.
* Practical knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly Azure and/or AWS, including cloud-native services, networking, identity and security.
* Experience with SaaS applications and integrating cloud-hosted services with existing enterprise systems.
* Understanding of relational databases, SQL, data modelling and data integration approaches.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and service-to-service authentication.
* Understanding of infrastructure, networking, security, performance, availability, disaster recovery and business continuity.
* Experience designing solutions in complex enterprise environments with multiple dependencies and technology constraints.
* Ability to evaluate unfamiliar technologies, understand their architecture and determine suitable integration and implementation approaches.
* Strong understanding of security-by-design and operational supportability.

Desirable – AI, automation and emerging technology
  
  

* Practical experience integrating AI or LLM-based services into applications and enterprise workflows.
* Knowledge of AI architecture patterns, including RAG, MCP, tool calling, agent-based workflows and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Experience with AI platforms or services such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with workflow automation, orchestration platforms and low-code/no-code technologies, including Microsoft Power Platform or equivalent.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, containers, serverless technologies and modern cloud engineering practices.
* Experience designing reusable integration services, API gateways and enterprise automation solutions.
* Exposure to application modernisation, on-premise-to-cloud migration, SaaS onboarding and technology rationalisation.

**Candidates are not expected to have deep expertise in every technology listed. Breadth of technical understanding, strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability and the ability to learn new technologies are more important than specialist knowledge of any single platform.**
Business and sector expertise
  
  

* Experience working with business stakeholders across corporate functions such as HR, Finance, Procurement, Facilities, Risk, Compliance or other enterprise services.
* Understanding of how enterprise applications support business operations, including the importance of data integrity, integration, workflow efficiency and operational resilience.
* Ability to translate business challenges into pragmatic technical solutions and identify opportunities for simplification and automation.
* Experience communicating and advising senior stakeholders, including Head-of-Function level.
* Experience delivering technology solutions within complex, regulated or security-conscious enterprise environments.
* Appreciation of commercial considerations, including licensing, operational costs, vendor dependencies and total cost of ownership.

Leadership and management experience
  
  

* Experience providing technical leadership as a Solution Architect, Technical Lead or Senior Software Engineer on projects and programmes.
* Demonstrable ability to influence technical direction and engineering decisions across multiple teams.
* Experience collaborating with architects, developers, platform engineers, security specialists and business stakeholders.
* Ability to balance strategic architectural considerations with practical engineering and delivery needs.
* Willingness to challenge existing approaches constructively and propose simpler, more effective alternatives.

**Personal Skills And Capabilities**

title: Senior ServiceNow Architect
description:
**Company Description**
StrikePath AI is a mission-driven firm focused on turning enterprise AI ambitions into measurable business impact. Operating as one unified team with Mission AI Consulting, the company combines global delivery scale with deep, hands-on enterprise experience.

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect: a seasoned, independent platform authority who has seen enterprise ServiceNow programs succeed and fail, knows the difference, and can be placed on our most complex client engagements with confidence. If you bring 8+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, deep platform architecture and integration expertise, and the judgment to shape platform strategy at the executive level, your next mission is waiting. Follow StrikePath AI on LinkedIn to stay ready for upcoming opportunities.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time role for a Senior ServiceNow Solutions Architect. You will own the end-to-end technical vision of complex, multi-module and multi-instance ServiceNow engagements, operating with a high degree of autonomy and minimal day-to-day oversight. You will be the senior technical voice with the client: setting platform strategy, assessing the health and technical debt of existing instances, defining solution architecture and integration approach, and guiding delivery teams to scalable, secure, upgrade-safe outcomes. We expect you to be hands-on where it matters, and to lead and mentor where it counts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Architecture & Solution Design**

* Define and own the end-to-end ServiceNow architecture, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
* **Design across multi-module and multi-instance landscapes (ITSM, ITOM, SPM, SecOps, ITAM/HAM/SAM, HRSD, CSM, or others), with a strong command of the CMDB, CSDM, and the platform data model.**
* **Establish architectural standards, design patterns, and reference architectures for scoped applications, workflows, business rules, UI policies, client scripts, ACLs, notifications, and integrations.**
* **Make and defend sound build-versus-buy and out-of-the-box-versus-custom decisions, balancing client needs against long-term maintainability.**
* **Apply ServiceNow's AI platform capabilities, including Now Assist and AI Agent Studio, to design practical Agentic AI use cases for clients.**

**Integration & Hands-On Technical Leadership**

* Define integration architecture across REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, and event-driven interfaces, including authentication, error handling, scalability, and API governance.
* **Remain hands-on: build proofs of concept, review code and configuration, resolve critical design and performance issues, and set the technical bar for the team using Flow Designer, Glide scripting, and custom logic.**
* **Oversee testing strategy, guide UAT cycles, and ensure alignment with ServiceNow best practices and platform performance standards.**

**Platform Strategy & Client Advisory**

* Partner with client executives and technical leaders to align platform strategy, roadmap, and instance strategy with organizational goals and licensing realities.
* **Lead requirement and architecture workshops, offering both tactical and strategic guidance, and serve as the senior technical point of contact and trusted advisor throughout the engagement.**
* **Manage client expectations on scope, risk, and trade-offs; raise issues early with clear options and recommendations; and support pre-sales, estimation, and SOW development where needed.**

**Technical Debt, Governance & Platform Health**

* Assess existing instances for technical debt, including customization sprawl, upgrade blockers, data quality issues, and integration fragility. Quantify the impact and deliver a prioritized remediation roadmap.
* **Establish and enforce technical governance, design authority, and release management practices.**
* **Champion platform health, manageability, and upgrade readiness, minimizing technical debt and custom scope creep on every engagement.**

**Delivery Leadership & Team Enablement**

* Own solution delivery across the full project lifecycle, working independently and driving complex work to completion.
* **Mentor architects, developers, and technical consultants, and partner with functional consultants, project managers, and stakeholders to ensure successful implementations.**
* **Develop high-quality architectural documentation including solution blueprints, integration designs, test plans, and deployment guides.**

**Qualifications**

* **Experience**
  : 8+ years of hands-on experience on the ServiceNow platform, with a proven record as a lead or principal architect on enterprise implementations.
* **Platform Architecture**
  : Deep expertise designing and architecting enterprise ServiceNow solutions across multi-module and multi-instance environments, including CMDB/CSDM, scoped application design, security and ACL models, and performance and upgrade considerations.
* **Hands-On Integration**
  : Demonstrated, hands-on experience designing and building integrations using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub, MID Server, and event-driven patterns. Strong command of JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, and platform design patterns.
* **Platform Strategy**
  : Track record of defining platform roadmaps, instance strategy, and governance models that align with business goals and keep the platform healthy as it scales.
* **Technical Debt Management**
  : Proven ability to assess an existing platform, identify and quantify technical debt, and lead remediation without disrupting the business.
* **Client Management**
  : Strong executive presence and experience managing client relationships, facilitating workshops, setting expectations, and acting as the trusted technical advisor on high-visibility engagements.
* **Independence**
  : Self-directed and accountable. You can be placed on a complex project, quickly find your footing, and drive it forward with minimal supervision.
* **Leadership**
  : Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical teams and own solution delivery across the full project lifecycle.
* **Certifications**
  : Active ServiceNow CSA and CAD certifications, plus 2–4 active ServiceNow CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist) certifications across one or more product areas.
* **Communication**
  : Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders, up to the executive level.
* **Delivery Methods**
  : Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) strongly preferred. CMA (Certified Master Architect) certification is also highly valued.
* **Experience in a consulting or partner firm environment, leading multiple concurrent client engagements.**
* **Hands-on experience with Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, or other Agentic AI capabilities on the ServiceNow platform.**
* **Experience leading platform health checks, instance consolidation, or upgrade and migration programs.**

description:

* Experience with distributed messaging middleware or event-streaming systems

* Programming experience in Python or C++
* Experience developing LLM-based or agentic tools and automation frameworks

* Cloud architecture certification(s) — AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Platform Engineering to lead the strategy, engineering, and operations of a scalable enterprise platform supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.

The ideal candidate will enable application and data engineering teams through self-service infrastructure, standardized delivery workflows, and a strong developer experience, supporting finance transformation solutions across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own the platform engineering roadmap, delivery governance, and team development, partnering with product, architecture, security, and business leaders to improve engineering productivity and deliver measurable business outcomes across client engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Technology & Architecture Leadership**

* Own the platform engineering strategy and architecture roadmap, aligning cloud infrastructure, shared services, and modernization priorities with business and product goals.
* Lead the design and evolution of secure, resilient cloud-native platforms, including container orchestration, networking, identity, secrets management, and standardized environments.
* Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and automated guardrails for consistent provisioning and operation of platform services.
* Enable application, data, and AI/ML workloads through reusable platform capabilities, APIs, integration patterns, and scalable compute and storage services.
* Own CI/CD and release engineering capabilities, including automated testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment strategies, and rollback readiness.
* Provide technical leadership for critical incidents, architectural reviews, and complex engineering decisions; drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions.

**Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Lead delivery planning and governance across platform workstreams, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and commitments against agreed business outcomes.
* Embed agile, DevOps, and SRE practices, including service ownership, observability, on-call readiness, incident response, and tested disaster recovery.
* Define and track service-level indicators and objectives, agreed SLAs, and engineering delivery metrics to improve reliability, deployment performance, and recovery times.
* Drive capacity planning, performance optimization, and FinOps practices; manage platform budgets and vendors to improve cost efficiency without compromising reliability.
* Partner with security and governance teams to embed access controls, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection, and compliance requirements into platform operations.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale multidisciplinary platform engineering teams spanning cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, and automation; develop engineering managers and technical leads.
* Build a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
* Own workforce planning, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with the platform roadmap.
* Coach managers and engineers on technical judgment, execution discipline, stakeholder engagement, and career growth; delegate effectively while maintaining accountability.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with product teams, enterprise architects, security leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, and clients to translate business needs into platform priorities.
* Balance platform investment, delivery capacity, risk, and business value; align stakeholders on trade-offs, service expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Support solutioning, proposals, and client discussions with platform architecture, delivery estimates, operating models, and cost considerations.
* Communicate roadmap progress, investment needs, service health, delivery risks, and business impact clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Platform & Product Mindset**

* Manage the platform as an internal product, using developer feedback and adoption metrics to prioritize capabilities that reduce friction and accelerate delivery.
* Build self-service workflows, reusable infrastructure modules, service catalogs, and standardized delivery paths with clear documentation and onboarding.
* Measure platform value through adoption, developer satisfaction, onboarding time, delivery lead time, and reduced operational toil; enable secure analytics and AI use cases.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE, including substantial architecture and delivery ownership.
* 5+ years of engineering people-management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading multiple teams and developing engineering managers or technical leads.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity, security, resilience, and cloud operating models.
* Strong expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform), and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and automation using relevant tools and languages (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Python, or Go).
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and shared platform services; experience enabling data platforms and integration workloads.
* Experience with secure-by-design engineering, identity and access management, secrets management, software supply-chain security, and enterprise governance.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to deliver enterprise platform programs, manage cross-team dependencies, and establish effective execution and risk governance.
* Experience implementing DevOps and SRE practices, including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident reviews, and disaster recovery testing.
* Strong understanding of scalability, capacity planning, performance tuning, cloud cost optimization, budget ownership, and vendor management.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and application needs; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, analytics platforms, or other data-intensive enterprise products is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

title: System Architect (EW Systems)
description:
Job Description- System Architect (EW Systems)
 

About Us
 

We are a group of young and enthusiastic engineers, domain experts providing turnkey solutions to challenging requirements in Signal Processing. We work on leading technologies in Signal Processing solving problems in Defence and Aerospace fields. Our solutions range from tactical radios to radars, and from research to mission critical applications.
 

About the role
 

As a System Architect, you will own the end-to-end architecture of our Electronic Warfare products — ESM/ELINT receivers with direction finding, emitter geolocation and electronic attack capability. You will translate customer requirements into a coherent system design spanning antennas, RF front ends, digital receivers, signal processing and software, and act as the technical authority across RF, FPGA, software and mechanical teams from concept through qualification and field trials.
 

Responsibilities 
 

**Requirements & System Definition**

 

* Translate customer QRs/GSQRs and specifications into System Requirement Specifications (SRS), architecture documents, ICDs and a requirements verification matrix.
* Define system-level performance budgets: sensitivity, instantaneous bandwidth, dynamic range, probability of intercept, DF accuracy and geolocation error.
* Conduct architecture trade studies covering size, weight, power, cost, performance and risk, and justify design decisions to internal and customer stakeholders.

**Hardware/Software Partitioning & Integration**

 

* Partition functionality across RF, RFSoC/FPGA, embedded processors and host software; select ADC/DAC and processing platforms (Zynq RFSoC, Versal).
* Define high-speed data and control interfaces (JESD204, PCIe, 10/40G Ethernet) and the system timing and synchronisation scheme.
* Define antenna, RF front-end and platform interfaces for airborne, naval and ground installations.
* Guide integration across RF, FPGA, software and mechanical teams and resolve cross-domain technical issues.

**Verification, Qualification & Reviews**

 

* Define the system test strategy, acceptance test procedures and test-bed requirements in coordination with the system test team.
* Plan MIL-STD-810 (environmental) and MIL-STD-461 (EMI/EMC) qualification, and JSS 55555 where applicable.
* Lead PDR/CDR and technical reviews with DRDO labs, DPSUs, the Services and certification/quality agencies (CEMILAC, DGAQA) as applicable.
* Own architecture-level technical risk and support cost and schedule estimation for proposals and programmes.
* Mentor engineers and set design and documentation standards across the team.

 

**Qualifications**

 

**Required**

 

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering or a closely related field.
* 12+ years in EW, ESM/ELINT, radar or SIGINT system development, with at least 4–5 years owning system-level architecture end to end.
* Strong command of receiver architecture and analysis: cascade noise figure, linearity, dynamic range, spur budgets and frequency planning.
* Hands-on knowledge of DF techniques and emitter geolocation.
* Working knowledge of digital receiver and signal processing architectures on FPGA/RFSoC platforms.
* Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for system modelling and performance analysis.
* Familiarity with MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461 and JSS 55555, and with the defence design review process (PDR/CDR).
* Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and to produce and defend technical documentation with customers.
* Indian citizen, eligible for security clearance.

 

**Preferred**

 

* M.Tech / M.S. or Ph.D. in RF/Microwave, Communication or Signal Processing.
* Experience delivering to DRDO labs, DPSUs (HAL, BEL) or the Services, or through iDEX programmes.
* Experience with DRFM-based electronic attack systems and false-target generation.
* Exposure to airborne platform integration and airworthiness certification.

Employee status and commitments
 

* Permanent full-time role based at our Hyderabad office with often onsite client visit.
* Overtime may be required to ensure client projects to be delivered on time.
* Weekend work is rare but can occasionally be necessary.

Why join US?
 

* **Culture of Excellence:**
  We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* **Opportunities for Growth:**
  We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:**


  Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* **Innovative Environment:**


  Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of EW and signal processing technology.

As part of our global digital health and diagnostics initiatives, our product squads build complex, large-scale software solutions. Quality Engineering is not just a final check—it is a core pillar of our product strategy, ensuring safety, reliability, and unparalleled user experience.

As an Expert SDET, acting as a Solution Architect, specialized in Open Source Test Automation, you will operate as a strategic domain authority across multiple cross-functional product squads within a specific domain. You will sit at the intersection of business strategy, software architecture, and quality engineering. You are accountable for designing robust, open-source automation frameworks, handling ambiguous quality requirements, managing complex stakeholder landscapes, and mentoring junior engineers. * Test Automation Architecture Definition & Governance

Establish reusable architectural components and design patterns for the Test Automation Quality Engineering practice
* Technology Fit Analysis: Evaluate, select, and govern the implementation of all new testing tools and infrastructure components to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards. * Requirement Synthesis: Elicit, analyze, and synthesize complex, sometimes ambiguous stakeholder needs regarding software quality, usability, and data integrity
* Traceability: Ensure comprehensive test and quality requirements traceability across solutions
* Impact Evaluation: Evaluate how changes in scope impact overarching software quality and map out immediate and long-term implications within the product domain

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You’ll Do**

We are seeking a strong technology leader as Director role to lead the strategy, development, and operation of Teradata Active Compute cloud platform. This leader will be responsible for building a highly scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient compute foundation for enterprise analytics, AI/ML, and data workloads across multiple public clouds.

Our cloud product is an enterprise-grade Teradata cloud data warehouse/analytics platform. We call it the active compute platform, which runs on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and is aimed at large, mission-critical workloads where predictable performance, governance, security, and workload management matter. Typical workloads include Enterprise data warehousing, Business intelligence and reporting, Large-scale SQL analytics, Customer/marketing analytics, Financial and operational analytics, Production ML/AI workloads, and Mixed workloads that need strong workload management.

Teradata improved its product portfolio and introduced additional compute capabilities as part of its newer Autonomous Knowledge Platform / Teradata Cloud architecture. The key idea is to have two different kinds of compute in the same governed environment rather than forcing every workload into one compute model. The product is intended for workloads that need to be available continuously and have predictable performance.

The leader we are looking for needs to help Teradata position itself not merely as a cloud data warehouse, but as an enterprise compute/data/AI platform where production and experimental workloads can coexist without compromising either performance or cost control.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the technical strategy and roadmap for Teradata Cloud Platform.
* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for compute orchestration, provisioning, scaling, workload management, reliability, and observability.
* Deliver a seamless experience across always-on production workloads and elastic, on-demand workloads.
* Drive cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Partner closely with Product, AI/ML, Data, SRE, and Customer teams to translate business and customer needs into platform capabilities.
* Establish strong standards for performance, availability, security, and cloud economics/FinOps.
* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization and leadership team.
* Define and track platform SLOs, operational metrics, customer adoption, and unit economics.
* Leverage AI, including agentic development approaches, to accelerate engineering velocity, improve developer productivity, and drive rapid innovation across the platform.
* Maintain a strong execution focus, drive accountability and timely delivery of results, and think outside the box to solve complex technical and business challenges.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* 10+ years of experience in software, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or data platforms, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations.
* Proven experience building and operating large-scale, multi-tenant cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of distributed databases, compute/storage separation, Kubernetes, orchestration, autoscaling, and workload management.
* Experience with both always-on production systems and elastic/serverless compute architectures.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, AI/ML, and cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to connect deep technical strategy with product direction, customer value, and business outcomes.
* Experience across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP preferred.
* Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools, agentic AI, or AI-driven engineering workflows to accelerate software development, increase engineering productivity, and enable rapid innovation.
* A strong track record of execution, with the ability to turn strategy into measurable outcomes, challenge conventional thinking, and develop creative solutions to complex problems. This is a hard requirement.

The ideal leader we are looking for is a hands-on technical leader who combines deep distributed systems expertise with strong product and organizational leadership. They should be comfortable operating at the architecture level while also building teams, managing execution, and shaping the long-term strategy for enterprise cloud compute. This leader must embrace AI-driven development as a catalyst for engineering velocity and innovation, while fostering a results-oriented culture that encourages creative thinking, experimentation, and continuous improvement

title: Open Source Program Office
description:
Open Source Program Office

About the role

Citizens Bank: Open Source Program Office (OSPO), part of Enterprise Technology, is hiring a

Senior Software Engineer to modernize and automate the open-source governance and

vulnerability management processes at the bank.

The OSPO sets and enforces policies for open source components, packages, libraries and

services used across the bank. Today, developers handle too much of that work manually. You

will help build the automation, integrations and decision logic that let application teams get

compliant answers quickly, so security and licensing risk falls while delivery speeds up. You will

work with application teams, Information Security, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture.

Automate governance workflows

 Partnering with our Legal, Risk, and DevSecOps stakeholders, design and build

integrations among Sonatype, ServiceNow, GitHub, Jenkins and Harness that replace

manual review, ticketing and approval steps.

 Build self-service tools, APIs and CI/CD pipeline plug-ins that give developers policy

feedback early, in the IDE, pull request or build, rather than at release.

 Automate onboarding and offboarding of applications, repositories and policies in

governance tooling.

Streamline waivers and exceptions

 Create an automated waiver process: intake, risk-based routing, approval, expiry and re-

evaluation, with an audit trail.

 Define and encode the rules under which a waiver is granted automatically (for example,

no reachable vulnerable code path, compensating controls in place, low-risk usage

context) in partnership with InfoSec and Risk.

Evaluate components more intelligently

 Build logic that combines vulnerability data, reachability analysis, exploit intelligence

(such as EPSS and KEV), license and contract terms, ISBIA evaluations, project health

and deployment context into a clear risk decision.

 Reduce false positives and unblock application teams by separating theoretical findings

from exploitable ones.

 Automate triage of newly disclosed vulnerabilities, license changes and end-of-life

components across the bank's application inventory.

Enable developers and report on the program

 Write clear documentation, templates and golden-path guidance, and support teams

adopting them.

 Build dashboards and metrics on policy compliance, waiver volume, time to resolution

and risk trends for leadership and audit.

 Support software bill of materials (SBOM) generation, ingestion and analysis

(CycloneDX, SPDX), and contribute to regulatory and audit readiness.

 Mentor engineers and set engineering standards for the OSPO's code, testing and

operations.

What you bring

 6+ years of software engineering experience (or equivalent), including 3+ years building

automation, platform or developer-experience tooling at senior level.

 Strong programming skill in Python, Java, or Go, with experience designing and

consuming REST APIs and webhooks.

 Hands-on experience with software supply chain or application security tooling, such as

Sonatype (Nexus IQ, Lifecycle, Repository), or comparable SCA tools (Snyk, Black

Duck, Mend, Dependency-Track).

 Working knowledge of open source licensing (permissive versus copyleft) and how

license obligations affect enterprise use.

 Experience building CI/CD integrations in Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions or similar,

including policy gates and quality checks.

 Experience automating workflows in ServiceNow (Flow Designer, REST integrations)

and Microsoft Power Automate or comparable low-code platforms.

 Understanding of vulnerability management concepts: CVE/CVSS, exploitability,

reachability, SBOMs and remediation prioritization.

 Ability to turn ambiguous policy into precise, testable rules, and to explain risk decisions

to developers, security staff and auditors.

 Clear written and verbal communication, and a track record of working across

engineering, security, legal and risk teams.

 Bachelordegree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: Systems Software Principal Engineer
description:
**Systems Software Principal**
**Engineer**
Attract, develop & engage a world-class workforce
  
  
For more than 30 years, TTEC has anticipated customer needs and stayed ahead of consumer demands. As the leading global provider of technology-enabled customer experience solutions, TTEC designs, enables, manages, and grows superior customer experiences that drive shareholder value. Simply put, we help companies grow the value of their business by growing the value of their customer base. From design to delivery, our comprehensive solutions create value across the entire customer life cycle with industry-specific services.
  
  
**Our Capabilities Include**

* Design: Customer Strategy Services
* Enable: Customer Technology Services
* Manage: Customer Management Services
* Grow: Customer Growth Services

**Position Summary**
The Systems Software Principal Engineer provides enterprise-level technical leadership for TTEC’s core systems, identity, messaging, endpoint, automation, and infrastructure platforms. This role owns architectural direction, lifecycle strategy, modernization roadmaps, platform resilience, and engineering standards for services that support a highly distributed global environment. The Principal Engineer defines reference architectures, guides security-by-design practices, influences cross-functional technical decisions, and provides Tier 4 escalation support for the most complex service reliability and platform issues. This role partners across Infrastructure, Information Security, Networking, Operations, and business technology teams to align technical strategy with enterprise outcomes while mentoring senior engineers and raising the overall maturity of engineering practices.
  
  

* Enterprise directory services, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, PKI, clustering, and domain services architecture
* Endpoint and systems management, including Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Tanium, PowerShell, and automated deployment practices
* Identity and access management, including hybrid identity, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Ping, Okta, privileged access, and identity governance
* Cloud and hybrid platform integration, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Cloud Platform, and on-premises Active Directory
* Messaging and collaboration platforms, including Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, and Google Workspace
* Security, audit, and compliance programs, including FedRAMP, PCI, CAP, HIPAA, SOX, vulnerability management, patching, monitoring, and reporting
* Storage, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery platforms, including Cohesity, NetApp, replication, recovery validation, and service continuity planning
* Virtualization and platform infrastructure, including Nutanix, VMware, Hyper-V, high availability, capacity planning, and service reliability engineering

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own enterprise architecture, technical strategy, and lifecycle direction for highly distributed systems, identity, endpoint, messaging, and infrastructure platforms
* Define and maintain reference architectures, engineering standards, governance models, and technical patterns that promote consistency, resilience, security, and operational excellence
* Provide Tier 4 escalation support for the most complex Windows, identity, messaging, endpoint, cloud integration, and platform reliability issues
* Lead modernization initiatives across legacy and hybrid platforms, including automation strategy, platform rationalization, cloud integration, and lifecycle risk reduction
* Establish automation, scripting, and repeatable engineering practices using PowerShell and related tooling to improve reliability, speed, compliance, and operational efficiency
* Drive security-by-design practices across platform architecture, change design, access control, vulnerability remediation, compliance readiness, and customer data protection
* Partner with Information Security, Networking, Operations, Application, and business technology teams to deliver integrated solutions that meet performance, compliance, security, and business continuity objectives
* Govern system changes, design reviews, release readiness, and operational handoffs in accordance with TTEC standards and enterprise change practices
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, support models, knowledge articles, and operational playbooks for Tier 1 through Tier 4 support teams
* Improve service reliability through monitoring, alerting, observability, capacity planning, incident trend analysis, problem management, and proactive risk mitigation
* Mentor senior engineers through architecture reviews, technical coaching, standards adoption, troubleshooting strategy, and knowledge sharing
* Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support for critical incidents, major escalations, and business-impacting platform events as required

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and progressive enterprise systems engineering experience
* 10+ years of progressive systems engineering experience supporting enterprise-scale Windows Server, identity, endpoint, messaging, cloud integration, and infrastructure platforms
* Expert-level knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, LDAP, ADSI, clustering, domain services design, and enterprise directory governance
* Expert-level experience with hybrid identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, endpoint management, Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, and enterprise access management practices
* Advanced scripting and automation experience using PowerShell and related tools to design, deploy, govern, and operate repeatable enterprise engineering solutions
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, IIS, Hyper-V, load balancing, LAN/WAN dependencies, shared storage, replication, and highly available platform design
* Demonstrated ability to design and govern high availability, disaster recovery, backup, recovery validation, monitoring, alerting, and service reliability practices
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, vulnerability management, privileged access, audit readiness, and regulatory frameworks including FedRAMP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, and related reporting obligations
* Experience defining architecture, technical standards, support models, operational documentation, and governance practices across enterprise platforms
* Strong working knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL, including incident, problem, change, configuration, and service continuity practices
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, lead technical decision-making, and translate ambiguous business or operational needs into scalable engineering outcomes
* Experience leading complex enterprise initiatives, mentoring senior engineers, coordinating customer-facing or internal projects, and driving outcomes across multiple technical teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert , Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, or equivalent credentials
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools and practices such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, configuration automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based change management

We are building the next generation of the platform: an AI-native case orchestration system that lets HR business teams automate routine work through configurable workflows and AI agent skills, so advisors and HR partners can spend their time on the moments that need human judgment.
  
  
We are a senior, engineering-driven team with a strong bias for ownership, deep customer empathy, and craft. We move fast, dive deep on hard problems, and treat AI as a first-class tool for reshaping how HR support gets delivered at Amazon scale.

**Preferred Qualifications**
