* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, Data Vault, hybrid modeling, and layered or medallion architecture patterns.
* Experience defining canonical keys, managing loosely typed source data, implementing deduplication, and preventing join fanout across related business domains.
* Expertise in ETL/ELT architecture and data pipeline development, with familiarity with dbt, Airflow, dbt Cloud, or native Snowflake Tasks.
* Experience integrating Salesforce CRM, market data feeds, third-party data sources, APIs, files, and streaming data into Snowflake.
* Understanding of Commercial Real Estate data domains, including property, building, lease, availability, sales, brokerage, valuations, capital markets, and property management.
* Experience integrating Snowflake with PostgreSQL, BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker, and application technologies such as Streamlit and React.
* Knowledge of geospatial data enrichment, property coordinates, and geocoding workflows.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture, RBAC design, segregation of duties, PII protection, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and CCPA.
* Experience with Snowflake network policies, PrivateLink, External Access Integrations, secure connectivity, and egress controls.
* Hands-on experience with Git-based deployment, Terraform or equivalent IaC tools, schemachange, dbt, and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
* Experience with environment promotion, release and rollback strategies, test-data cloning, operational monitoring, and alerting.
* Strong knowledge of at least one cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure, including storage, networking, virtual machines, identity, and key management services.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker; experience with Snowpark Container Services is an advantage.
* Experience enabling semantic layers, natural-language querying, governed LLM access, and AI-powered analytics is desirable.
* Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex, feature-store architecture, machine learning data-access patterns, and agent-aware security controls is an advantage.
* Demonstrated architectural leadership, including design reviews, reference architecture development, standards enforcement, and mentoring data engineers.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across business, data, security, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain architecture decisions, security controls, and cost-performance trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgment in resolving ambiguous requirements, assessing risks, and recommending practical solutions.
* Demonstrated delivery management skills, including the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, and timelines across distributed teams.
* Relevant Snowflake, cloud architecture, or data engineering certifications are preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end Snowflake platform architecture, including account and organization topology, databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, and development, UAT, and production environments.
* Design and implement scalable data architecture and layered data models, including raw, staging, curated, and semantic layers for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) domains such as property, lease, availability, sales, organization, and contact.
* Define semantic views and semantic models that expose governed, business-friendly data for BI reporting, natural-language querying, and LLM-powered analytics.
* Establish warehouse sizing, scaling, workload isolation, naming conventions, object ownership, and reusable architecture standards.
* Define dimensional, Data Vault, or hybrid data models and canonical join keys to ensure data consistency and prevent duplicate records and join fanout across property, lease, and sales domains.
* Lead ETL/ELT pipeline architecture for batch and streaming ingestion from Salesforce CRM, market data feeds, APIs, files, and third-party CRE data providers.
* Leverage Snowflake Dynamic Tables, Streams, Tasks, and Snowpark to implement transformations, incremental processing, and automated data workflows.
* Establish data engineering standards for data typing, casting, deduplication, data quality, and handling wide or loosely typed source tables.
* Design and implement Snowflake security architecture, including role-based access control (RBAC), role hierarchies, functional access roles, and segregation of duties.
* Implement data protection controls such as column-level masking, row access policies, object tagging, tag-based masking, sensitive-data classification, and auditing.
* Ensure compliance with GDPR, CCPA, client confidentiality requirements, and restrictions governing personally identifiable information (PII) and confidential deal data.
* Define network security, secure connectivity, egress controls, External Access Integrations, and secure data-sharing patterns.
* Design integration architectures between Snowflake, PostgreSQL, downstream applications, BI tools, and application layers such as Streamlit and React.
* Govern Secure Data Sharing and provider-consumer data exchange with brokers, partners, and external data providers.
* Oversee geospatial and market-data enrichment pipelines, including property coordinates and geocoding, while ensuring compliance with network and data security restrictions.
* Optimize Snowflake query performance using clustering keys, search optimization, partition pruning, and result and metadata caching.
* Establish FinOps practices covering warehouse auto-suspend and auto-resume, resource monitors, budget controls, credit consumption, and cost attribution by project or cost center.
* Define platform SLAs, monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and operational procedures, including tracking serverless compute costs.
* Enable AI-driven analytics and natural-language querying through governed semantic models and Snowflake Cortex where appropriate.
* Collaborate with data science teams to support feature stores, machine learning data access, and secure access to sensitive data attributes.
* Ensure LLMs and AI agents respect masking policies, row-level security, and appropriate access controls.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), Git-based deployment, and CI/CD practices for Snowflake objects and semantic models using Terraform, schemachange, dbt, or equivalent tools.
* Define environment promotion, test-data cloning, release management, rollback procedures, and deployment standards.
* Implement observability using Snowflake query history, Account Usage views, Information Schema, logging, and alerting, supported by operational runbooks.
* Own the Snowflake platform roadmap, evaluate new features and editions, and establish reference architectures and engineering standards.
* Act as the technical design authority by conducting architecture reviews, mentoring engineers, enforcing best practices, and guiding implementation decisions.
* Translate business requirements across brokerage, valuations, capital markets, and property management into scalable data platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with business, security, infrastructure, application, and data engineering teams to communicate architecture trade-offs, performance considerations, and cost implications.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: iCare Connect Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
We are an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.
  
  
Sanofi’s Digital organization’s mission is to transform Sanofi into a data-first and AI first organization by empowering everyone with good data. Through custom developed AI products built on world class data foundations and platforms, the team builds value and a unique competitive advantage that scales across our markets, R&D and manufacturing sites. The team is located in major hubs in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Cambridge, Bridgewater and most recently, Toronto, with the aim of opening a new office in Hyderabad. Join a dynamic, fast paced and talented team, with world class mentorship, using AI to chase the miracle of science
  
  
**About Growing With Us**
In this role you will
  
  

* Play a critical role in managing, supporting the iCare Salesforce Health Cloud Platform.
* Accountable for delivering Digital Patient Services Products and Solutions assisting Sanofi Patient Services functions.
* Leverages specialized, functional expertise for solving complex functional problems as individual or as team member.
* Leads and executes functional and technical expertise all along the lifecycle (plan, design, build, run) of Digital Patient Services leveraging Salesforce Health Cloud and managed packages.
* Provide solution guidance for highly complex business processes, regulatory (HIPAA, Data Privacy, GxP, etc.), compliance and cybersecurity processes. S/he will leverage the Digital portfolio, catalog of services, existing platforms as well as integrate new industry standards to define and implement the Patient Services products and services.

**About You**

* Lead the design of Patient Support Services (PSS) solutions for large programs, products, and projects.
* Acts as Authority and subject matter expert owing standards and practices related to Patient Services functional expertise in Salesforce.
* Work with team and fellow Engineers to track and align on solution built as part of different streams in the Program.
* Work as part of the Agile teams on large programs, governing, shaping the delivery of projects supporting design, architecture, enhancements, with focus on optimizing business processes, finding business and technical alignments across multiple therapeutic areas where possible.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design of Patient Support Services (PSS) solutions for large programs, products, and projects.
* Acts as Authority and subject matter expert owing standards and practices related to Patient Services functional expertise in Salesforce.
* Work with team and fellow Engineers to track and align on solution built as part of different streams in the Program.
* Work as part of the Agile teams on large programs, governing, shaping the delivery of projects supporting design, architecture, enhancements, with focus on optimizing business processes, finding business and technical alignments across multiple therapeutic areas where possible.
* Development & Customizations: Develop & review the complex solutions using Apex, LWC, Visualforce, triggers, flows & Omni Components and standard Salesforce features.
* Code reviews: Act as the health cloud expert, providing technical guidance, making technical decisions, and enforcing best practices.
* Build and maintain integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Streaming APIs, and middleware (IICS, AWS API GW, etc.).
* Work with architects to define integration patterns and data flow designs.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with business analysts and stakeholders to gather, refine, and translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Integration: Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems using APIs and web services.
* Quality & Performance: Conduct code reviews, unit testing, debugging, and ensure security, scalability, and data quality.
* Maintain unit test coverage (≥75%) and ensure reliable CI/CD deployments.
* Work with version control tools (Git) and DevOps platforms (Copado, Gearset, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
* Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior developers on the team.
* System Support & Enhancements: Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement fixes.
* Optimize performance, improve existing automations, and refactor legacy components.
* Stay updated on Salesforce releases and recommend improvements.

**Essential Skills & Qualifications**

* Salesforce Expertise: Strong knowledge of Health Cloud features, data models (patient/insurance), and core Salesforce.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Salesforce APIs, Triggers, Flow builder, OmniStudio and platform security.
* Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Understanding of provider/payer processes, US healthcare ecosystem, and compliance.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, problem-solving, leadership, and stakeholder management.
* Certifications: Salesforce Certified Developer I & II, Salesforce Health Cloud Certification

***Job Specific Skills, Competencies & Pruriency***

* Salesforce Technologies: Advanced
* Life Sciences/Patient Support Services expertise: Intermediate
* Application Design & Integration: Intermediate
* DevOps: Intermediate
* Compliance of computerized systems: Intermediate
* Lean & Agile practices: Intermediate
* Business Acumen: Intermediate
* Problem Solving: Intermediate
* Decision Making: Intermediate
* Critical Thinking: Intermediate
* Transversal collaboration: Intermediate

**Job Qualifications**

* Understanding of life sciences/pharma.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven experience as a senior developer / technical lead or in a similar role, with a strong background in software development or engineering.
* 7+ years of Software engineering and design experience with large scale business applications in a fast-paced iterative development environment.
* Strong experience with Agile based development, preferably with direct experience as Salesforce Engineer with specialization in Salesforce Technologies (Health Cloud, OmniStudio, Shield, Data Masking, Managed packages), Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD tools (AutoRABIT Release Manager and Vault/Copada/GearSets), Salesforce Managed Packages (Adobe E-sign, Service Cloud Voice, AWS Connect) a huge plus.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a strategic mindset.
* The candidate must be detailed oriented, customer driven, able to work well across time zones on a truly global team, and a team player.
* The ideal candidate will have experience providing consumer or patient facing technologies.
* Expected to carry out core accountabilities with minimal level of supervision for complex tasks and no supervision for more routine matters.
* Preferred experience with GxP, HIPAA and GDPR regulations.
* Demonstrate professional and reliable behavior on a consistent basis.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

When joining our team, you will experience
  
  

* An international work environment, in which you can develop your talent and realize ideas and innovations within a competent team.
* An attractive, market-oriented salary and cafeteria benefits.
* Flexible home office policy, with a possibility to work up to 60% of time from home / where you can easily schedule your office days.
* Work from an "Office of the Year 2020" finalist office.
* Collective life and accident insurance.
* Yearly medical check-up.
* Exposure to training and certification pathways for technical and functional skills from Salesforce products.
* An individual and well-structured introduction and training of new employees and we will dedicate a Buddy for you to better navigate in your first weeks.
* Your own career path within Sanofi. Your professional and personal development will be supported purposefully.
* Join a great community & special events (Monthly Board Game Nights, Summer Events, Well-Being Lectures & Sport Clubs)

Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary.
  
  
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.
  
  
At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Senior ECM Solution Architect [T500-30491]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Enterprise Content Management Solution Architect:**

The ECM Solution Architect defines secure, scalable and supportable end-to-end content management solutions aligned with the enterprise ECM strategy. The role covers solution architecture, requirements engineering, integration design, technical governance and delivery assurance across IBM and Box-based ECM platforms.

**Who we are (Zurich Enterprise Content Management – ZECM):**

Zurich is one of the world’s leading insurance groups, and one of the few to operate on a global basis. Our mission is to help our customers understand and protect themselves from risk. With about 55,000 employees serving customers in more than 170 countries, we aspire to become the best global insurer as measured by our shareholders, customers and employees. We help individuals, small and medium sized companies and global corporations around the world understand and protect themselves from risk by offering a wide range of insurance products, solutions and advisory services.

**ZECM provides our Business Partners with a reliable and comprehensive service for capturing, managing, storing, preserving and retrieving business content and documents that are key to their business functions. We offer two solutions:**

* ECMaaS: is a shared content services platform using primarily IBM Cloud Pack for Business Automation (CP4BA) and hosted in Capgemini Azure Cloud.
* ZBOX: is a shared content services platform based on Box SaaS
* We offer from Consulting Services, to Project execution and application maintenance for the above shared ECM platforms.

**Our opportunity:**

Within the Enterprise Content Management we produce value by offering global services to all those interested Business Units. We implement ECM projects usually with the help of some external vendors and our responsibilities cover a wide range of activities depending on the type of project.

As an ECM Solution Architect, you would be reporting to the ECM Lead Solution Architect performing one or more of the following tasks in each project.

* Perform the analysis of business requirements and translating them into solution requirements to ensure their implementation throughout the project life cycle, or review the proposed solution coming from our partners.
* Write or validate detailed design documents against those requirements and create the technical quality checks to ensure functional and non-functional requirements are met during project/s lifecycle.
* Identify deviations from the standards, enforce best practices and submit ideas and thoughts regarding projects or the whole platform.
* Share subject matter expertise to others in the organization or supporting others in their efforts to deliver (ECM Service Managers, ECM Project Managers, etc).
* Ensure compliance of the ECM Solutions with ECM Strategy, Group Operations & Technology Standards, customer project requirements and operational quality levels.
* Understanding and being able to apply different delivery approaches (Waterfall, SCRUM, Zurich Lean) and perform, independently, business analysis processes in accordance with Zurich Project Management Framework and the Zurich Risk Policy.
* Work with the AI teams and experts to align on best practices and quality / governance controls.

**Your role:**

As an ECM Solution Architect the role is focused on requirements & end-to-end ECM architecture solution definition within a project context across the lifecycle to support business process & IT system changes. The Key tasks include:

* Ensure that ECM Solutions are aligned to business needs and communicate the business benefits.
* Participate in the ECM Solution strategy, innovation areas and technology roadmap globally.
* Participate in the Solution Architecture Governance to ensure the assigned projects are compliant with the strategy and the group.
* Understand customer objectives, processes and products to make recommendations and proposals.
* Work with key stakeholders to understand the business requirements, existing systems and applications, and drive the ECM Solution for assigned projects.
* Balance the competing constraints of business need, services, technology and quality to produce the specified product, service or result with minimal change requests required.
* Produce requirement specifications if needed and outline solution design documents throughout the project life cycle.
* Perform quality review checks on project deliverables.
* Participate on solution portfolio rationalization and operational simplification and identify cost and service efficiencies.
* Apply consulting skills to facilitate decision making, resolve conflicts, and gain consensus and customer commitment.
* Ensure methodical delivery and continuous improvements in shared services
* Collaborate with global teams on strategy updates, planning, and investment prioritization.
* Own the end-to-end solution architecture from initial requirements and option assessment through detailed design, implementation assurance, operational readiness and post-implementation validation.
* In addition to architecture and governance responsibilities, the ECM team owns and evolves selected technical products, frameworks, accelerators and integration components. The Solution Architect is expected to contribute hands-on when appropriate by producing prototypes, reference implementations, API contracts, reusable patterns and technical enablers.

**Your Skills and Experience:**

**Required experience & certificates:**

* English fluent written and spoken.
* Experience to work in diverse, multi-cultural environments and to deal with ambiguity and changing/evolving requirements.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to communicate with both, business and technical stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

**Other desirable skills:**

* Other languages might be very valuable due to the distributed nature of the service.
* Good understanding of quality management and development methodologies are highly valuated.

**Technical skills:**

* Degree from a technical program, or a business-related degree with IT experience.
* +3 years as SME/Architect/Senior Developer in complex IT projects and landscape
* **Experience in Enterprise Content Management projects is highly valued, especially if the knowledge is tight to the following products:**
* IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation
* IBM FileNet Content Manager and its evolution towards IBM Content Cortex
* IBM Content Navigator
* Box.com
* Ability to work at multiple levels of abstraction, from enterprise and solution architecture to API definitions, configuration models, proof-of-concept development and review of critical implementation artefacts.
* Sufficient software-engineering knowledge to guide development teams, assess implementation quality, review critical code or configuration where required, and contribute to prototypes or reference implementations without becoming the primary developer for every initiative.
* Experience in Waterfall and Agile development framework, Scrum Master, tools and process is an advantage.
* Appreciated hands-on spirit and willingness to develop small things if required.
* Artificial Intelligence basic knowledge.
* Know how to leverage the usage of Microsoft 365 Copilot to speed up documentation review.
* Use AI tools to reinforce the quality of the deliverables such as Detailed Design documents, test cases, test plans, etc.
* Use the power of AI to cooperate with it and brainstorm on improvements for the platform.
* Claude or other AI technologies is appreciated as some developments might be part of the work.

**Soft Skills:**

* Positive attitude, strong communication (verbal and written) & interpersonal skills.
* Team player and able to create and work in a collaborative environment.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across all levels, including teams outside of shared services and solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor for the customer by having a holistic view of the different alternatives that would provide a solution to the customer/s.
* Ability to discuss technical topics in business terms, including but not limited to give presentations to an audience with different level of technological maturity.
* Ability to think outside of the box and be innovative by keeping abreast of new trends, identifying opportunities to bring in change for business benefit.

**Additional Information:**

**Our current technology stack includes, but is not limited to:**

* IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation
* IBM FileNet Content Manager and its evolution towards IBM Content Cortex
* IBM Content Navigator
* Box.com
* Microsoft Azure
* Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Services
* Microsoft Azure Event Hub
* Microsoft Azure Functions
* Bespoken developed and integrated products
* **Shift timings: 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST**

title: Senior Staff Solution Architect
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
ServiceNow is seeking a Sr Staff Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of scalable, intelligent, and high-impact solutions across the Connected Customer Experience portfolio. This is a senior-level, hands-on architecture role focused on enabling seamless digital workflows, integrating platform capabilities with AI/ML and data-driven insights, and ensuring technical excellence across customer-facing applications.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, platform, data, and AI teams to architect solutions that enhance user experience, deliver personalized customer journeys, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in enterprise SaaS architecture, CRM systems, solution design, AI/ML integration, and data platform engineering within Digital Technology (DT) environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect scalable, secure, and compliant end-to-end solutions integrating platform capabilities with intelligent data-driven features across customer experience applications.
* Define architecture patterns for workflows, integrations, platform extensions, and API-driven services that extend ServiceNow capabilities while ensuring alignment with security and platform standards.
* Lead evolution of architectural standards, evaluate tools and frameworks, and partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business requirements into technical designs.

**AI/ML & Data Platform**

* Architect AI/ML capabilities for personalization, recommendations, semantic search, and conversational AI with service layers that enable easy consumption by product teams.
* Design unified data architecture bringing together customer signals across touchpoints, including data lakes, warehouses, real-time pipelines, and analytical products.
* Establish governance frameworks for data quality, privacy, security, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA) while ensuring data readiness and pipeline integration.
* Define architecture for model observability, performance monitoring, and continuous learning feedback loops.

**Technical Strategy & Leadership**

* Define multi-year architectural roadmaps and lead architectural reviews, governance processes, and critical modeling decisions across product verticals.
* Translate complex designs into accessible, secure services ensuring observability, performance, and operational excellence while mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and foster a culture of technical excellence.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15+ years in enterprise software architecture, solution design, or technical leadership with significant CRM and enterprise SaaS platform experience.
* Proven track record designing production-grade solutions across customer service, digital workflows, CRM, or customer experience platforms.
* Deep expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, API-first design, cloud-native technologies, and security best practices.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML systems with hands-on experience in personalization, NLP/NLU, semantic search, or conversational AI.
* Experience with data platform architecture including data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), and data governance.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face), MLOps tools, and data processing tools (Spark, dbt, Airflow).
* Excellent communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders across cross-functional, matrixed global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ServiceNow platform and extending its capabilities through custom applications or intelligent services.
* Deep understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM) and their integration with customer experience ecosystems.
* Background in customer journey orchestration, personalized digital experiences, or recommendation engines in large-scale SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases for GenAI applications.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and experience in global, matrixed organizations.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role shaping customer experience architecture within one of the world's leading enterprise platforms.
* The opportunity to define architectural strategies for mission-critical applications serving millions of users.
* A collaborative, innovation-focused culture with organizational influence and visibility to senior leadership.

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The
**Technical Architect for Tableau Next**
is an execution-focused analytics architect and primary subject matter expert for the Tableau Next platform. You will design and deliver migrations from Salesforce CRM Analytics, Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, and legacy Tableau Server to a modern data stack. As the primary technical authority for this migration track, you will own the Tableau Next analytics platform architecture, legacy content migration strategy, and feature adoption roadmap.
  
  
Operating at the forefront of the modern data stack, you will architect scalable and secure solutions that bridge Data Cloud’s foundational architecture with Tableau Next. You will combine deep Analytics, Data 360, and Salesforce knowledge to ensure dashboards, data sources, permissions, and security structures are migrated with full fidelity, improved performance, and accelerated time-to-insight for business users.
  
  
You will use approved enterprise AI tools as an authorized input to relevant architecture, migration, analysis, and documentation work. You will validate AI-assisted outputs, test assumptions, protect sensitive information, and remain accountable for technical decisions, migration quality, and customer outcomes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  

* Tableau Next Platform Ownership: Act as the definitive technical authority for Tableau Next, leading the end-to-end transition of dashboards and reporting from Salesforce CRM Analytics, Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, and legacy Tableau Server.
* AI-Assisted Architecture and Migration: Use approved enterprise AI tools to support architecture documentation, legacy-to-target mappings, migration planning, test-case development, diagnostics, and technical communications. Apply expert judgment to validate outputs and preserve business logic, data fidelity, and platform compatibility.
* Security and Governance Architecture: Design and implement comprehensive data governance and security frameworks within the new architecture, enforcing policy-based data visibility and row-level security (RLS) to ensure strict, role-aligned data access.
* Human Accountability and Validation: Review AI-assisted recommendations, mappings, and analysis for accuracy, completeness, security, privacy, and alignment with approved architecture and governance standards before they inform delivery or customer decisions.
* Data Source Architecture: Architect the data source framework using Analytics, Data 360, and Salesforce knowledge to design live connections and optimized models tailored for Tableau Next.
* Data Ingestion and Engineering: Own and manage data ingestion directly within Salesforce Data Cloud to power the Tableau Next reporting layer.
* Semantic Layer Design: Design and build the semantic layer strictly within Salesforce Data Cloud to support all Tableau Next analytical requirements.
* Model Translation: Map and translate legacy BI semantic models into Data Cloud Calculated Insights and semantic models, using structured validation to confirm business logic equivalence.
* Data Lineage: Define end-to-end data lineage, ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved when migrating fields through Data Cloud transformation layers.
* Discovery and Strategy: Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client teams to assess legacy report complexity, usage analytics, and data source dependencies.
* Advisory: Serve as a Trusted Advisor to Analytics leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Tableau Next migration roadmap, self-service analytics vision, and data governance strategy.
* Migration Standards: Establish best-in-class standards for the migration practice, building reusable Tableau Next dashboard templates, Data Cloud connection frameworks, migration validation methods, and governance playbooks.
* Execution and Cutover: Plan and execute cutover strategies, including legacy BI deprecation, user access migration, and post-go-live enablement.
* Risk Mitigation: Identify and proactively mitigate technical risks related to data source credentials, calculated field logic parity, RLS re-implementation, extract refresh SLAs, data readiness, and AI-assisted migration outputs.
* Technical Communication: Translate architecture decisions, migration risks, data limitations, and validation findings into clear guidance for client teams, Analytics leaders, and Enterprise Architects.

**Strictly Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)**

* Tableau Next: Comprehensive, hands-on mastery of the Tableau Next platform, including advanced dashboarding, platform capabilities, and usage reporting.
* Salesforce Data Cloud Expertise: Deep technical understanding of data connections, data ingestion, Data Streams, Data Lake Objects (DLOs), Data Model Objects (DMOs), Data Governance, and Calculated Insights.
* Data Governance and Security: Proven ability to design and execute complex data governance models, specifically implementing policy-based data visibility and row-level security (RLS).
* Salesforce CRM Analytics: Proven experience and technical depth in CRM Analytics, formerly Einstein Analytics.
* Semantic Models: Advanced ability to design, build, and migrate semantic layers, specifically within the Salesforce Data Cloud architecture.
* Salesforce Administrator Knowledge: Deep understanding of Salesforce platform administration, security models, and user management.
* Salesforce Core Platform: Functional knowledge of at least one Salesforce Cloud, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Financial Services Cloud.
* AI-Fluent Technical Practice: Demonstrated ability to use approved enterprise AI tools or comparable authorized AI-assisted methods for role-relevant work products such as architecture documentation, migration mappings, test cases, diagnostics, or technical analysis, with human validation and accountability for the final result.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-Have)**

* Knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud One.
* Experience migrating from IBM Cognos, SAP Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Microsoft Power BI, Looker, or legacy Tableau Server to Tableau Next.
* Familiarity with Tableau Site and Governance Architecture, including project hierarchy, permission models, and content certification workflows.
* Understanding of broader cloud data platform integrations, including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, and Azure Synapse, as secondary analytical sources.
* Knowledge of dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar orchestration tools for upstream data pipeline dependencies.
* Familiarity with Tableau Embedded Analytics for migrating legacy embedded BI into external applications.
* Understanding of Tableau Bridge for on-premises data source connectivity.
* 10+ years of general experience in Business Intelligence, analytics, and data platform solutions.
* 5+ years of hands-on analytics development and architecture experience.

Certification Requirements
  
  
**Required Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Administrator
* Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant

**Highly Desired (Very Strong Plus)**

* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
* Tableau Desktop Specialist

**Nice to Have**

* Tableau Certified Architect
* Tableau Certified Data Analyst
* Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced
* Databricks Certified Associate Developer
* dbt Analytics Engineering Certification

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations

title: ServiceNow Senior Technical Consultant
description:
The ServiceNow Senior Technical Consultant with 7 - 10 year's experience will lead solution architecture, technical design, implementation governance, and complex platform delivery across the Now Platform. The role requires strong hands-on architecture capability across core platform development, integrations, security, data model design, scalable implementation patterns, and deep portal engineering experience across Employee Center and Customer Service Management portals, with a preference for candidates who hold ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA) credentials.

**What you will do:**

* Own end-to-end technical architecture for ServiceNow programs, including solution design, integration patterns, environment strategy, data architecture, security model, portal architecture, and deployment governance.
* Translate business and operating model requirements into scalable ServiceNow technical solutions across one or more product lines such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, SPM, IRM, or custom applications.
* Define and enforce platform standards for scripting, scoped app design, CMDB and data model integrity, API integrations, DevOps and CI/CD alignment, portal design patterns, and upgrade-safe extensibility.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for complex builds, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Script Includes, business rules, workspace and portal components, search experiences, and external system integrations.
* Lead technical design workshops, architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, and design authority forums with stakeholders, delivery teams, and customer leadership.
* Mentor developers, leads, and consultants on architecture patterns, engineering quality, portal design strategy, performance optimization, and secure development best practices.
* Identify risks, technical debt, and non-scalable customizations early, and steer delivery toward maintainable out-of-box aligned architecture decisions.

**Core technical skills**

* Deep expertise in Now Platform architecture, data model design, ACL and security architecture, domain separation considerations, update strategy, and integration design.
* Strong hands-on capability in JavaScript and ServiceNow server-side and client-side scripting, with working knowledge of HTML, CSS, REST, SOAP, and API-led integrations.
* Experience designing and governing enterprise integrations with cloud platforms, identity providers, observability tools, middleware, and line-of-business applications.
* Strong understanding of SaaS and PaaS architecture principles, multi-tenancy, automation, analytics, AI-adjacent platform capabilities, and enterprise architecture frameworks.
* Experience across multiple ServiceNow product lines beyond core ITSM, preferably including at least two or more of ITOM, CSM, HRSD, ITAM, SPM, IRM/GRC, or App Engine.
* Ability to balance out-of-box capability, configuration, and custom development while preserving upgradeability and long-term platform health.

**Employee Center and CSM portal expertise**

* In-depth knowledge of building and governing Employee Center experiences, including Unified Taxonomy, Curated Experiences, Dynamic Topic Pages, Mega Menu, My Active Items, Recommended for You, Popular Topics, Quick Links, and employee-centric search configuration.
* In-depth knowledge of building and governing CSM portals using Service Portal and Configurable Portal widgets, including page creation, widget configuration, Portal Data List, case-centric navigation, knowledge exposure, request experiences, and portal-specific access models.
* Ability to design when to use separate portals versus a unified experience, with clear understanding that Employee Center and Customer Service portals are separate portals with distinct URLs, access controls, and licensing implications.
* Strong experience in widget strategy, including using base widgets as-is, cloning widgets for controlled enhancement, and developing custom widgets only where required by experience, governance, or business differentiation.
* Expertise in building portal information architecture, including taxonomy-led multi-department navigation for Employee Center and siloed case-management journeys for CSM portals.
* Working knowledge of portal search configuration, knowledge surfacing, user criteria, content targeting, and performance considerations for high-traffic self-service experiences.
* Ability to define migration and coexistence strategies between legacy Service Portal implementations and Employee Center experiences, including widget reuse, cloning strategy, and content/taxonomy redesign.

**Portal-specific responsibilities**

* Architect employee self-service experiences that support multi-department discovery through taxonomy, dynamic pages, targeted content, and consolidated task visibility.
* Architect customer and partner self-service portals that prioritize case creation, case tracking, knowledge deflection, contextual lists, and configurable portal widgets.
* Establish standards for portal page models, widget reuse, naming conventions, content governance, search tuning, analytics, and extensibility.
* Guide teams on trade-offs between out-of-box Employee Center capabilities and custom Service Portal development for CSM or specialized service experiences.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* 7+ years of ServiceNow implementation, development, or architecture experience, including ownership of complex technical solution design and delivery.
* Proven experience acting as a technical lead, solution architect, or platform architect on enterprise-scale ServiceNow programs.
* Demonstrated success in designing complex solutions, custom applications, integrations, and self-service portal experiences across multiple systems and stakeholder groups.
* Hands-on experience with Employee Center and or CSM portal design, including portal information architecture, widgets, search, security, and content strategy.
* Strong client-facing consulting experience, including workshops, stakeholder communication, architecture presentations, and technical governance.

**Leadership & behavioral traits**

* Strong problem-solving ability with the judgment to simplify complex requirements into practical architecture decisions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative leadership style with the ability to mentor teams, influence design choices, and uphold engineering and portal standards across delivery streams.
* High accountability, delivery discipline, and comfort operating in ambiguous enterprise transformation environments.

**Certifications:**

Preferred

* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* ServiceNow Certified Master Architect (CMA)

Strongly desired

* Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Two or more Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications aligned to major product lines such as CSM, HRSD, or ITSM.
* Architecture Excellence accreditation, where relevant to current CTA pathway requirements.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Technical Team Lead – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning.
  
  
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad.
  
  
**Description Of The Area**
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Team Management**

* Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment
* Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work
* Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary.
* Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your team members

**Capability Development & Resource Management:**

* Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it
* Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution
* Manage the team's budget, including headcount, software/infrastructure operational costs, and vendor contracts, ensuring financial responsibility

**Technical Direction & Architecture:**

* Enable technical decision-making and design of robust, resilient, and highly available systems that integrate generative AI, multi-agent frameworks, RAG/GraphRAG pipelines, state machines, classical ML, and enterprise data ecosystems
* Establish robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal foundation models, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, and vector, graph and relational databases
* Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of RDT and Business functions, strictly following architectural patterns, standards, and data strategies established across the functions
* Identify areas of technical debt and perform pragmatic cost/benefit analyses for resolving this debt, ensuring optimal cloud resource and model inference cost-efficiency
* Establish and enforce rigorous enterprise standards for code, systems development, identity management, and authentication mechanisms across the team

**Agentic SDLC & Code Quality:**

* Ensure the team effectively leverages agentic Software Development Lifecycle workflows and tools daily (e.g., Claude Code, autonomous agents) to safely accelerate development and automated testing cycles
* Act as the technical standards keeper; perform or enable effective, rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code to maintain strict enterprise software engineering standards

**Compliance & Regulatory Alignment:**

* Oversee compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments, ensuring engineering deliverables are audit-ready and aligned with GxP compliance and Computerized System Validation (CSV)/Software Assurance (CSA) standards
* Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) to preserve validated infrastructure states

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Science, or a related field
* Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience in team leadership and people leadership in an agile product delivery environment, with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams
* Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience working in AI software development teams, with at least 5 years as a hands-on engineer or architect designing cloud-native solutions
* Regulated Domain Experience: Proven experience operating within a highly regulated environment (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical healthcare preferred) delivering validated applications
* Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior
* Possesses deep active listening and mentoring/coaching skills
* Demonstrates a leadership presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manage complexity
* Is a decisive leader, comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Brings an enterprise mindset that can break down silos, focusing on delivery through collaboration across organizational boundaries

**Technical Skills**

* AI & Orchestration Frameworks: Deep practical expertise in multi-agent system design, state machine logic, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph
* Classical Machine Learning: strong hands-on background in building applications driven by classical (pre-generative) Machine Learning and MLOps
* Core Programming: Production-grade mastery in advanced Python for backend/AI workloads and TypeScript for modern frontend interfaces and generative AI and classical ML UX/UI. Strong foundational understanding of modern full-stack development environments
* Data & Cloud Platforms: Strong architectural understanding of enterprise data platforms like Snowflake, vector databases (e.g., AWS OpenSearch), and graph databases (e.g., AWS Neptune)
* Cloud Engineering & DevOps: High proficiency overseeing AWS cloud architecture (including serverless workloads, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, etc.), managing fully automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
* AI Observability: Experience defining monitoring, logging, and telemetry strategies to track model drift, API/MCP health, resource utilization, and anomaly identification

* Strong stakeholder management skills to influence non-technical Senior Stakeholders on complex architectural designs
* Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures
* Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative , with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker, detail-oriented and highly organized
* Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary

Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).

A healthier future drives us to innovate. title: AI-Native Systems Builder
description:
We're looking for builders.
  
  
Not product managers. Not software engineers. Not AI researchers. People who happen to do all three when the problem demands it — because they care more about solving the problem than about which lane it falls in.
  
  
****What this role is****
Darwinbox is an enterprise HCM platform used by hundreds of large organizations across multiple countries. We're in the middle of a fundamental shift — rearchitecting the product and the company to be AI-native. Not adding AI features to an existing system. Rebuilding how the system thinks, operates, and delivers value.
  
  
This role exists because the most important work in that transformation doesn't fit traditional job boundaries. It sits at the intersection of product thinking, systems engineering, enterprise domain knowledge, and AI — and it requires people who can hold all of that in their head while shipping something that actually works.
  
  
You will take ambiguous, high-stakes enterprise problems and turn them into working systems. Some will be customer-facing product capabilities. Some will be internal operational systems. All of them will require you to think deeply about the realities of enterprise software — permissions, auditability, multi-tenancy, scale, configurability, edge cases — because that's where most "AI-powered" systems quietly break.
  
  
****What the work looks like****
You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem.
  
  
It might sound like: "Our customers can't tell whether their employees are actually using the platform — and neither can we." Or: "Implementation consultants spend 40% of their time on work that should be systematized." Or: "This workflow was designed for humans filling forms — redesign it for a world where AI handles 80% of the steps."
  
  
Your job is to go from that problem statement to a production system. You'll need to understand the business context, design the solution, build it (using AI-native development workflows extensively), validate it against real enterprise complexity, and iterate until it works — not in a demo, but at scale, with real customers, in production.
  
  
****Who thrives here****
People who build things outside of work — not because someone asked, but because they saw a problem and couldn't leave it unsolved.
  
  
People who use AI tools daily and have strong opinions about where they're transformative and where they're dangerous.
  
  
People who think in systems — who instinctively ask "what breaks downstream?" and "what happens at 100x scale?" and "what's the edge case no one mentioned?"
  
  
People who've shipped things. Not prototyped. Shipped. In environments where the user didn't forgive rough edges.
  
  
You might come from engineering, product, consulting, design, operations, or a path that doesn't have a clean label. We genuinely don't care about the label. We care about how you think, how you simplify, and what you've built.
  
  
****What we explicitly don't optimize for****

* Resume pedigree as a proxy for capability
* Interview performance on problems you'd never encounter here
* AI enthusiasm without AI execution
* Coordination-heavy profiles that produce slides instead of systems
* Prototype thinking without production realism

****Why this role exists****
Most companies hire PMs to write specs, engineers to execute them, and analysts to measure the outcome. Three roles, three handoffs, three points of context loss.
  
  
We're building a company where one person can hold the full arc — problem to system to outcome — because we believe that's how the best enterprise software gets built in the AI era.
  
  
If that sounds like how you already think, we should talk.

Hyderabad

HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.
  
  
You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.

:

title: Principal Architect
description:
**About The Role**
As a Principal Architect, you will be responsible for the architectural design and end-to-end implementation of a high-performance OLAP query engine and semantic layer. The primary goal is to develop a custom JSON-based query language (DSL) and a translation engine that converts these requests into optimized SQL for columnar databases. This role requires a deep understanding of systems programming, compiler theory, and multi-dimensional data modeling to serve high-concurrency read loads in a microservices environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
  
  

* Architectural Design & Query Execution

+ Compiler & DSL development: Design a custom JSON-based OLAP query language. Define eBNF grammars and build a translation layer to convert functional formulas and DSL requests into an optimized execution plan.
+ SQL generation & optimization: Implement and oversee the generation of highly optimized SQL tailored for columnar databases including ClickHouse, SingleStore, and DuckDB.
+ Semantic layer management: Architect the representation of multi-dimensional data models within columnar structures, ensuring efficient data retrieval and aggregation.
+ Custom function logic: Implement logic for custom functions, determining the optimal balance between SQL push-down and application-layer execution

* Caching & Performance Engineering

+ Multi-dimensional caching: Envisage and implement a distributed caching strategy for multidimensional data, utilizing shared memory systems like Redis.
+ Concurrency & scaling: Build and maintain high-performance microservices using Java (Micronaut or Spring Boot) with Project Loom (Virtual Threads) to handle massive concurrent read loads.
+ Low-level optimization: Manage system-level performance including connection pooling, array pooling, and off-heap memory management.
+ JVM tuning: Apply expert knowledge of Java Garbage Collectors (including ZGC and Shenandoah) to maintain low-latency response times.

* Engineering Excellence & AI Integration

+ AI-augmented development: Leverage AI coding agents and tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle, from prototyping to debugging.
+ Technical documentation: Maintain a disciplined approach to software development by documenting architectural decisions, design patterns, and technical specifications.
+ Technical leadership: Act as the primary technical authority on query engine internals, providing guidance on complex systems-level challenges.

**What We're Looking For**

* 15+ years in software engineering with a focus on backend systems and data infrastructure
* Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of compilers, ASTs, eBNF, and query planning
* In-depth understanding of SQL, query optimization, and the internal workings of columnar databases
* Expert proficiency in Java, specifically regarding multi-threading, asynchronous I/O, networking, and memory management
* Proven experience in designing distributed caching layers and managing state across microservices
* Ability to decompose complex data problems into scalable architectural components
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, with a strong tendency to document thoughts and architectural ideas
* A rigorous approach to software craftsmanship, including testing, telemetry, and performance benchmarking
* Minimum of 1 year of experience using AI coding agents to enhance development productivity
* Prior experience developing financial systems such as ERP, EPM, or General Ledger platforms is an added plus

**Why this Role**
You will own the internals of the query engine at the heart of a next-generation financial planning platform — the layer where compiler theory, columnar database performance, and multi-dimensional semantics converge.
  
  
**Why Planful**
To Foster The Best In Class Work We’re So Proud Of, We’ve Created a Best In Class Culture, Including
  
  

* 2 Volunteer days per year, Birthday PTO, and quarterly company Wellness Days
* 3 months supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave and generous parental leave
* Talkspace access and mental health support
* Annual company-wide gatherings held in cities like San Diego, Denver, Palm Springs, and Vegas!
* Office hubs in San Francisco, Toronto, and London. We also offer benefits such as home office setup, and monthly wifi and cell phone reimbursements for all employees, in-office or remote.

**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.

* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.

* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.

* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments.
