**Skill Set : NPU - Compiler Role**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly experienced Compiler / Software Architect to join our NPU Hardware Architecture team and play a key role in the hardware-software co-design of next-generation AI inference accelerators.

This is a unique role at the intersection of NPU hardware architecture, AI compilers, performance modeling, and software development. The position will work directly with hardware architects to define, evaluate, and prototype the software stack required to program current and future NPU architectures.

Our NPU architecture is closely coupled with the compiler stack. Efficient utilization of the accelerator requires deep understanding of the hardware compute architecture, memory hierarchy, dataflow, scheduling, quantization, instruction set and execution model. The successful candidate will use this understanding to develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts, evaluate architectural proposals against real AI workloads, and influence the design of future NPU hardware.

You will work closely with hardware architects, micro-architects, compiler engineers and AI software teams to answer a fundamental question:

**How should the NPU hardware and software be co-designed to deliver the best performance, power efficiency, programmability and scalability for real-world AI workloads?**

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

Compiler & Software Architecture for NPU

* Develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts for current and next-generation NPU architectures.
* Define software abstractions and compiler flows that efficiently expose NPU hardware capabilities to AI workloads.
* Develop and evaluate compiler concepts including graph lowering, intermediate representations, operator mapping, scheduling, tiling, fusion, memory planning and code generation.
* Translate NPU architectural concepts into executable software models and demonstrate their feasibility using representative AI workloads.
* Develop lightweight compiler/runtime infrastructure to validate new hardware features before production software implementation.
* Analyze existing compiler limitations and identify architectural changes required to improve programmability and accelerator utilization.

Hardware–Software Co-Design

* Work as an integral member of the hardware architecture team to co-design NPU hardware and software.
* Analyze how proposed hardware features can be effectively exposed through the compiler and software stack.
* Provide software-driven feedback on compute architecture, memory hierarchy, data movement, dataflow, scheduling, instruction set and accelerator programmability.
* Identify hardware features that provide meaningful benefits to real AI workloads and challenge features that add hardware complexity without sufficient software value.
* Define compiler requirements and software abstractions for new NPU capabilities.
* Participate in architecture and micro-architecture reviews and influence hardware decisions from a software and workload perspective.
* Evaluate architectural trade-offs considering performance, power, area, compiler complexity and software scalability.

AI Workload & Performance Analysis

* Analyze representative AI models and workloads to identify compute, memory, bandwidth, scheduling and data-movement bottlenecks.
* Build software-based performance models and workload prototypes to evaluate architectural concepts.
* Develop experiments to quantify the impact of proposed hardware features on model performance and accelerator utilization.
* Investigate issues such as quantization, sparsity, operator fusion, tensor layouts, tiling, data reuse, memory bandwidth and scheduling efficiency.
* Correlate software/model-level performance with architectural and micro-architectural behavior.
* Use workload analysis to guide both current-generation optimizations and next-generation NPU architecture.

Architecture Prototyping

* Rapidly prototype software solutions for architectural concepts that may be months or years away from production silicon.
* Develop functional models, compiler prototypes, simulators, emulators, reference implementations or runtime abstractions as needed to validate architectural ideas.
* Demonstrate end-to-end execution of representative AI workloads on proposed NPU architectures.
* Build proof-of-concepts that allow hardware architects to make informed architectural decisions before RTL implementation.
* Help establish software models and interfaces that can later evolve into production compiler components.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Work closely with NPU hardware architects, micro-architects, RTL designers and the production compiler/software organization.
* Bridge the communication gap between hardware and software teams and translate requirements in both directions.
* Participate in architecture definition from early concept through implementation and silicon bring-up.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction for compiler-driven hardware/software co-design.
* Influence the roadmap of future NPU architectures through workload and software-driven insights.

Necessary Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

8+ years of experience in compiler development, systems software, computer architecture, AI accelerators, or a closely related area.

Strong understanding of compiler architecture and compiler optimization techniques.

Strong C++ programming skills and proficiency in Python.

Strong understanding of computer architecture and familiarity with accelerator architectures, memory hierarchies and data movement.

Experience analyzing AI/ML workloads and understanding performance bottlenecks.

Ability to work across hardware and software boundaries and communicate effectively with hardware architects.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate architectural ideas.

Good to have

* Experience developing compilers or software stacks for NPUs, GPUs, DSPs, TPUs or other AI accelerators.
* Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TOSA, StableHLO, Torch-MLIR or similar compiler infrastructure.
* Experience with accelerator-specific scheduling, tiling, memory management or code generation.
* Understanding of NPU architecture concepts such as dataflow, tensor engines, systolic/array-based compute, local SRAMs, DMA/data movement and accelerator instruction sets.

* In-depth knowledge of Azure networking components including VNet, ExpressRoute, vWAN, ingress/egress patterns, and Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs)

* Strong automation skills using ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
* Experience deploying infrastructure using a modular, reusable approach.

Multi Cloud Migration & Modernization
  
  

* Multi-Cloud Migration experience. Hands-on experience in AWS or GCP to Azure migration.
* Experience with large-scale cloud migration projects using tools like Azure Migrate.
* Familiarity with all stages of the migration lifecycle, including assessment, planning, execution, and optimization.
* Experience with container migration and modernization initiatives.

Infrastructure Security and Zero Trust Practices
  
  

* Strong command of network segmentation, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, VPN/ExpressRoute security, and Zero Trust networking.
* Implement secure connectivity and encrypted network flows across hybrid and cloud environments.
* Implement Azure Policy, Blueprints, governance guardrails, and secure by design patterns.
* Experience in meeting compliance standards and performing cloud security assessments.
* Deploy secure landing zones following CAF & WAF (Cloud Adoption Framework & Well‑Architected Framework) principles ensuring governance, resiliency, and secure adoption paths
* Ensuring alignment with industry frameworks like Zero Trust principles

Consulting & Delivery Mindset

* Curiosity to explore emerging data and AI technologies
* Willingness to receive feedback, grow technical depth, and expand ownership over time
* Demonstrated success in delivering customer-facing projects in large-scale enterprise environments
* Experience conducting technical workshops, envisioning sessions, and solution design engagements.
* Exposure to multiple industries and sectors, with the ability to tailor solutions to diverse business needs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Proven adaptability to new technologies and evolving customer requirements.

title: Predictive Science -  AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
  
  
As a Vice President – AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead in Predictive Science, you will own the technical vision and delivery for a team of prompt engineers and AI/ML model developers building intelligent document processing and data extraction solutions in the KYC/AML domain.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Architect agentic, multi-step AI workflows chaining classification → extraction → cross-validation → exception routing with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Debug and remediate complex prompt failures (context-window overflow, instruction drift in long chains, RAG retrieval poisoning, output/format instability).
* Design prompt/model evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy plus consistency, robustness, latency, cost-per-call, and hallucination rate.
* Operationalize prompt lifecycle management as production code: versioning, CI/CD prompt tests, A/B experiments, rollback, and audited change history.
* Guide model selection and optimization (prompting vs fine-tuning vs custom training) balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and data sensitivity.
* Design RAG architectures for financial documents: chunking, embeddings, vector store design, re-ranking, and context injection.
* Oversee fine-tuning/training workflows: dataset curation, annotation quality, training configurations, and generalization across document variants.
* Build and maintain evaluation infrastructure: benchmark/golden datasets, regression suites, and automated scoring to catch regressions pre-production.
* Define confidence calibration and escalation logic so systems estimate uncertainty and route low-confidence outputs to human reviewers with the right context.
* Partner with governance/model risk and data engineering: produce validator-ready documentation (explainability/auditability) and ensure robust, refreshed data/annotation/eval pipelines; drive AI-native development practices to improve velocity.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* 10+ years in NLP/AI/ML or computational linguistics, including 3+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.
* Hands-on LLM internals expertise: tokenization impacts, attention limits, context window management, and temperature/sampling trade-offs.
* Proven prompt architecture design/debugging: multi-turn chains, few-/many-shot, chain-of-thought, self-consistency, and constitutional AI.
* Strong RAG system design experience: embeddings trade-offs (e.g., ada/BGE/Cohere), chunking for semi-structured docs, hybrid retrieval (dense+sparse), and re-ranking.
* Fine-tuning experience: LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO, dataset curation, and evaluating tuned vs prompted performance.
* Python + ML engineering proficiency: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex (or equivalents), vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector), and API development.
* AI evaluation systems experience beyond F1: faithfulness, answer relevance, RAG context precision/recall, automated eval pipelines, and LLM-as-judge.
* Deep understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucinations, sycophancy, long-context instruction degradation, prompt-format sensitivity, and catastrophic forgetting.
* Structured output enforcement in production: JSON mode, function calling, constrained decoding, output parsers, and schema validation.
* Build-vs-buy/model selection track record: benchmarking foundation models (GPT-4/Claude/Llama/Mistral) against task requirements.
* Leadership under ambiguity: pragmatic trade-offs, rapid iteration as practices evolve, and strong communication with compliance, risk, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Domain expertise in KYC/AML or financial document processing: entity extraction from registries, beneficial ownership structures, sanctions screening logic, adverse media classification.
* Experience designing autonomous AI agents: tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, memory architectures, and safety guardrails for regulated environments.
* Knowledge of AI security/adversarial robustness: prompt injection defense, jailbreak detection, data poisoning awareness, and output monitoring for sensitive financial data.
* Experience with model distillation to produce smaller, faster models for cost-effective deployment.
* Familiarity with AI observability/monitoring: tracking prompt/model performance, drift detection, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Experience with multi-modal AI combining OCR, layout understanding, and LLM-based extraction for complex documents.
* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in CS/NLP/ML or equivalent depth via publications, open-source, or production system design and Passion for talent development: growing engineers from junior prompt writers into senior AI system designers via structured mentorship.

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution

title: AI Tech lead
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The AI Tech Lead serves as a key technical resource for the ZenAI platform and a critical escalation point for complex platform, integration, and engineering issues. The role requires deep platform expertise and is responsible for feature evaluation, advanced technical consulting, and development of the internal tools on which the team depends. The AI Tech Lead ensures that solutions deployed on ZenAI are optimized for performance, cost efficiency, and model selection; advises power users and technical audiences on advanced platform capabilities; and serves as the technical liaison to vendor engineering and support teams. This role will initially operate as an individual contributor and is expected to evolve into a people-leadership position with one to three direct reports as the team grows. The role also provides complementary coverage across time zones in partnership with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Master Data and Capacity Model Ownership:**
  Own the capacity model and related planning master data in SAP IBP. Use the master data dashboard to identify gaps or inaccuracies in production run rates, changeover constraints, material lead times, resource calendars and other planning parameters. Coordinate corrections with the relevant supply planners and master data stewards responsible for maintaining the source data in ECC/S/4HANA.

* **Constraint Identification and Alert Generation:**
  Run SAP IBP heuristics and planning algorithms to identify constraints across the supply network. Generate system alerts for capacity bottlenecks, material shortages, safety stock violations, and demand-supply imbalances.

* **Scenario Building:**
  Build comparable scenarios with consistent assumptions that enable the Supply Planers in both the Mid-Term and Short-Term to evaluate alternatives. Ensure scenarios are structured, repeatable, and documented so that leadership can compare options on a level playing field.

* **Resolution Modelling:**
  Execute resolution modelling in SAP S4 ePPDS and SAP IBP to test proposed solutions before they are committed. Validate feasibility of allocation changes, schedule adjustments, and capacity rebalancing options.

* **Digital Twin Development:**
  Drive digital twin development as organizational maturity evolves. Progress the modelling capability through maturity stages: heuristic-based planning, optimizer-driven planning, and ultimately AI/Joule-enabled autonomous planning.

* **Data and Parameter Stewardship:**
  Serve as the owner of planning parameters, ensuring that safety stock targets, lot sizes, planning horizons, and aggregation rules are correctly configured and regularly reviewed for accuracy. Ensure issues identified through modelling or business plan validation are escalated and corrected at source where required.

**RESOURCES MANAGED**

***Financial Accountability***

None.

***Supervision***

Initially an individual contributor role. Expected to supervise one to three ZICC-based direct reports (AI Tech Analysts) over time as the team grows.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

The following education and experience qualifications are required or preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field required; advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years of professional experience in technical roles such as software engineering, platform engineering, or solution architecture
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with API integrations, enterprise system connections, and automation platforms
* Demonstrated expertise with AI platforms and technologies, including agentic and generative AI
* Experience evaluating, testing, and rolling out new platform features in an enterprise environment
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across multiple systems
* Experience building internal tooling, dashboards, and automation solutions
* Prior people leadership or team lead experience preferred
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry preferred

**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

The following technical skills are required or preferred:

* Deep expertise with enterprise AI platforms and technologies, including agents, workflows, skills, integrations, and agentic AI; experience with Langdock, OpenAI, or similar platforms preferred.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) services and MCP gateways; experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and event-driven architectures
* Strong proficiency in Python and scripting languages for automation and tooling
* Experience with Databricks preferred
* Proficiency with database technologies (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and reporting frameworks
* Understanding of FinOps principles, token/cost tracking, and spend optimization
* Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, GPT Codex, or similar)
* Experience with Flask, Posit/RStudio, or similar application development frameworks
* Proficiency with collaboration tools (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

**PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

Primarily office-based at the Zoetis India Capability Center (ZICC) in Hyderabad, India. Occasional travel (0-10%). Schedule flexibility required to provide complementary time zone coverage with the global AI Capabilities & Governance team. This description indicates the general nature and level of work expected. title: SAP Consultants - Lead
description:
**What you will do on your journey with WebBeds.**

As an SAP Consultant Lead / SAP ABAP Developer Lead, you will join the growing global SAP team at WebBeds and play a key role in our SAP S/4HANA and RISE with SAP transformation journey.

**\***
These roles are based in Hyderabad and can also be considered in Bangalore, Pune, Chennai or Noida. We are building an internal SAP capability to drive innovation, reduce reliance on external partners and establish long-term ownership of our business processes and SAP solutions.'

We are recruiting across multiple functional and technical domains, with opportunities for SAP R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, together with an SAP ABAP Developer Lead.

Each successful candidate will lead delivery and solution ownership within their area of expertise. Functional Leads will collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions, while the SAP ABAP Developer Lead will partner with Functional Leads, Global Process Owners and technical teams to deliver Clean Core-aligned developments, integrations, analytics and automation.

All roles will contribute to process standardisation, innovation, compliance, operational excellence and measurable business value.

**In this role you will:**

**Key responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:**
  lead delivery within your assigned functional domain or ABAP technical specialism, from requirements and solution design through testing, deployment, go-live, hypercare and operational handover.
* **Stakeholder partnership:**
  partner with business stakeholders, Global Process Owners, SAP teams, integration teams and delivery partners to define scalable future-state solutions.
* **SAP best practice:**
  champion SAP S/4HANA best practices, RISE with SAP, fit-to-standard delivery and Clean Core principles.
* **Design, testing and deployment:**
  lead or support workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution design, documentation, SIT, UAT, end-to-end testing, data migration, cutover and production readiness.
* **Automation and governance:**
  drive automation, process standardisation, continuous improvement, controls, compliance and governance.
* **Innovation:**
  identify opportunities to apply SAP Signavio, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP BTP, SAP Build, Datasphere, SAC, Cloud ALM and LeanIX where relevant to your role (nice to have).
* **Specialist leadership:**
  provide leadership within your specialist area through design assurance, quality oversight, knowledge transfer and effective collaboration with internal and external teams.
* **Record-to-Report (R2R) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end R2R processes within SAP S/4HANA, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Tax, Financial Close, Statutory and Management Reporting, Profitability Analysis (CO-PA), Bank Reconciliations and Finance Controls, and partner with O2C and P2P process owners to support an integrated Finance operating model across the WebBeds SAP landscape.
* **Order-to-Cash (O2C) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end O2C processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Customer Master Data, Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing and Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Credit Management, Collections, Dispute Management, Cash Application, Revenue Management and customer experience optimisation, and lead the design, configuration, standardisation and continuous improvement of SAP SD and FSCM capabilities to strengthen revenue assurance, working capital, collections effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* **Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own end-to-end P2P processes within SAP S/4HANA, including Supplier Master Data and Onboarding, Sourcing and Contracts, Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods and Service Receipts, Invoice Verification, Supplier Reconciliations, Payment Integration, Spend Visibility, Procurement Compliance, Supplier Performance, and SAP MM procurement and inventory management.
* **Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Functional Consultant Lead:**
  own planning and performance management processes, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario modelling, cost and profit centre planning, allocations, profitability analysis, business performance analysis, management reporting, dashboards, planning standardisation, SAC Planning, Datasphere and decision-support insights.
* **SAP ABAP Developer Lead:**
  own the technical design and delivery of SAP ABAP and BTP solutions across R2R, O2C, P2P & FP&A, translating functional requirements into scalable RICEFW objects, custom transactions, reports, interfaces, forms, workflows, CDS-based data models, APIs, integrations, Fiori services and intelligent automation solutions aligned with Clean Core principles.

**The skills we would love to see in your suitcase!**

* Proven experience in at least one of the functional domains (R2R, O2C, P2P, FP&A) or in SAP ABAP development, with relevant professional experience, technical expertise and business process knowledge.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, strong hands-on SAP ABAP experience in S/4HANA, including ABAP Objects, Data Dictionary, ALV, Smart Forms or Adobe Forms, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits and performance optimisation.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience developing across SAP FI, CO, MM and SD business processes, with the ability to understand functional specifications and intended business outcomes.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, integration experience using IDocs, BAPIs, APIs, SAP Integration Suite or equivalent SAP integration technologies.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, advanced experience with ABAP CDS Views, including data models, analytical queries and consumption views supporting Fiori, Datasphere, SAC and Finance reporting.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, experience with RAP, OData services, APIs, SAP Gateway, Fiori/UI5 extensibility and SAP BTP or side-by-side extension patterns.
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Build, AI-assisted development, workflow automation or agentic automation is strongly preferred (nice to have).
* For the SAP ABAP Developer Lead role, the ability to lead technical design, code reviews, development standards, documentation, testing, transport governance, defect resolution and developer mentoring.
* Please apply for the role that best aligns with your experience and state clearly in your application which role or domain best matches your background, demonstrating relevant depth in that area.
* Applications will be assessed against the requirements of the selected functional domain or SAP ABAP technical role.

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**Description**
**About Salesforce**

The ideal technical consultant is a demonstrated thought leader in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of enterprise desktop, cloud, and/or mobile solutions, including enterprise integrations leveraging middleware tools and platforms. Developers deliver technical solutions to meet the customer’s business and technical requirements. * Programming solutions in Salesforce’s Apex programming language, JavaScript, Lightning Web Component Framework and JS Frameworks with API integrations to cloud and back-office systems
* Developing, optimizing and deploying Salesforce applications
* Demonstrating key Salesforce capabilities and features
* Learn and use Salesforce’s Services team best practices
* Help clients consistently meet/exceed goals and metrics
* Contribute to customer success through front and back-end solution development and release management
* Deliver high customer satisfaction (CSAT)
* Continued professional growth and development

**Minimum Qualifications**

* BA/BS degree or foreign equivalent
* 6+ years of relevant experience
* Strong problem solving skills
* Experience using technical skills to solve real-world business problems
* Strong programming skills with JavaScript and one object-oriented language (eg Java, C#, Python)
* Data modeling (objects, fields and relationships; able to model 1:M and M:M relationships)

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

* Strong presentation skills. Able to effectively present and defend point of view to a variety of audiences

* Positive attitude; ability to motivate others

This role will contribute to the development of intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, collaborating, and operating within complex enterprise environments.
  
  
Your role will also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end‑to‑end processes and projects for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely and accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on tasks to be performed; and mentoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skill development, professional growth, and overall success

* Experience designing and implementing advanced RAG architectures.
* Hands-on experience with:

+ Semantic search
+ Enterprise knowledge retrieval systems

**AI Workflow Orchestration**

* Proven ability to develop:

+ Self-healing workflows
+ Automated debugging mechanisms

+ Quality assurance and audit checkpoints

* Experience deploying Generative AI solutions in:

+ On-premises environments
+ Hybrid architectures
+ Public cloud environments

+ Microsoft Azure
+ AWS
+ Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

* C#.NET, .NET6+, MVC.NET, Angular, or one of Bootstrap, ReactJS, VueJS.

* Attention to detail. Dedicated self-starter with excellent people skills.
* Quick learner and a go-getter.
* Effective time and project management.
* Analytical thinker and a great team player.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal & problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills are a must.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a creative mindset to bring fresh ideas to table.

* Demonstrates strong collaboration skills by working effectively with cross-functional teams, sharing insights, and contributing to shared goals and solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging trends, technologies, and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge.

title: Specialist, AI Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior/Principal AI Engineer, you will drive the end-to-end development of GenAI applications, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, and LLM-based workflows, while ensuring high standards of performance, scalability, and responsible AI practices. You will provide technical leadership, mentor teams, and translate complex AI capabilities into impactful business solutions.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Implement Agentic AI systems leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, Google ADK, Strands, and Semantic Kernel, enabling multi-step reasoning and task orchestration.
* Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques (ReAct, few-shot learning, chain-of-thought, prompt chaining) to improve accuracy, determinism, and robustness of LLM systems.
* Build multimodal AI solutions, integrating text with images or structured data to support complex enterprise use cases.
* Apply harness engineering practices to systematically design, test, and evaluate AI/agent workflows across different scenarios.
* Develop reusable agent tooling and integrations, enabling interaction with enterprise services, tools, and workflows, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication patterns.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable GenAI-driven solutions.
* Leverage modern AI developer tooling such as Claude CLI, GitHub Copilot, Vertex AI, and Codex to accelerate development workflows.
* Support deployment and operationalization of AI solutions using cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP.

**What Should You Have**

* Masters in a relevant quantitative, applied field (Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering)
* Minimum of 5 years of work experience in the end-to-end lifecycle of ML model development and deployment into production within a cloud infrastructure (Databricks is highly preferred).

**Primary Skills (must-have)**

* Expertise in RAG architectures, including embedding generation, retrieval optimization, grounding, and context management.
* Experience in prompt engineering techniques
* Experience implementing AgentOps practices, including observability, tracing, logging, and performance evaluation of AI systems.
* Strong Python programming skills with experience in tooling, function-calling, and agent-driven integrations.
* Familiarity with harness engineering approaches for systematic testing, validation, and benchmarking of AI systems.
* Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interaction patterns.
* Solid expertise in NLP and text processing, including tokenization, embeddings, and preprocessing pipelines.
* Understanding of transformer architectures and modern LLM ecosystems.

**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**

* Exposure to multimodal AI systems involving text, vision, or structured data fusion.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, including synthetic test generation and prompt regression testing.
* Experience with advanced chunking strategies and context window optimization.
* Hands-on experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch for custom model development or experimentation.
* Exposure to LLMOps/MLOps practices for deployment, monitoring, and scaling AI systems.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
**Required Skills**
Animal Vaccination, Biopharmaceutical Industry, Collaborative Development, Databricks Platform, Data Engineering, Design Applications, Digital Transformation, Disease Prevention, Econometrics, Information Security, Machine Learning (ML), Macroeconomics, MultiModal AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Prompt Engineering, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), System Designs, System Integration, Technical Leadership, Testing
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
LLMOps, Machine Learning Operations, PyTorch

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a senior technologist to join our Messaging Middleware team based in the firm’s offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Gurugram. The team is responsible for building and evolving a framework for real-time data streaming web applications used across the firm. This framework enables partner teams to focus on business logic while relying on a robust shared platform to handle the complexity of real-time messaging, data delivery, scalability, resiliency, observability, and developer ergonomics. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will help shape the technical direction of a core platform, make key architectural and implementation decisions, contribute directly to high-impact systems, and raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, mentorship, and example.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will design, build, and enhance a framework that powers real-time data streaming web applications across the firm. You will work on capabilities that improve platform efficiency, robustness, scalability, observability, and ease of use for application teams. You will partner closely with framework users to understand their requirements and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that support low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant application behavior. You will drive performance tuning across the stack, including messaging, serialization, transport, concurrency, backpressure handling, and client/server interactions. You will help design resilient systems that handle failures gracefully, including network interruptions, traffic spikes, and partial service degradation. You will also contribute directly to the implementation of critical components, review architecture and code, troubleshoot production issues, and drive improvements in testing, operability, and long-term design health. As a senior technical leader on the team, you will mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day-to-day collaboration. You will influence engineering culture by setting a high bar in technical rigor, ownership, and execution, and periodically providing clear updates to senior stakeholders on technical direction, system health, key deliverables, and important risks or trade-offs.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, and object-oriented programming
* The candidate should have 7+ years of software engineering experience building high-performance, real-time distributed systems
* The candidate should have strong experience with messaging middleware, event-driven systems, and low-latency data streaming architectures
* Proven experience designing and building production-grade frameworks, platforms, or shared infrastructure
* The candidate should have strong understanding of performance, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed systems
* The candidate should have hands-on experience with technologies such as Kafka, Solace, NATS, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, WebSockets, SSE, or gRPC streaming
* The candidate should have strong software design, debugging, testing, and code quality fundamentals
* The candidate should have experience with production observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support
* The candidate should have demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience as a senior individual contributor
* The candidate should have excellent written and oral communication skills
* The candidate should be comfortable working in a language-agnostic environment
* Candidates with experience in browser-facing real-time applications, serialization and wire protocols, resilience patterns, or large-scale performance testing will have an added advantage

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplMiddlewareApr26

title: Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)
description:
**Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)Role**
**Overview**
We are looking for a Lead Embedded Firmware Developer with 12+ years of experience to drive the architectural direction, optimization, and scaling of our next-generation Residential Gateway products. Our software architecture leverages prplOS, making our platform inherently SoC-independent across diverse silicon, including Broadcom and MaxLinear SoCs.
  
  
In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our embedded firmware and wireless stack. You will own the Linux wireless architecture, scaling our platform to support cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities, while ensuring carrier-grade stability through deep system-level profiling and optimization using tools like perf and Valgrind. Additionally, you will champion automation by using Python scripting to build robust testing and unit testing framework methodologies that ensure code quality across the entire lifecyle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of resilient, hardware-agnostic gateway firmware, mentoring engineering teams and establishing embedded development best practices.
* Test Automation & Scripting: Architect and implement automated testing and unit testing frameworks using Python to validate system components, APIs, and overall firmware reliability.
* Performance Profiling & Optimization: Use perf, Valgrind (Memcheck, Massif, Helgrind), and kernel utilities to profile OS memory and CPU management, eliminate memory leaks, resolve race conditions, and minimize CPU bottlenecks.
* Wireless Stack & Driver Integration: Design, configure, and optimize Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 features using hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, and iw sub-systems.
* Firmware Development: Architect, develop, and maintain high-performance firmware in C and C++ across various gateway hardware platforms.
* SoC Abstraction: Leverage prpl APIs to maintain hardware-agnostic implementations across multiple carrier-grade SoCs.
* Inter-process Communication (IPC): Develop and maintain scalable services utilizing ubus and/or iMTP to ensure reliable internal bus communication.
* Network Stack Management: Design and troubleshoot robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 network stacks to ensure optimal routing, bridging, and packet forwarding.
* Service Management & Provisioning: Implement and maintain device management and service models, including TR-181 data models and USP (User Services Platform / TR-369).
* Containerization & Lifecycle Management: Configure and manage containerized microservices and virtual execution environments using Docker and prpl LCM (Lifecycle Management).
* Version Control: Manage source code, branching strategies, and firmware release pipelines using Git.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Experience: 10+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience in the telecom, networking, or residential gateway industries.
* Languages: High proficiency in C and modern C++ programming within resource-constrained embedded systems.
* Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Embedded Linux development within OpenWrt or prplOS ecosystems.
* Device Management: Deep, production-level expertise with broadband management standards, explicitly TR-181 data models and USP (TR-369).
* Containerization: Demonstrated experience deploying, isolating, and configuring containerized microservices using Docker and lifecycle tools like prpl LCM.
* Advanced Linux Wireless: Deep knowledge of the Linux Wireless stack, including hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, iw, and Linux wireless drivers.
* Networking Protocols: Deep understanding of Layer 2/3 networking and core routing/bridging concepts.
* Profiling & Debugging: Hands-on experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools, specifically perf and Valgrind.
* Version Control: Strong expertise managing source code and branching strategies via Git.

**Good-to-Have Requirements**

* Next-Gen Wi-Fi: Experience implementing, configuring, or debugging next-generation wireless features like Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7.
* Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python for creating automated test scripts, hardware validation, or test execution.
* Testing Frameworks: Experience building or maintaining unit testing frameworks (e.g., CUnit, Unity, PyTest) in an embedded context.
* IPC Frameworks: Deep familiarity with OpenWrt ubus and message bus architectures like iMTP.
* Hardware Abstraction: Hands-on experience developing abstraction layers on Broadcom or MaxLinear residential gateway SoCs.

40

Regular

title: Data Engineering SMTS/LMTS
description:
**Description**
About Salesforce
  
  
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**Department Overview**
The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows.
  
  
Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation—not experimentation without operational accountability.
  
  
**Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator**
We are seeking a
**Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS)**
to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth).
* Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node.js/APIs).
* Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

title: Senior NetSuite Technical Consultant
description:
**About Us**
dotSolved, headquartered in Silicon Valley USA, is a leading global provider of business process automation, modern application engineering, and cloud infrastructure services. dotSolved focuses on enabling digital transformations for small, medium, and large enterprises, in the following industries (but not limited to): High technology, Energy, Manufacturing, Financial Services, Media & Entertainment, Communications, Retail, Healthcare, and Education.
  
  
dotSolved drives digital transformations for enterprises by defining, automating, and optimizing complex business processes for the digital era and engineering modern, data & analytic driven, applications that deliver intended business value. With hundreds of successful implementations and experience in Big Data, ERP, and Supply Chain, dotSolved can guarantee the creation of measurable business value from project engagements leading to accelerated business growth and profitability for customers.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position: Senior NetSuite Technical Consultant**
Location: Hyderabad - Remote
  
  
Engagement Type: Full Time
  
  
Shift Timing: 3.00AM - 12.00PM PST (US Pacific Time)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy advanced customizations using SuiteScript (1.0 & 2.x), SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST web services), SuiteFlow, and the SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF).
* Architecture & Design: Own the technical architecture for complex customizations, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and adherence to NetSuite best practices and governance limits.
* Integration Development: Build and maintain inbound/outbound integrations between NetSuite and third-party systems (Salesforce, billing platforms, EDI, middleware such as Boomi, MuleSoft, or Workato).
* Code Review & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, conduct peer code reviews, and manage version control/deployment pipelines (SDF, CI/CD) across Sandbox and Production environments.
* Performance Optimization: Diagnose and resolve script governance issues, performance bottlenecks, and data integrity problems in high-volume transactional environments.
* Solution Design: Translate functional requirements and solution design documents (SDDs) into technical specifications and working code.
* Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and code review support to junior developers on the team.
* AI & Automation: Evaluate and implement NetSuite's native AI capabilities (SuiteSense, etc.) and scripted automation to streamline financial and operational workflows.

**Key Qualifications**

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on NetSuite development experience, including full-lifecycle implementations and ongoing managed services/support.
* Technical Proficiency: Expert-level SuiteScript 2.x (and working knowledge of 1.0), strong JavaScript fundamentals, and deep understanding of the NetSuite data model, record types, and SuiteCloud platform architecture.
* APIs & Integration: Extensive experience with SuiteTalk (REST/SOAP), RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts, and third-party API integration patterns.
* Customization Tools: Advanced experience with SuiteBuilder, SuiteFlow, Workflow Action scripts, Custom Records, and Saved Searches/SuiteQL.
* Environment Management: Proven experience managing code deployments and configuration across Sandbox, Release Preview, and Production environments using SDF and bundle management.
* Consultative Mindset: Ability to advise on "out of the box" vs. custom development trade-offs, articulating ROI and long-term maintenance costs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Documentation: Strong ability to produce technical design documents, unit test plans, and deployment runbooks.
* Language: Fluency in English (written and verbal) required.
* Certification: NetSuite Certified SuiteCloud Developer strongly preferred; NetSuite Certified ERP Consultant a plus.

**Must-Have Experience**

* Deep understanding of ERP core business processes: Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and financial management (GL, AR, AP)
* Advanced SuiteScript 2.x development (Map/Reduce, Scheduled, User Event, Client, RESTlet scripts)
* Strong SQL/SuiteQL skills for complex reporting and data extraction
* Experience with NetSuite governance, script deployment records, and error handling/logging frameworks
* Experience building and troubleshooting inbound/outbound integrations at scale
* Experience with Advanced Financials (OneWorld, intercompany elimination, financial reporting)
* Experience with Advanced Revenue Recognition
* Experience with tax engines (OneSource or NetSuite native taxation)
* Experience supporting both greenfield implementations and post-go-live managed service

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Technical Consulting — Revenue Cloud Advanced(RCA)
description:

You will act as the senior technical leader for quote-to-cash migration engagements, guiding the team through complex product catalogue migration, contract and subscription data migration, billing migration strategy, ERP integration design and Agentforce revenue agent configuration — while building a high-performing team of Revenue Cloud and AI migration specialists.***

title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.

**Equal Opportunity**

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

title: Design System/UX Engineer
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
* UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
* Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward.

**What you'll own:**

* The design system as a real component library — templates and patterns developers implement without friction
* Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
* Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
* The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
* Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
* Your committed timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with taste and grit — a designer who ships
* Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
* You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it — your design system makes them faster, never slower
* You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering — you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs.
* Strong graphics experience — ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly.
* Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product — versioned, documented, themed, adopted.
* Strong templating discipline — reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build.
* Understands the tech underneath — WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading — well enough that your designs never fight the architecture.
* Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) — an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day.
* Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts.
* Perceived-performance craft — skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't.
* Design tokens as the theming backbone — enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite.
* Overlay/extension constraints fluency — designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities.
* Usability evidence at startup speed — lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies.
* A debugger in the browser — you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.
