title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
**Description**
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.

Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Performance Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Performance Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Diagnose issues that an in-house performance testing team has been unable to. There are five aspects to Performance Engineering: software development lifecycle and architecture, performance testing and validation, capacity planning, application performance management and problem detection and resolution.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA

15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Senior AWS Integration Architect, you will design and implement enterprise-scale AWS integration platforms, cloud-native architectures, and metadata-driven integration frameworks. The role requires extensive expertise in AWS Glue-based data integration solutions, serverless architectures, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and modern cloud integration patterns.
  
  
The architect will leverage AWS services such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, CloudFormation, CDK (TypeScript), and CodeBuild to build scalable, secure, and high-performance integration solutions. Strong experience in Python, PySpark, SQL, and TypeScript is required, along with expertise in Data Mesh architectures, multi-tenant integration platforms, cross-account deployments, and event-driven integration patterns.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to deliver cloud solutions using Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and accelerate software delivery.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Design and architect enterprise-scale AWS Glue-based data integration solutions for cloud-native applications and Data Mesh platforms.
* Lead the design and implementation of serverless integration architectures using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and AWS Glue.
* Develop and optimize AWS Glue ETL jobs using Python and PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation.
* Design metadata-driven and configuration-over-code integration frameworks using JSON schemas and reusable architecture patterns.
* Build scalable, event-driven integration pipelines supporting JDBC, REST APIs, SFTP, and messaging-based integrations.
* Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using AWS CDK (TypeScript) and CloudFormation.
* Lead multi-tenant architecture decisions and cross-account deployment strategies across AWS environments.
* Develop backend services using TypeScript and Python for serverless applications.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitHub, and DevOps best practices.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to gather requirements, conduct architecture reviews, and deliver solution demonstrations.
* Ensure security, governance, monitoring, and operational excellence across AWS integration platforms.
* Optimize AWS solutions for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Mentor development teams and establish best practices for cloud-native integration and automation.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to improve engineering productivity and accelerate SDLC processes.
* Work closely with Agile teams to deliver high-quality cloud solutions following DevOps and continuous integration practices.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* 10 12+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS cloud integration solutions.
* Strong expertise in AWS Glue for ETL development, data transformation, workflow orchestration, and enterprise data integration.
* Extensive experience with AWS services including AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Athena, Amazon SQS, and AWS CodeBuild.
* Experience with AWS CDK (TypeScript) and AWS CloudFormation for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated cloud provisioning.
* Good understanding of AWS security services including Amazon Cognito, AWS WAF, AWS Certificate Manager, Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon SageMaker.
* Strong programming skills in Python, PySpark, SQL, and TypeScript.
* Experience developing serverless applications and backend services using AWS Lambda and TypeScript.
* Expertise in developing, optimizing, and troubleshooting AWS Glue ETL jobs using Python and PySpark.
* Strong knowledge of Data Mesh architecture, metadata-driven integration, and configuration-over-code platform design.
* Experience designing event-driven architectures using EventBridge, Step Functions, Lambda, and SQS.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns including REST APIs, JDBC, SFTP, and asynchronous messaging.
* Experience designing multi-tenant integration platforms and cross-account AWS deployment strategies.
* Proficiency in JSON schema design, metadata management, and reusable integration frameworks.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitHub, and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud automation, and deployment strategies.
* Familiarity with GitHub Copilot and Claude Code for AI-assisted software development and Agentic SDLC workflows.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies.
* Experience with performance optimization, monitoring, troubleshooting, and cost optimization of AWS cloud solutions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication, and technical leadership skills.
* Proven ability to mentor engineering teams and establish cloud integration architecture best practices.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have a minimum of 10 years of experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* This position is based at the Hyderabad office.
* A minimum of 15 years of full-time education is required.

title: Engineering Lead-AI Agentic Platform
description:
Engineering Lead
  
  
AI Agentic Platform Orchestration, Benchmarking & Unification
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to build, architect, and lead the team behind our next-generation AI Agentic Platform. This platform empowers enterprises to measure ROI on industry-specific agent activity, benchmark AI agents against performance standards, orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows, and unify AI agents seamlessly across diverse platforms and ecosystems.
  
  
As the engineering leader for this strategic product, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong people management skills to deliver a unified control plane for the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape. You will own the technical vision, drive architectural decisions, and grow a high-performing team that ships at the frontier of AI engineering.
  
  
Platform Capabilities You'll Own
  
  

* Industry-Specific ROI Measurement: Build instrumentation, analytics, and reporting frameworks that quantify the business impact of AI agents across verticals such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, and telecom.
* AI Agent Benchmarking: Develop standardized evaluation harnesses, performance scoring, and quality metrics that allow enterprises to compare agents on accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task success.
* Agent Orchestration: Design multi-agent orchestration engines, workflow planners, routing layers, and coordination frameworks that enable agents to collaborate on complex tasks reliably.
* Cross-Platform Agent Unification: Architect a unified abstraction layer, connectors, and protocol adapters (MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants, LangGraph, etc.) so customers can manage agents across vendors and frameworks from a single pane of glass.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Hire, build, and lead a high-caliber engineering team across backend, AI/ML, and platform infrastructure
* Define and own the technical architecture for a multi-tenant, scalable AI agentic platform
* Drive the technical roadmap for orchestration, benchmarking, observability, and unification capabilities
* Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and GTM teams to translate customer needs into shippable engineering outcomes
* Establish engineering best practices for AI agent development, evaluation, safety, and deployment
* Lead architectural reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex distributed systems
* Build robust evaluation frameworks and ROI dashboards that customers and internal teams trust
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency at scale
* Mentor engineers, set growth paths, run performance reviews, and foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture
* Communicate progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3+ years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native platforms
* Hands-on experience building AI/ML or LLM-powered products in production environments
* Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts including planning, tool use, memory, and multi-agent coordination
* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript
* Experience designing APIs, SDKs, and integration platforms used by enterprise customers
* Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining strong engineering talent
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
* Familiarity with emerging agent interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols
* Experience designing LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems (offline evals, A/B testing, golden datasets, judge models)
* Knowledge of observability for AI systems including tracing, telemetry, and cost/quality monitoring
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering at scale
* Background in building analytics, ROI dashboards, or business intelligence tooling for enterprise customers
* Domain experience in one or more verticals (BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, customer support, or sales)
* Familiarity with AI safety, guardrails, and responsible AI frameworks
* Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field

Technical Stack & Tooling
  
  

* Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Java
* AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google APIs
* Agent Protocols: MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants API, function calling, tool use frameworks
* Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Pinecone/Weaviate/Qdrant, Snowflake/BigQuery
* Streaming & Messaging: Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, gRPC
* Cloud & Infra: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker
* Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana

What We're Looking For
  
  

* A builder-leader who can both architect deeply technical systems and grow a high-performing team
* Someone genuinely excited about agentic AI and the future of multi-agent enterprise systems
* A pragmatic decision-maker who can balance innovation, customer value, and engineering excellence
* A strong communicator who can simplify complex AI concepts for diverse audiences
* A coach and mentor who invests in people and builds inclusive, psychologically safe teams

Why Join Us
  
  

* Lead one of the most strategic AI initiatives at the company at the forefront of agentic AI
* Build a category-defining platform that unifies, benchmarks, and orchestrates AI agents across the enterprise
* Shape product and technical strategy alongside senior leadership
* Work with cutting-edge LLMs, agent frameworks, and evaluation tooling
* Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits
* Flexible work culture with strong investment in learning and development

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description:

People Technology is the central hub for all Amazon people data. Our technology provides the foundation and orchestration for a multitude of key human resource processes — from onboarding tens of thousands of temporary employees during peak holiday season to integrating critical employee data with internal and external systems. We design and build highly secure, global software that allows Amazon to effectively manage the workforce, resulting in a better employee experience and a better bottom line.
  
  
We are looking for a Sr. Software Development Engineer to lead the design and development of Time and Pay systems at Amazon's scale and complexity. These systems reside on the critical path of Amazon operations.
  
  
As a Sr. SDE, you will invent new technologies and build custom solutions to help Amazon track time, attendance, and productivity of employees — directly impacting the employee experience for millions of associates. You will own problems end-to-end and work with some of the best minds at Amazon. This role is for a full-stack senior developer with an emphasis on designing highly scalable and extensible applications. You will design flexible and scalable solutions, and tackle some of the most complex challenges in computing by utilizing your skills in data structures, algorithms, and programming principles. Your responsibilities will span the full software development lifecycle — design, development, testing, deployment, and operations. * 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

Working with some of the most talented and dedicated team members you can find
  
  
Having fun

Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.

description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.
  
  
You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.
  
  
Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.
  
  
Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.
  
  
Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.
  
  
Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.
  
  
Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.
  
  
Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.
  
  
Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS:
  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms
* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with compliance & security standards including PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and NIST
* 6+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience in any Bigdata architecture, or experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn and experience in Kafka

* Strong proficiency in Java/J2EE frameworks, with a focus on Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Cloud

* Experience with inter-service communication using Eventgrid,gRPC or Kafka

**Performance Optimization:**

* Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like JMeter, Java Flight Recorder
* Expertise in JVM tuning, memory management, and SQL query optimization

**DevOps Practices and CI/CD:**

* Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including:

+ CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure Pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, GCP Cloud Build
+ Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS).
+ Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible
+ Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk

**Database and Data Storage:**

* Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server).
* Experience with NoSQL and caching technologies and/or hyperscaler-native options

**Code Reviews and Best Practices:**

* Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry-standard best practices
* Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis

**API Management and Security:**

* Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway
* Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML

**System Architecture and Design:**

* Experience producing architecture/design artifacts (diagrams, decision logs) using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or ArchiMate
* Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architectures, and domain-driven design (DDD)

**Leadership and Communication**

* Provide proof of concepts, analysis of alternatives, and brief their results to client stakeholders
* Responsible for cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud
* Build meaningful relationship with clients

* Contributes significantly towards leading initiatives for development and maintenance of tools, methods, and offerings in the area of specialization
* Identifies and builds productivity and efficiency drivers which substantially influence during sales pitch and become key criteria for winning new projects in the specialty area

**The team:**
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 8-14 years of industry experience, with at least 8+ years in a technical architect role designing applications and hosting solutions on cloud platforms
* At least 10+ years of hands-on experience in cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud
* Should have knowledge to understand and create the Target State Solutions
* Should be able to create Low level designs for Engineering teams For Ex: Flow charts, Sequence diagrams, class diagrams

+ Spring web-Java API development along with certification process

* Familiarity with principles summarized in the major Cloud Adoption Frameworks and Well-Architected/Architecture frameworks (e.g., AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) + Well-Architected; Azure CAF + Well-Architected Framework; Google Cloud CAF + Architecture Framework)

title: Principal Engineer - Systems
description:
**About Freshworks:**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead the design and evolution of the enterprise-scale platform architecture that powers Freshworks’ multi-tier SaaS products. This role will define the architecture strategy for a major platform domain, drive modernization initiatives, and establish best practices across service design, reliability, engineering quality, and cost.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in distributed systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, microservices, event-driven design, and large-scale production operations with strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities — and remains genuinely hands-on, writing production code and leading deep debugging when it matters.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & Strategy**

* Define and own the platform architecture roadmap for your domain, including the target state and a realistic path to it.
* Design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient architectures supporting high-throughput, low-latency, multi-tenant workloads.
* Establish architecture standards, design principles, decision records, and review practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and own build-versus-buy decisions with measurable outcomes.

**Platform Engineering**

* Architect and build cloud-native services and APIs that scale with global growth.
* Design service decomposition, API contracts, messaging and event-driven flows, caching strategies, and database-layer design.
* Treat multi-tenancy as a first-class design concern: isolation models, noisy-neighbour control, per-tenant limits, and cost attribution.
* Lead platform modernization — monolith decomposition, migrations, and deprecations carried through to completion.

**Reliability, Performance & Operations**

* Drive platform reliability, availability, performance optimization, and observability.
* Take ownership of complex production issues in distributed SaaS environments, leading deep root-cause analysis and implementing permanent preventive safeguards.
* Define SLOs, failure modes, resilience patterns, and capacity planning for the systems you own.

**Engineering Excellence & Quality**

* Write clean, maintainable, high-performance production code and build proof-of-concepts that settle architectural questions.
* Establish rigorous engineering standards through code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD integration.
* Identify architectural bottlenecks and technical debt, and drive practical, iterative refactoring without compromising business delivery.

**Security, Privacy & Compliance**

* Ensure platform designs and team practices align with information security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Design for tenant isolation, access control, auditability, and data residency from the outset.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide architectural guidance across multiple engineering teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.
* Mentor senior and staff engineers, raising the bar through reference implementations and sponsorship rather than authority.
* Influence engineering strategy and long-term technology investments; articulate complex trade-offs to both technical panels and executive stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience.
* 14+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or systems architecture within modern distributed SaaS environments.
* Expert-level backend engineering in Java, Python, Go, or equivalent — currently hands-on.
* Proven experience designing and operating enterprise-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, with real numbers for throughput, latency, availability, and behaviour under failure.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency and idempotency, retries and backpressure, concurrency, caching, and database design and optimization.
* Demonstrated ownership of large-scale migrations or modernization initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Advanced production debugging skills — Linux internals, profiling, log analysis, and telemetry in distributed cloud environments.
* Experience leading cross-functional architecture initiatives in SaaS or product organizations.

**Good to Have**

**Data Platform & Analytics**

* Batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, and serving architectures; streaming and CDC (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium).
* Lakehouse and modern data platform technologies such as Delta Lake, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud-native data services.
* Reusable data models, semantic layers, and curated data products enabling self-service analytics.
* Data governance practice — metadata management, cataloging, lineage, and data quality frameworks.
* Feature and training data architectures supporting AI/ML initiatives.

**Adjacent Experience**

* ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or similar analytical and search engines.
* AI-native product capabilities — RAG, agentic workflows, and LLM integration in production.
* FinOps practice: cost attribution, showback, and efficiency guardrails at platform scale.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Principal Engineer – Software Architecture and Modernization
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Lead software architecture and modernization
  
  
Shape the evolution of legacy applications into well-structured, domain-oriented software. Define target architecture, module and service boundaries, migration seams, compatibility strategies, and incremental paths that teams can implement safely.
  
  
Stay deeply hands-on in code
  
  
Contribute directly to critical implementations, prototypes, refactoring, code reviews, and production fixes. Work comfortably in backend code and frameworks such as Java/Springboot, Golang, Node/TypeScript, or similar backend ecosystems, and help teams improve application structure, runtime behavior, and maintainability.
  
  
Design strong domain models and APIs
  
  
Create clear domain abstractions, ownership boundaries, service contracts, and APIs. Improve how business rules are represented in code and keep consumers insulated from legacy storage and implementation details.
  
  
Modernize application foundations
  
  
Guide framework and runtime upgrades, dependency modernization, concurrency and lifecycle improvements, and the decomposition of tightly coupled code. Use practical refactoring strategies that keep large systems releasable throughout the work.
  
  
Engineer for correctness, performance, and reliability
  
  
Diagnose difficult behavior through code, runtime evidence, database interactions, and dependency flows. Fix root causes in implementation and design, including concurrency defects, inefficient data access, resource contention, failure propagation, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Improve data access and integration design
  
  
Move business logic out of database-centric implementations and into testable application code. Design effective persistence, transaction, caching, messaging, and event-consumer patterns while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.
  
  
Raise the bar for code quality and testing
  
  
Establish strong practices for unit, integration, contract, and functional testing. Improve code review, static analysis, dependency management, feature controls, and validation so teams can change complex software with confidence.
  
  
Create reusable engineering patterns
  
  
Turn successful designs into clear patterns, reference implementations, libraries, and architecture decisions that help teams solve recurring software problems consistently.
  
  
Turn technical strategy into cross-team execution
  
  
Translate architectural risk into clear code-level priorities, decisions, ownership, and sequenced implementation plans. Partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to move complex software initiatives from design through working code.
  
  
What This Is Not
  
  
This is not a people-management or architecture-only role. The engineer is expected to contribute directly to implementation and production outcomes.
  
  
This is not limited to greenfield design or modernization for its own sake. Decisions must balance long-term software quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.
  
  
What You Bring
  
  
Deep backend and distributed-systems engineering
  
  
You have substantial experience designing, building, operating, and evolving production backend systems, services, APIs, and distributed applications.
  
  
Credible hands-on implementation depth
  
  
You can move from architecture into code, configuration, instrumentation, and diagnosis. Exact experience with Java/Springboot or Golang or Node/Typescript is relevant, but the key here is moving ideas into shippable software solutions and not on the technology.
  
  
Service transformation and architecture judgment
  
  
You can define service boundaries, domain ownership, migration strategies, integration patterns, and practical architecture decisions for complex existing environments.
  
  
Production reliability and performance expertise
  
  
You can trace difficult behavior through application code, runtime state, database interactions, and dependency flows, then implement fixes that improve correctness, concurrency, performance, and recovery behavior.
  
  
Software design and refactoring depth
  
  
You can improve large codebases through domain modeling, modular design, dependency management, incremental refactoring, and carefully chosen abstractions. You know how to create better seams without forcing risky rewrites.
  
  
Data and integration depth
  
  
You understand relational databases, SQL behavior, messaging, event consumers, data movement, caching, and the tradeoffs involved in separating applications from legacy data dependencies.
  
  
Strong testing and code-quality discipline
  
  
You treat automated testing, code review, static analysis, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of software design—not downstream concerns.
  
  
Principal-level technical leadership
  
  
You create clarity across teams, challenge weak assumptions constructively, communicate risk in business terms, and help groups converge on decisions they can execute.
  
  
An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering
  
  
You actively look for ways AI can expand engineering leverage across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, refactoring, test generation, debugging, documentation, and planning. You help turn promising uses into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.
  
  
Bonus Points
  
  
Experience modernizing large complex software systems, including runtime and framework upgrades.
  
  
Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, or establishing modular boundaries within large existing applications.
  
  
Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.
  
  
Experience with profiling, runtime instrumentation, concurrency analysis, database-performance diagnosis, or tuning.
  
  
Experience applying AI coding agents for codebase analysis, implementation, testing, and software modernization.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Modernization advances without destabilizing the business
  
  
Critical migrations have clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, and safety controls. Teams retire legacy constraints while maintaining compatibility and operational continuity.
  
  
Critical software becomes easier to change
  
  
Codebases have clearer boundaries, stronger tests, healthier dependencies, and fewer hidden couplings. Teams can add capabilities and modernize incrementally without destabilizing unrelated behavior.
  
  
Architecture decisions become executable
  
  
Teams understand the target state, the next practical step, and the tradeoffs behind key decisions. Cross-team dependencies and risks are surfaced early and actively managed.
  
  
Engineering quality improves across the lifecycle
  
  
Test coverage, code review, static analysis, dependency health, and production validation become stronger and more consistent across the software in scope.
  
  
AI expands engineering leverage
  
  
AI becomes an effective part of how teams understand code, explore designs, implement changes, generate tests, diagnose problems, and document systems.
  
  
Why This Matters
  
  
ABC Fitness depends on critical software and data flows that must evolve without compromising the businesses and members they support. Strong architecture is valuable only when it produces clearer code, better behavior, and software that teams can continue to change.
  
  
This role connects long-term technical direction with hands-on software engineering. Done well, it will help teams reduce codebase complexity, modernize with confidence, resolve production problems at their source, and build a stronger foundation for future product development.
  
  
**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam

* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
