description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid Functional Architect role focuses on designing and optimizing S4 HANA based Order to Cash solutions that enhance revenue processes pricing strategies and logistics execution for a global organization. The architect will translate business needs in supply chain and consumer goods domains into scalable configurations that improve operational efficiency and customer experience while ensuring sustainable value delivery for the enterprise and society.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design comprehensive S4 HANA Order to Cash architectures that align with business objectives and support scalable growth across global markets while ensuring efficient integration with existing enterprise applications and data flows.
* Develop robust S4 HANA OTC Basic Info System configurations that standardize master data usage improve transactional accuracy and reduce process cycle times across sales and distribution functions.
* Configure and optimize S4 HANA Billing and Revenue processes to streamline invoicing ensure regulatory compliance and increase transparency of revenue recognition for finance and commercial stakeholders.
* Implement S4 HANA Advance Pricing solutions that support complex pricing scenarios discount structures and promotional mechanisms while improving margin visibility and profitability management for product and channel portfolios.
* Design S4 HANA Advance Order to Cash workflows that minimize order processing delays reduce manual interventions and enhance fulfillment reliability leading to improved customer satisfaction and repeat business.
* Configure S4 HANA Sales BOM structures that support bundled offerings kit management and variant handling thereby enabling flexible product strategies and better alignment with consumer goods market demands.
* Optimize S4 HANA Basic Logistic Execute capabilities to improve shipment planning picking packing and delivery confirmation processes resulting in lower logistics costs and higher service levels.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams in supply chain finance sales and operations to gather requirements validate solution designs and ensure that implemented configurations meet business expectations and performance targets.
* Conduct detailed fit gap analyses and impact assessments for S4 HANA enhancements and change requests to safeguard system stability and minimize risk to critical order management and billing operations.
* Prepare functional specifications for required developments and integrations ensuring that technical teams have clear documentation to build reliable interfaces reports and extensions that support end to end OTC processes.
* Establish governance for data quality testing and user acceptance by defining scenarios metrics and validation steps that ensure accurate transactional flows from order capture to billing and revenue reporting.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing process performance metrics identifying optimization opportunities and recommending S4 HANA configuration changes that strengthen supply chain resilience and societal value creation through reliable product availability.
* Provide structured guidance and knowledge transfer to business users and support teams through workshops documentation and process walkthroughs to build organizational capability in managing S4 HANA OTC solutions.


**Qualifications**
* Possess strong hands on expertise in S4 HANA OTC Basic Info System Billing and Revenue Advance Pricing Advance Order to Cash Sales BOM and Basic Logistic Execute with a proven record of delivering complex implementations over at least ten years.
* Demonstrate applied experience in supply chain management processes particularly in consumer goods planning order fulfillment and distribution enabling practical translation of domain requirements into effective S4 HANA designs.
* Showcase proficiency in end to end order to cash process mapping requirements elaboration and solution configuration including pricing conditions billing types account determination and logistics execution rules.
* Exhibit capability to analyze data flows troubleshoot functional issues and coordinate with technical specialists to resolve integration problems between S4 HANA and surrounding enterprise platforms.
* Display strong communication and stakeholder management skills to facilitate workshops present solution options and gain consensus on design decisions among business and technology participants.
* Bring familiarity with hybrid working models and remote collaboration tools enabling efficient coordination of design build test and deployment activities across distributed teams.
* Present evidence of structured documentation practices including configuration guides process maps and training materials to support sustainable knowledge retention and system support.


**Certifications Required**
 SAP Certified Application Associate S4HANA Sales certification or equivalent specialized S4 HANA Order to Cash credential preferred.

description:

**Position Summary**
**Lead Applied AI Platform Engineer I**
**Role Overview: As a Lead Applied AI Platform Engineer I, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. The ideal candidate will be a role\-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Outcome\-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering\-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per\-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high\-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low\-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.

Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy\-as\-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry\-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift\-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high\-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability\-by\-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Customer\-Centric Engineering: Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption\-validated increments rather than big\-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible\-by\-design and submit them for admission, co\-defining service\-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy\-as\-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self\-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use\-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance\-as\-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co\-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.


**The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.**
**The successful candidate will possess:**
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.


**Required Qualifications:**
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 6\+ years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C\#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing frameworks \& tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

title: AI Architect
description:
**AI Architect** 

*Enterprise AI \| Generative AI \| Agentic AI \| Cloud Architecture \| Hyderabad* 




 Generative AI and agentic systems are moving from pilots to the core of how enterprises operate — and Tachyon Technologies is where that shift is being architected. We're looking for a senior AI Architect who wants to own that transformation end to end: designing the systems, setting the standards, and seeing solutions run in production at enterprise scale, not just in a slide deck.
 



 This is a role for someone who has already done real cloud architecture, has since built genuine depth in LLMs, RAG, and agentic design, and wants a platform where that combination is the whole job — not a side project bolted onto something else.
 


**What You Will Do** 
* Architect end\-to\-end enterprise AI solutions spanning applications, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, integrations, and user experience.
* Design and lead Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, enterprise search, tool/function calling, and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Define cloud\-native architectures for AI workloads on Azure, AWS, and/or GCP using managed AI services, containers, Kubernetes, and serverless patterns.
* Evaluate and select models, frameworks, vector databases, and cloud services against business, security, performance, and cost requirements.
* Design integrations between AI solutions and enterprise platforms — Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, ERP/CRM, data platforms, and external APIs.
* Create architecture blueprints, reference patterns, reusable components, and technical standards for AI delivery.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, design reviews, and proof\-of\-concept initiatives with engineering and customer teams.
* Define AI evaluation and observability approaches — grounding, accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, and safety.
* Establish guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, identity and access models, and Responsible AI practices.
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, and help build strong architecture practice across AI initiatives.
  


**What You Bring** 
* 15\+ years in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or cloud architecture, with recent hands\-on technical work.
* A production GenAI or Agentic AI system you've personally architected and shipped — not a POC — using LLMs, RAG, tool/function calling, or multi\-agent orchestration.
* Deep, hands\-on cloud architecture experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP; multi\-cloud experience is a strong plus.
* Working fluency with modern AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Strong software engineering foundation with hands\-on programming, preferably Python, and the ability to review implementation\-level decisions.
* Solid grounding in microservices, REST APIs, event\-driven architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with relational, NoSQL, and vector data platforms, and designing data/knowledge access patterns for AI.
* Excellent communication — equally comfortable with engineering teams and business/technology leaders.
  


**Also Great to Have** 
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation), CI/CD, and production support practices.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI/Gemini.
* Cloud architecture certification from Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Experience building reusable AI platforms, accelerators, or enterprise AI capabilities.
* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), knowledge graphs, or advanced enterprise search.
* Background in customer\-facing architecture, solutioning, or technical consulting.
  


**Why Tachyon** 
* Own architecture decisions on high\-visibility enterprise AI programs, from first workshop to production rollout.
* Work at the intersection of deep cloud engineering and cutting\-edge agentic AI — not one at the expense of the other.
* Shape reusable patterns and standards that other architects and engineers will build on.
* Direct exposure to customer stakeholders and technology leadership, with real influence over technical direction.

title: Software Development Engineer 2
description:
**About the Role** 




 LivSYT is building an AI\-native engineering platform that automates complex infrastructure design \- from engineering calculations and 3D/CAD models to drawings and downstream project workflows.
 



 We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build the platform layer connecting our CAD/geometry engine, AI systems and cloud infrastructure.
 **This is not a conventional CRUD/API development role.** 
 You will work on large engineering models, distributed computation, real\-time collaboration, versioning, multi\-user concurrency and secure enterprise deployments. You will have significant ownership over architecture and technical decisions as the platform scales globally.
 



  
 



**What You Will Own** 



* Design and build high\-performance backend services using Python, FastAPI and asynchronous programming.
* Architect APIs and distributed services connecting CAD/geometry engines, AI agents and cloud services.
* Build systems for processing and managing large engineering/CAD models and binary files, including DWG, IFC and BREP workflows.
* Design real\-time multi\-user collaboration: concurrency, versioning, locking, conflict resolution and recovery.
* Build event\-driven and asynchronous workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS or equivalent systems.
* Design scalable data architectures using PostgreSQL, Redis and object storage such as S3\.
* Own performance, observability, reliability and production troubleshooting for cloud\-native services on AWS.
* Design secure multi\-tenant architecture including RBAC/ABAC, auditability, encryption and enterprise data isolation.
* Build and improve CI/CD for backend services using Git, Docker and modern deployment pipelines.
* Work directly with CAD, AI, frontend and product engineers to take systems from architecture through production.



  
 



**What We Are Looking For** 




**Must have** 



* 5\+ years building production backend or platform systems.
* Excellent Python fundamentals and production experience with FastAPI, Django, Flask or another modern Python backend framework.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, distributed systems and service\-oriented architecture.
* Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals: schema design, transactions, indexing and query optimization.
* Experience with event/message systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS.
* Production experience with AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker and CI/CD.
* Strong system\-design ability and experience diagnosing performance, scalability and reliability problems in production.
* Evidence of owning systems end\-to\-end \- not only implementing tickets.



**Strong advantage** 



* Experience with large\-file or binary\-data processing.
* WebSockets, collaborative editing, distributed locking, version\-control or other real\-time systems.
* Kubernetes, ECS or EKS and production observability tooling.
* CAD, GIS, gaming engines, simulation, geometry or 3D systems.
* AI/LLM infrastructure, agent integration or model\-serving workflows.
* Enterprise multi\-tenant SaaS, permissions, security and audit systems.



**The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here** 



* You enjoy hard systems problems and can move between architecture, code, debugging and production.
* You make pragmatic trade\-offs between speed, scalability and engineering quality.
* You can challenge an architecture constructively and then take ownership of the solution.
* You are comfortable working closely with domain engineers, product leaders and other senior engineers.
* You want to build core technology rather than maintain a mature legacy platform.



**Why LivSYT** 



* Work at the intersection of CAD, AI and distributed cloud systems.
* Build software that helps automate how major physical infrastructure is designed and delivered.
* Own meaningful parts of the core platform while the architecture is still being built.
* Work directly with senior engineering and product leadership with substantial technical autonomy.
* See your systems used on real\-world transportation and data\-center engineering workflows.



  
 



**Technology Environment** 




**Python / FastAPI \| PostgreSQL / Redis \| Kafka / async workers \| AWS / S3 / RDS / ECS \| Docker / CI/CD \| CAD \& geometry services \| AI services** 




  
 



**Location** 




**Hyderabad \- Work from Office** 
 . This is a hands\-on product engineering role with close collaboration across the CAD, AI, backend, frontend and product teams.
 



  
 



**About LivSYT** 




 LivSYT builds AI\-powered software for the engineering and construction ecosystem. Our platform connects engineering design, digital workflows, project controls and automation to help infrastructure and data\-center teams move from fragmented, memory\-dependent processes toward software\-driven engineering and execution.
 



  
 



*LivSYT is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: ITSM Solutions Architect
description:
**ITSM Solutions Architect** 




 Department: Information Technology
 



 Location: Kondapur, Hyderabad, India
 



 Work Mode: Work From Office – 5 Days a Week
 



 Shift Timings: 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time, Permanent
 



 Reports To: IT Operations Manager / Director of IT Infrastructure \& Operations
 



**Position Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced ITSM Solutions Architect – Service Desk Plus Enterprise with 8\+ years of experience in IT Service Management, ITSM platforms, service desk operations, and enterprise ITSM solution design.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in Service Desk Plus Enterprise or comparable enterprise ITSM platforms, with proven experience designing and implementing scalable ITSM solutions, optimizing ITIL processes, configuring workflows and automation, integrating enterprise applications, and driving continuous service improvement.
 



 This role will serve as a technical and process architect, working closely with IT Operations, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Application, Security, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable ITSM solutions aligned with organizational objectives, ITIL best practices, governance, compliance, and operational standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* ITSM Solution Architecture \& Design
* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise\-scale ITSM solutions using Service Desk Plus Enterprise or similar ITSM platforms.
* Define scalable, sustainable, and standardized ITSM platform architecture aligned with business and operational requirements.
* Conduct process reviews, discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and stakeholder consultations to identify service management needs.
* Translate business and technical requirements into effective ITSM processes, workflows, service models, and platform solutions.
* Develop solution designs, workflow diagrams, process documentation, and technical specifications.
* Establish platform standards, configuration guidelines, governance processes, and best practices.
* Lead process reviews and stakeholder governance meetings to evaluate service performance, process effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.



**Service Desk Plus Enterprise Configuration** 



* Configure, administer, and maintain Service Desk Plus Enterprise modules, including:
* Incident Management
* Request Management
* Change Management
* Problem Management
* Asset Management
* Service Catalog
* CMDB
* Design and optimize request templates, categories, forms, business rules, approval processes, user roles, escalation paths, notifications, and SLAs.
* Configure service workflows and automation rules to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Design and maintain Service Catalog structures and self\-service capabilities.
* Ensure platform configurations are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with organizational standards.



**Workflow Automation \& Orchestration** 



* Design and implement workflow automation, orchestration, and self\-service capabilities across ITSM processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive service desk and IT operations activities.
* Develop automated approval, assignment, escalation, notification, and fulfillment workflows.
* Evaluate and implement automation capabilities that improve ticket resolution, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency.
* Support integration of AI\-enabled service management features, chatbots, virtual assistants, and predictive analytics where applicable.
* Continuously evaluate emerging ITSM automation capabilities and recommend improvements.



**ITIL Process Management** 



* Design, implement, and optimize ITIL\-aligned processes covering:
* Incident Management
* Request Fulfillment
* Change Management
* Problem Management
* Asset Management
* Configuration Management
* Service Level Management


- 


**Enterprise Integrations \& API Architecture** 



* Design and support enterprise application integrations between the ITSM platform and other business and technology systems.
* Define API and automation design strategies for integrating Service Desk Plus with enterprise applications.
* Work with REST APIs, web services, and other integration technologies as applicable.
* Support integrations with systems such as HRIS, ERP, identity platforms, monitoring tools, endpoint management platforms, collaboration tools, and other enterprise applications.
* Define integration requirements, data flows, authentication methods, error handling, and monitoring processes.
* Ensure integrations are secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable.



**CMDB \& Configuration Management** 



* Define and maintain Configuration Management Database (CMDB) concepts, standards, and governance.
* Support identification and management of Configuration Items (CIs), relationships, dependencies, and ownership.
* Establish processes for maintaining accurate and reliable configuration data.
* Integrate CMDB information with Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and other ITSM processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve configuration data quality and visibility across the enterprise.



**Reporting, Analytics \& Performance Management** 



* Analyze ITSM data and develop reports, dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and service performance metrics.
* Monitor SLA compliance, ticket volumes, backlog health, resolution trends, recurring incidents, and service performance.
* Provide data\-driven insights to IT leadership and stakeholders.
* Identify trends and process bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.
* Support predictive analytics and AI\-enabled reporting capabilities where applicable.



**Governance, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Establish and maintain ITSM platform governance, configuration standards, and compliance controls.
* Ensure ITSM processes align with organizational policies, ITIL best practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support audits by maintaining accurate ITSM records, process documentation, configuration documentation, and governance evidence.
* Identify opportunities for ITSM transformation and continuous improvement.
* Develop roadmaps for platform enhancements, automation, integrations, and process maturity.
* Evaluate existing processes and recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, user experience, service quality, and operational control.



**Implementation, Testing \& Production Support** 




**Lead ITSM platform enhancement initiatives through the complete lifecycle:** 



* Requirements Gathering
* Process Analysis
* Solution Design
* Configuration
* Development
* Testing
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Deployment
* Production Support
* Continuous Optimization
* Develop test plans and validate configuration changes before production deployment.
* Coordinate release and change activities with relevant technical teams.
* Troubleshoot complex platform, workflow, integration, and configuration issues.
* Provide technical guidance and support for production incidents related to the ITSM platform.



**Stakeholder Management \& Consulting** 



* Collaborate with Service Desk, IT Operations, Infrastructure, Application, Security, and business teams to understand requirements and deliver effective ITSM solutions.
* Lead stakeholder workshops and requirements\-gathering sessions.
* Provide consulting and recommendations on ITSM process design, platform capabilities, automation, and governance.
* Communicate complex technical and process concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Lead stakeholder governance meetings and provide updates on platform performance, initiatives, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Work independently while managing multiple priorities and cross\-functional initiatives.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT Service Management, Service Desk Operations, IT Operations, ITSM platform administration, or ITSM solution architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Service Desk Plus Enterprise or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale ITSM solutions.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL processes and service management best practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher – Mandatory.
* Strong experience with ITSM workflow configuration, automation, SLA management, reporting, and dashboards.
* Experience with enterprise application integrations, API design, automation, Service Catalog, and CMDB concepts.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and process optimization skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong stakeholder management and consulting abilities.
* Advanced ITIL certification.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working in healthcare, government, financial services, or other regulated environments.
* Experience with Service Desk Plus Enterprise architecture and large\-scale implementations.
* Experience with ITSM transformation and service management maturity initiatives.
* Experience implementing workflow automation, orchestration, and self\-service solutions.
* Knowledge of AI\-enabled ITSM, chatbot/virtual\-agent integrations, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation.



**Key Competencies** 



* ITSM Solutions Architecture
* Enterprise ITSM Platform Architecture
* Service Desk Plus Enterprise
* ITIL Process Management
* Incident, Request, Change \& Problem Management
* ITSM Process Analysis \& Optimization
* Workflow \& Automation Configuration
* Workflow Automation \& Orchestration
* Service Catalog Design
* Configuration Management \& CMDB
* Asset Management
* SLA \& Service Performance Management
* Reporting, Dashboards \& Data Analytics
* Enterprise Application Integrations
* API \& Automation Design
* ITSM Transformation \& Continuous Improvement
* Platform Governance \& Compliance
* Solution Design \& Technical Documentation
* Stakeholder Consulting \& Requirements Gathering
* Process Reviews \& Governance
* Excellent Communication \& Presentation Skills
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills

description:
****Job Description****
**Specialist, Process Data Engineering**
**The Opportunity**
 Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
   

  

 Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
   

  

 This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 As a Process Data Engineer, you are the technical architect of our global Process Intelligence and AI initiatives. Your primary focus is constructing robust data pipelines that ingest transactional data from diverse enterprise systems (SAP, Veeva, Appian, ServiceNow) into an advanced, object\-centric process data model. Operating within an Agile framework, you will manage the end\-to\-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) of these models, leveraging them to build predictive machine learning models and deploy process\-aware AI agents that enable autonomous execution management across the enterprise.
   

  

****What Will You Do In This Role****
* Data Pipeline Engineering Architect and manage highly scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract raw event logs and transactional data from core organisation systems (SAP, Veeva Vault/CRM, Appian, Oracle).
* Process Data Architecture Design and implement Object\-Centric Data Models. Define custom entity types and relationships rather than relying on flat, single\-case event logs to build a dynamic Process Digital Twin.
* Agile Delivery \& SDLC Operate within an Agile Scrum methodology. Translate business requirements into technical user stories, participate in sprint rituals, and manage strict SDLC code promotion (Dev, QA, Prod) for all data models and AI applications.
* AI \& Agentic Orchestration Develop and deploy process\-aware AI agents and automated action flows. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) to create "Process Copilots" that allow business users to query operational data using natural language.
* Predictive Process Monitoring Implement Machine Learning models (using Python/R) on top of the process data graph to predict process delays, compliance risks, and operational bottlenecks before they occur.
* IT Governance \& AI Ethics Ensure all pipelines, AI integrations, and deployments strictly comply with our Information Technology policies, GxP standards, and corporate AI ethics guidelines using robust version control and CI/CD pipelines.


****What Should You Have****
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or quantitative field (Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering).
* 3 to 6 years of experience in Data Engineering.


****Required Skills****
* Database \& Cloud Engineering Expert\-level SQL and data modeling. Deep understanding of relational databases, data warehousing, and handling multi\-terabyte datasets.
* Process Platform Expertise Extensive hands\-on experience with leading Enterprise Process Mining platforms, specifically dealing with multi\-object graphing and execution management.
* Agile \& SDLC Methodologies Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Proficiency with Jira/Confluence for sprint tracking, and Git/Bitbucket for version control and managing release branches.
* Applied AI \& Machine Learning Experience building predictive models applied to time\-series or event log data. Proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch) and LLM API integrations.
* Source System Knowledge Strong understanding of underlying database schemas and APIs for Veeva (Vault/CRM), Appian, and SAP.


****Primary Skills (Must Have)****
* SQL
* Data modeling
* Process Mining
* Spark SQL
* Agile SDLC
* Git
* Python
* Process Engineering/Modeling


****Secondary Skills (Nice To Have)****
* SDLC Architecture \& Agile Leadership Proven ability to design robust CI/CD pipelines specifically for process data models and AI agents. Experience participating in backlog grooming, sprint planning, and cross\-functional Agile delivery.
* AI\-Driven Digital Twin Architecture Ability to structure the object\-centric data model specifically so it can serve as a highly accurate, real\-time knowledge base (RAG foundation) for enterprise AI agents.
* Business\-to\-Technical Data Mapping Ability to translate functional business workflows (e.g., Order\-to\-Cash, IT Service Management, Clinical Operations) directly into backend table schemas.
* SAP ECC \& SAP HANA Mastery Deep architectural understanding of core SAP data structures (e.g., VBAK/VBAP, EKKO/EKPO, BKPF/BSEG) and how they evolve between ECC and S/4HANA environments.
* ServiceNow \& Veeva Architecture Thorough understanding of the ServiceNow Task table architecture and Veeva Vault/CRM object models.


****Who We Are****
 We are known as well\-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. title: Senior Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect to design, implement, and support real\-time and near real\-time data replication and CDC solutions using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters.
   

  

 The role will focus on homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms, with particular emphasis on Oracle and SQL Server migrations to Snowflake using Oracle GoldenGate Big Data DAA Adapters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade Oracle GoldenGate replication, CDC, and migration architectures.
* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and administer Oracle GoldenGate Microservices components, including Extract, Replicat, Distribution Service, Receiver Service, Service Manager, trails, checkpoints, and credential stores.
* Configure Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters and DAA connectors for Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data lake integrations.
* Implement initial load, continuous synchronization, and CDC MERGE patterns for migrations into Snowflake.
* Support homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms.
* Monitor replication latency, throughput, and availability; troubleshoot capture, delivery, trail, and performance issues.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technical designs, deployment standards, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Support migration planning, cutover, rollback, incident resolution, and production support activities.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Oracle GoldenGate implementation, administration, and production support experience.
* Strong expertise in Oracle GoldenGate 19c, 21c, and 23ai, including Microservices Architecture, Integrated Extract, Classic Extract, Integrated Replicat, Parallel Replicat, Coordinated Replicat, and Big Data Adapters.
* Experience with Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong understanding of CDC, heterogeneous replication, data migration, high availability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Snowflake ingestion patterns including stage\-based loading, continuous replication, and MERGE\-based CDC processing.
* Good knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, data lake, and Lakehouse architecture concepts.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration, shell scripting, SQL, Python, and automation skills.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 A senior data integration specialist capable of leading enterprise CDC and migration initiatives using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Big Data DAA Connectors, with a strong focus on secure, scalable, high\-availability replication into Snowflake and other modern analytics platforms.

* Software Engineering \& APIs: Solid experience with REST APIs, Git version control, unit testing, and basic CI/CD practices
* Workflow \& Process Automation: Experience automating workflows using Python orchestration, low\-code automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath), or enterprise schedulers
* Exposure to Deployment \& Cloud: Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker) for deploying scripts and API services


 Strong to have:
   

  

* Prompt Architecture \& Validation: Ability to design complex, multi\-step prompts; validate outputs against business logic; and refine solutions iteratively
* Regulatory Domain Knowledge: Foundational knowledge of ICH guidelines FDA/EMA submission processes, regulatory document formats (eCTD, GxP guidelines, CT documentation), emerging AI/ML regulatory guidance

title: Engineering Manager, Financial Services
description:
**About Tide**
 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
   

  

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
   

  

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
   

  

**Tide Facts**
* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg


**About The Role**
 As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you’re an experienced Full Stack Engineering Leader with strong people\-management skills, comfortable operating at scale and driving impact through well\-designed platforms.
   

  

 In this critical role, you will lead a cross\-functional engineering team (comprising Backend, Mobile, and Web engineers) and partner closely with Product Management to own and lead our global In\-Person Acquiring products.
   

  

 In\-Person payments currently account for a significant majority (65%\+) of our Acquiring revenue in key markets, making this a highly visible, high\-impact domain. You will own the technical direction and end\-to\-end execution of systems that power our in\-house ePOS solutions, Tap to Pay technologies, cross\-platform mobile apps, and complex pricing engines. You will oversee the maintenance of highly reliable live products while leading the architectural strategy for critical third\-party vendor integrations and hardware partnerships. Additionally, you will drive major platform transformation initiatives and lead the engineering scaling of localized payment networks (such as QR/UPI) across international markets, alongside rollout toolkits for our European expansion.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
* Full Stack Leadership: Proven track record directly managing, coaching, and developing cross\-functional teams of Backend, Mobile, and Web engineers.
* Technical Depth \& T\-Shaped Leadership: A platform\- and tech stack\-agnostic engineering leader who is an expert in at least one core domain/platform (e.g., backend or mobile), with the proven ability to translate those core software engineering principles to guide, mentor, and architect solutions across other platforms in a T\-shaped leadership model. Extensive experience building robust applications, server\-side engineering, mobile app deployment architecture, and scalable system design.
* Domain Expertise: Experience in FinTech, specifically within Acquiring, In\-Person Payments, ePOS systems, or payment gateway integrations is highly desirable.
* Architecture \& Scale: Experience engineering scalable, reliable solutions in a cloud\-native environment, managing microservices, and implementing RESTful APIs and event\-driven systems.
* Partner Integrations: Proven experience designing systems that seamlessly integrate with complex third\-party vendors, hardware providers, and external payment networks.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Full ownership of technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, championing engineering best practices from development and testing to production deployment and monitoring.
* Strategic Execution: A technical, hands\-on leader who can guide architecture decisions, translate complex product strategy into reliable platform solutions, and communicate technical concepts seamlessly to stakeholders.


**Our Tech Stack**
* Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
* Event\-driven architecture with messages over SNS\+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
* Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
* Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
* DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
* GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines \- new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
* Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
* Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust \+ some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management


**What You’ll Get In Return**
* Competitive Compensation \- competitive salary and share options
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top\-up options.
* Life \& Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering \& Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning \& Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks \& Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).


**Tidean Ways of Working**
 At Tide, we’re Member First and Data Driven, but above all, we’re One Team. Our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy allows you to work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days a year. We are remote first, but when you do want to meet new people, collaborate with your team or simply hang out with your colleagues, our offices are always available and equipped to the highest standard. We offer flexible working hours and trust our employees to do their work well, at times that suit them and their team.
   

  

 TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
   

  

 At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently\-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
   

  

 We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
   

  

*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*
**Disclaimer**
 It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That
   

  

* Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
* All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
* Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
* Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.


*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
   

  

 Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*
**Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.**
**Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with* 
*Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice* 
*.**

title: Software Architect – Defence and Mission-Critical Systems
description:
**Software Architect – Defence and Mission\-Critical Systems** 




**Experience: 10–15 years** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time, permanent** 




**Industry: Defence, Naval and Mission\-Critical Systems** 




**Drop Resume:** 
 ta@matrixst.in
 








**Role Summary:** 




  





**We are seeking a senior, hands\-on Software Architect to lead the architecture, development, integration and delivery of mission\-critical defence software products.** 




  





**The candidate must have proven experience working with Battle Management Systems, Combat Management Systems, C4I platforms. The role requires direct experience integrating military sensors, effectors, communication systems and platform equipment into operational software.** 




**The architect will own the software product from system requirements and architecture through development, integration, qualification, customer acceptance and operational deployment.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**• Define the end\-to\-end architecture for mission\-critical defence and shipboard software products.** 




**• Convert operational and system requirements into software requirements, interface specifications and verifiable architecture.** 




**• Lead the integration of military sensors, RF, EOIR, Radars, communication equipment with weapon interfaces and other platform subsystems.** 




**• Design distributed, real\-time and fault\-tolerant applications for command, control and situational\-awareness systems.** 




**• Establish software architecture principles, coding standards, interface standards and engineering processes.** 




**• Ensure bidirectional traceability between system requirements, software requirements, design, source code and verification results.** 




**• Prepare and review Software Development Plans, Software Quality Assurance Plans, Interface Control Documents, Verification and Validation Plans and software release documentation.** 




**• Solid Understanding of STANAG, DEF STAN, IEEE and NATO interoperability requirements.** 




**• Support software safety assessment, hazard analysis, design assurance and preparation of certification evidence.** 




**• Architect the integration and deployment of machine\-learning models within operational software.** 




**• Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews and technical risk assessments.** 




**• Take responsibility for product performance, reliability, cybersecurity, maintainability and long\-term support.** 




  





**Mandatory Defence and Standards Experience.** 




  





**The candidate must have practical experience with:** 




**•  Battle Management Systems, Combat Management Systems \& C4I Platforms** 




**•  Capability to interpret, develop and implement Interface Control Documents (ICDs)** 
 for integrating military sensors, equipment and external subsystems
 



 •  
 **DEF STAN 00\-55** 
 – Safety of Programmable Elements in Defence Systems.
 



 •  D
 **EF STAN 00\-56** 
 – Safety Management Requirements for Defence Systems.
 



 •  IEEE/ISO/IEC 12207 software lifecycle processes.
 



 •  Software Quality Assurance Plans, configuration management plans and certification documentation.
 



 •  Requirements traceability, design assurance, verification and validation.
 



 •  Relevant STANAGs and NATO interoperability standards.
 



 •  Preparing objective evidence for audits, qualification and customer acceptance.
 



 Experience with DEF STAN 00\-40, DEF STAN 00\-42 and DEF STAN 00\-600 is desirable.
 



 Software Architecture and Engineering Skills
 



 •  Strong architecture experience with distributed, event\-driven and real\-time software systems.
 



 •  Strong programming experience in C\+\+ and/or Java or C\#, with working knowledge of Python.
 



 •  Linux\-based application development, system services, process management and performance optimization.
 



 • Multithreading, concurrency, inter\-process communication and deterministic data processing.
 



 • Network programming using TCP/IP, UDP, multicast, serial communication and message\-oriented middleware.
 



 • Strong understanding of design patterns, modular architecture, service\-oriented architecture and microservices where operationally appropriate.
 



 • High availability, redundancy, failover, health monitoring and graceful degradation.
 



 • Secure coding, authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging and cybersecurity hardening.
 



 • Offline and disconnected operations in bandwidth\-constrained defence environments.
 



  





**Machine\-Learning Skills** 




  





**• Experience integrating computer vision, detection, classification, tracking or decision\-support models into production products.** 




**• Model conversion and optimized inference using ONNX and hardware\-specific inference engines.** 




**• Deployment on GPU and edge\-computing platforms.** 




**• Understanding of model validation, dataset versioning, performance benchmarking and inference monitoring.** 




**• Ability to define controlled fallback behaviour when an ML model produces uncertain or invalid results.** 




**• Experience maintaining traceability between model versions, datasets, software releases and operational performance.** 




**Development and Engineering Tools** 




**The candidate should have hands\-on experience with:** 




**• Containers: Docker and container orchestration where appropriate.** 




**• Dynamic analysis: Valgrind, sanitizers, profiling and memory\-analysis tools.** 




**• Interface testing: Wireshark, protocol simulators, equipment emulators and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test environments.** 




**• Observability: Structured logging, and system\-health monitoring.** 




**• Documentation: Controlled requirements, architecture, interface, test and release documentation with complete traceability.** 




**• ML lifecycle: MLflow, DVC or equivalent model and dataset version\-control tools.** 




  





**Qualifications:** 




  





**• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.** 




**• Minimum 10 years of direct software product engineering and delivery experience.** 




**• Demonstrated ownership of at least one complete mission\-critical or defence software product lifecycle.** 




**• Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across software, electronics, systems engineering, testing and field integration.** 




**• Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with customers, certification authorities, military users and equipment OEMs.** 




**Mandatory Eligibility Conditions** 




**• Candidates with less than 10 years of relevant software product delivery experience will not be considered.** 




**• Consultants, independent advisors and candidates with predominantly consulting or advisory experience will not be considered.** 




**• The candidate must demonstrate direct, hands\-on responsibility for architecture, engineering, integration, qualification and operational delivery of software products.** 




**•           General enterprise IT architecture experience without defence, naval, industrial control or comparable mission\-critical product experience will not meet the requirements of this position.**

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Location**
 HYDERABAD OFFICE INDIA PSC PGH
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Family Summary:
   

  

 P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.
   

  

**Dedication from Us:** 
 You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.
   

  

**What we Offer:** 
 Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the center, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.
   

  

 The Data Architecture job family involves leading the data design for an application, solution, or business domain, helping to define how data will flow, and be stored and structured.
   

  

 We are looking for an Architect to join our Supply Chain Innovation organization and lead the design of enterprise\-scale Generative AI solutions that run on top of P\&G's data platform. At P\&G, AI is not a standalone experiment — it is an operational interface over the data that runs our business, from supply chain and vendor systems to retail distribution and consumer insights. In this role you will own the architecture for how our AI systems retrieve, reason over, and act on enterprise data, working hands\-on while setting the standards other engineering teams build against. This is an exciting opportunity for a self\-motivated architect who enjoys solving complex technical problems and delivering high\-impact global solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end architecture for enterprise GenAI solutions — retrieval, orchestration, integration, and evaluation — ensuring they are scalable, secure, and aligned to business outcomes.
* Design production retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures over enterprise data, including document ingestion and chunking, indexing strategy, hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Architect multi\-phase agent and tool\-calling workflows with deterministic guardrails — scoped tool access, structured output schemas, validation, bounded retries, explicit completion contracts, and fallback handling — so that non\-deterministic models meet production reliability standards.
* Design the data ingestion and synchronization foundations that support AI grounding — streaming and change data capture from enterprise sources, canonical data models, and incremental sync that keeps indexes and downstream systems current.
* Enforce data governance and strict multi\-tenant isolation boundaries across brands, regions, and partners, applying access control, PII protection, and Responsible AI principles by default.
* Establish evaluation and observability standards for AI workloads — curated test sets, automated quality scoring including model\-based judging, regression suites in CI/CD, and end\-to\-end tracing of model behavior in production.
* Own the operational economics of AI systems: latency and throughput targets, inference and token cost management, caching strategies, and routing work to the appropriate model for the task.
* Act as the principal technical authority for AI architecture — lead design reviews, resolve complex performance and integration issues, mentor engineers, and champion Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.


 Ideal Candidate:
   

  

* A hands\-on architect who can independently design end\-to\-end solutions while remaining active in development, code review, and production problem\-solving.
* Treats AI systems as distributed data systems — designs for failure, latency, duplication, and drift rather than assuming the happy path.
* Collaborative and self\-motivated, able to work across global teams, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.


**About Us**
 We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
   

  

 Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor
   

  

**Job Qualifications**
 Job Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on architecture and technical leadership of large\-scale, multi\-tenant, or high\-throughput platforms.
* Hands\-on experience designing and delivering production Generative AI solutions — retrieval\-augmented generation, LLM\-based classification and extraction, or multi\-phase agent workflows — including the schema validation, guardrails, and fallback logic that make them dependable.
* Proven experience architecting orchestration layers for distributed systems — event\-driven and streaming pipelines, workflow and state management, idempotency, bounded retries, and recovery from partial failure — and applying the same discipline to AI and agent workflows.
* Strong grounding in search and retrieval: inverted indexes and lexical relevance scoring, vector and semantic similarity, hybrid retrieval and rank fusion, re\-ranking, and the effect of data freshness on retrieval quality.
* Experience defining quality and evaluation practices for probabilistic systems — curated test sets, regression suites, automated and model\-based scoring of output quality, and production tracing.
* Experience integrating heterogeneous enterprise systems and data sources at scale across streaming, API, and file\-based patterns, with strong data modeling and schema governance instincts.
* programming skills in at least one backend language (Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or similar), with hands\-on experience across document and relational data stores.
* Cloud\-native engineering experience (Azure) with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability as default practice.
* Ability to lead technical design discussions, drive solution decisions, and operate as a hands\-on technical lead within cross\-functional and global teams.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


 Preferred: Working knowledge of modern lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and medallion data architectures; familiarity with AI governance, guardrails, and evaluation tooling; experience integrating enterprise systems; experience designing for regulated or highly sensitive data environments.
   

  

**Job Schedule**
 Full time
   

  

**Job Number**
 R000159260
   

  

**Job Segmentation**

title: Software Development Manager, FinTech General Ledger
description:
**Description**
 We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems — the mission\-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi\-year financial transformation: re\-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond.
   

  

 You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle — spanning sub\-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration — delivering high\-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale.
   

  

 This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re\-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end — close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target\-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in large\-scale distributed systems, preferably a background in financial or ERP systems, and a proven ability to lead teams through ambiguous, high\-stakes transformation while keeping production healthy. You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long\-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation\-first solutions.
   

  

 If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger — modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self\-healing future state — we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead architecture, design, and delivery of GL and close systems, making technical decisions that balance near\-term reliability with the long\-term target state
* Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for your team, working backwards from FGBS customer needs and the broader GL modernization program
* Guide your team through system and process transformation — sequencing migration, modernization, and automation work while protecting the integrity and timeliness of every close
* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of software engineers, fostering a culture of automation\-first thinking and technical excellence
* Own operational metrics and system health for GL and close systems, establishing mechanisms to monitor progress and drive continuous improvement
* Partner with finance, controllership, and product teams to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, creating clear career paths and coaching that helps your team grow
* Champion automation and rapid iteration, continuously eliminating manual touchpoints to shorten Amazon's financial close timeline


**About The Team**
 We are the engineering organization behind Amazon's General Ledger and month\-end close — one of the most complex and high\-stakes financial processes in the company. Our teams own the timely and accurate closure of sub\-ledgers and the General Ledger, ensuring that approximately 900 million transactions per month are accounted for with precision, along with the foundational GL functions — ledger setups, posting and recurring schedules, journal processing, and close orchestration — that keep Amazon's financial engine running.
   

  

 What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization. We are actively building the next generation of Amazon's General Ledger and redesigning the close processes around it, with the goal of a faster, more resilient, and ultimately touchless close. Every sprint moves us closer to that future state — and this role helps lead the way there.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

description:
**Job Description**
 At Verisk, we are seeking an experienced and self\-driven Newgen ONE Implementation Specialist to independently deliver end\-to\-end implementations of the Newgen ONE platform. This expert\-level role is ideal for someone with deep knowledge of Newgen ONE and IBPS, strong Java development skills, and experience across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), from architecture to deployment.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the complete technical lifecycle of implementation projects—from requirements gathering to solution delivery. This includes workflow automation, web service integration, Okta configuration, and deployment automation using CI/CD. The ideal candidate thrives in an independent role with minimal supervision, confidently managing complex technical workstreams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Independently execute full lifecycle Newgen ONE implementations from the ground up, ensuring on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Lead all aspects of project architecture including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Configure and customize Newgen ONE workflows, forms, ECM, and case management modules at an expert level.
* Integrate Newgen ONE with third\-party systems using RESTful web services and Java.

* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins to ensure streamlined deployment and environment management.

* Proactively identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and issues throughout all phases of delivery.
* Prepare technical documentation, conduct knowledge transfers, and provide end\-user training as needed.
* Collaborate with business analysts, QA engineers, and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and code reviews, promoting continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* 8\-12\+ years of overall IT experience.
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on experience with the Newgen IBPS platform.
* 2\-3 years of independent implementation experience with Newgen ONE projects.
* Deep understanding of Newgen ONE APIs for workflows, DMS, queue management, and forms.
* Strong expertise in OmniDocs advanced features, including versioning and document workflows.
* Proficiency in Java and RESTful web service integration.
* Experience with Jenkins build pipelines and Newgen Deployment Manager.
* Familiarity with case management, workflow automation, and ECM best practices.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies and the full SDLC.

title: OT Security Architect
description:
India, Hyderabad
   

  

**OT Security Architect**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Summary**
 The OT Security Architect is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and strengthening the security architecture of IT and Operational Technology (OT) solutions across on\-premises, cloud, and integration environments. The role ensures that systems are designed and implemented according to security standards, hardening guidelines, and industry best practices. By supporting project teams during design and build phases, the OT Security Architect helps ensure secure implementation from the outset, while adapting controls to the unique operational constraints and risk profiles of OT environments. The position also contributes to improving technical documentation practices and promotes secure development principles throughout the lifecycle.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Security Architecture Reviews**
* Conduct Security Architecture Reviews for new and existing IT and OT solutions, including infrastructure, cloud (Azure), applications, and integrations
* Assess and validate security controls for solution architectures (authentication, logging, encryption, API security, secure integration patterns)
* Identify security risks and recommend mitigation measures to ensure solutions meet required protection levels before deployment


**Project \& Solution Support**
* Provide security guidance to project teams during design and build phases, ensuring security\-by\-design principles are applied
* Review integrations and APIs to ensure secure data exchange and appropriate protection mechanisms for services and external connections
* Evaluate and recommend security measures tailored to operational constraints and risk profiles of OT environments


**Secure Development Practices**
* Provide guidance on secure coding principles and application security controls
* Promote secure handling of data within applications and services
* Support teams in adopting secure development practices across the lifecycle


**Documentation \& Collaboration**
* Assist teams in producing clear and accurate technical architecture documentation, including diagrams
* Provide guidance, tools, or automation to improve documentation quality
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure security concepts are clearly communicated and understood


**Critical Job Requirements**
* OT Security Fundamentals: Understanding of industrial systems (ICS/SCADA) and their risks
* Security Architecture: Ability to design/review IT and industrial system architectures and identify security risks
* Network Segmentation: Expertise in securing boundaries between IT and OT environments using firewalls and secure connectivity
* Risk Assessment: Skilled in identifying risks while considering operational constraints and availability requirements
* Security\-by\-Design: Proven ability to integrate security controls early in solution design and adapt them to real\-world operational limitations
* Cloud Security (Azure): Experience securing cloud services including access, network, and configuration management
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM): Managing users, roles, permissions, and multi\-factor authentication (MFA)
* Encryption \& Data Protection: Protecting sensitive data at rest and in transit


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong experience in IT and OT security architecture across infrastructure, applications, and integrations
* Experience with cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure, and cloud security principles
* Knowledge of security controls for on\-premises infrastructure (system hardening, network segmentation, identity management, logging)
* Experience reviewing integrations and APIs with secure authentication and data protection practices
* Understanding of application security and secure development principles


**Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills for complex technical environments
* Ability to work autonomously and manage priorities across multiple reviews and projects
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong organizational and coordination skills (scheduling, follow\-ups, tracking outcomes)
* Team\-oriented mindset with a collaborative approach
* Positive attitude, adaptability to new technologies, and evolving security challenges
* Strong attention to detail in reviewing documentation and designs
