Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. Lonza is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Position Summary:**

You will own the architecture from LLM prompt design to multi\-tenancy and vendor integration across HR platforms (Workday, SAP, Oracle HCM). You will collaborate with engineering, security, and product teams to translate business requirements into production\-ready AI agent solutions.

* (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or equivalent) for architecture work, design documentation, and engineering workflows. Familiarity with agentic engineering patterns is expected.

****Preferred Qualifications****
* Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocol for vendor and cross\-system integrations.

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Solution Architect — Marketing Cloud Next is the primary client\-facing technical authority for migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms — Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud Classic — to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and technical platform design: owning the end\-to\-end solution blueprint, leading functional discovery workshops, translating complex marketing business requirements into a Salesforce MCN solution architecture, and governing the functional quality of deliverables across the migration wave.
   

  

 Solution Architect owns the solution strategy, functional design and client relationship — ensuring the migrated platform delivers the business outcomes the client's marketing operations, CRM and digital teams need, while the Technical Architect delivers the technical implementation. Together with the Data Cloud Architect, the SA ensures migrated subscriber data, consent records and journey logic land in a well\-governed, AI\-ready, unified customer platform that sets the client up for Agentforce personalisation and Data Cloud activation post go\-live.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end functional discovery — running structured workshops with client marketing operations, CRM, data, compliance and digital teams to capture current\-state platform capabilities, subscriber data architecture, journey complexity, consent model and integration dependencies across all legacy marketing platforms.
* Own the solution blueprint — designing the Marketing Cloud Next target architecture, including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio and Data Cloud integration design, translating legacy platform features into MCN\-native equivalents and identifying where custom development is required.
* Author the migration approach document — defining the phased migration strategy, wave sequencing, subscriber migration methodology, journey migration priority framework, legacy platform deprecation schedule and business cutover approach with go/no\-go criteria.
* Design the subscriber data migration strategy — at the functional level: defining which subscriber segments migrate, the business rules governing data transformation, suppression list governance, consent record mapping requirements and the subscriber validation criteria the business will use to sign off each data wave.
* Own the consent and compliance architecture — mapping legacy consent records, preference data and suppression lists to Marketing Cloud Next consent model and Data Cloud consent API, ensuring GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI obligations are met in the migrated platform from day one.
* Design the journey migration blueprint — inventorying and assessing all legacy journeys, drip campaigns and triggered sends; prioritising for migration, rebuild or retirement; mapping legacy automation logic to Journey Builder native capabilities; and defining the functional acceptance criteria for each migrated journey.
* Lead Data Cloud integration design — defining the unified customer profile architecture, data stream sources, identity resolution business rules, audience segmentation strategy and activation targets for Marketing Cloud Next — in collaboration with the Data Cloud Architect.
* Manage scope and functional sign\-off — maintaining the solution scope register, managing scope change requests, producing functional design documents and obtaining formal business sign\-off at each MDLC phase gate before the Technical Architect begins build.
* Serve as Trusted Advisor to the client — building long\-term relationships with client marketing technology leads, digital directors, CDOs and Enterprise Architects; providing candid guidance on MCN platform capabilities, migration trade\-offs and post\-migration marketing strategy.
* Govern functional quality of deliverables — reviewing all functional design documents, process maps, data mapping sheets, journey design artefacts and user acceptance test scripts produced by the track team to ensure they meet factory quality standards and client expectations.
* Validate business process equivalence post\-migration — leading user acceptance testing (UAT) planning, supporting client business users through UAT execution, managing defect triage and confirming that migrated journeys, subscriber segments and send logic deliver the same business outcomes as the legacy platform.
* Lead email deliverability strategy — advising on IP warm\-up planning, domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation management and inbox placement testing strategy post\-migration.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory — building reusable MCN solution design templates, discovery workshop guides, journey migration assessment frameworks, consent architecture blueprints and migration approach documents for the factory accelerator library.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning — contributing to proposal development, migration scope estimation, resource planning and solution presentations for prospective Marketing Cloud Next migration engagements.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform — Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder. Able to architect solutions end\-to\-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
* Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to MCN — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect's technical approach.

description:
**Job Summary** 

 We are seeking a hands\-on, high\-impact Senior Technical Architect (Platform Backend) to lead the architecture, scaling, and continuous evolution of our core platform infrastructure. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high\-throughput transactional systems and cloud\-native architecture. You will be responsible for driving high\-level and low\-level designs (HLD/LLD), establishing engineering guardrails, optimizing complex data pathways, and collaborating directly with product and engineering leaders to ensure absolute reliability, performance, and low latency at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities:System Design \& Architectural Leadership:
 * Own the end\-to\-end High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) for core platform services, asynchronous processing components, and enterprise ERP/bank integration adapters.
* Facilitate a smooth transition from monolithic legacy boundaries into clean, highly cohesive microservices domains without impacting uptime or data integrity.
* Establish architectural governance, lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and review critical pull requests to safeguard code quality, clean architecture principles, and SOLID design patterns.


 Scalability, Performance \& Reliability:
 * Architect multi\-tenant, cloud\-native frameworks capable of handling high\-concurrency and petabyte\-scale financial transactions with strict SLAs.
* Diagnose and eliminate system bottlenecks across distributed transactions, locking models, memory management, and network payloads.
* Oversee zero\-trust security compliance, fault\-tolerance mechanisms, automated failover policies, and disaster recovery readiness.


 Data \& Integration Architecture:
 * Design robust relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and non\-relational database schemas, complex indexing strategies, data partitioning models, and archival frameworks.
* Scale event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or similar messaging systems to manage reliable real\-time data streaming and asynchronous decoupling.
* Optimize high\-throughput caching architectures (using Redis) to minimize database overhead for intensive financial computations.


 Engineering Culture \& Execution:
 * Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, driving proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs) for emerging technologies, and cultivating an environment of fast, first\-principles execution.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management to scope technical roadmaps, decompose epic requirements into modular milestones, and proactively mitigate technical debt.


 Required Skills
 
 A technically deep engineering/product leader with:
 


* **Experience:** 
 12 \- 16 years of professional software engineering experience, with a minimum of 3 years successfully operating in a Technical Architect or Principal Engineer capacity for enterprise SaaS products.
* **Core Backend Stack:** 
 Expert\-level mastery of Java (Java 17\+), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and enterprise\-grade backend frameworks. A profound understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, multi\-threading, and high\-concurrency programming models.
* **Distributed Systems \& Messaging:** 
 Proven experience in building distributed microservices, RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* **Database \& Storage Expertise:** 
 Advanced proficiency in SQL and NoSQL storage engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis). Hands\-on capability with query execution plans, partitioning, and database tuning under heavy write/read loads.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Infrastructure:** 
 Solid production experience with AWS (or Azure/GCP), containerization technologies (Docker), cluster orchestration (Kubernetes), and enterprise CI/CD deployment pipelines.

title: Associate Director, Commercial AI – Tech Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Director — Commercial AI – Tech Lead, Digital Human Health**
****Job Description****
 This role sits within the Commercial AI vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), which is responsible for building and scaling AI capabilities across cross\-functional teams and divisions. The team operates as an embedded strategic partner to the commercial organization, providing thought leadership and delivering AI\-powered solutions to marketing and cross\-functional stakeholders. It shapes demand by translating business priorities into scalable AI products and agent\-driven solutions that enhance decision\-making and drive measurable business impact.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 As the Associate Director – Commercial AI Tech Lead, you will define and lead the technical vision, architecture, and engineering execution for AI and Agentic AI products supporting our company’s Commercial use cases in India. You will play a pivotal role in building and scaling enterprise\-grade AI solutions, including LLM\-powered and agent\-based systems, from rapid prototyping through production deployment.You will establish robust engineering foundations, including reusable frameworks, SDKs, and best practices across LLMOps/MLOps, while ensuring governance, scalability, and compliance. This role requires close collaboration with commercial stakeholders, product and program leaders, enterprise architecture, and risk, security, and privacy teams to deliver impactful, business\-aligned solutions.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Own the reference architecture for Commercial AI \+ Agentic AI solutions, including patterns for RAG, orchestration, tool integration, identity, and observability across environments.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery discover → design → build → deploy → monitor → iterate; ensure production readiness (performance, reliability, security, cost).
* Engineer and ship agentic workflows (planning/reasoning, tool/function calling, reflection, memory patterns, guardrails) and harden them into enterprise\-grade services.
* Establish LLMOps/MLOps operating practices versioning/registry, automated evaluation, safe rollout/rollback, monitoring, and continuous improvement loops.
* Build and maintain reusable capabilities (templates, SDKs, integration patterns, deployment scaffolds) that accelerate delivery across multiple commercial products/teams.
* Drive governance and risk controls in partnership with security/privacy/legal responsible AI, data privacy, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and policy\-based enforcement where needed.
* Implement evaluation \& quality frameworks for LLM/agent systems (offline \+ online), including guardrail testing, prompt/retrieval regression tests, and business KPI alignment.
* Own observability for AI services tracing across prompt → retrieval/tool calls → response, cost/usage dashboards, incident triage, postmortems, and reliability improvements.
* Optimize latency, quality, and cost trade\-offs through caching, prompt/RAG tuning, model routing, and systematic performance benchmarking.
* Partner with business/product leaders to translate commercial problems into well\-scoped AI roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable platform components.
* Ensure solutions align with SDLC \+ validation expectations appropriate for regulated environments; embed documentation and controls into delivery.
* Mentor and lead engineers/data scientists design reviews, coding standards, coaching, hiring input, and building a high\-performing delivery culture.


**Technical Expertise**
**Agentic AI**
* Hands\-on experience designing multi\-step agents with planning, tool/function calling, orchestration, and reflection loops.
* Strong understanding of memory patterns (short\-term, long\-term, episodic), grounding strategies, and failure\-mode handling (loops, hallucinations, tool errors).
* Ability to implement guardrails policy enforcement, prompt injection defenses, tool\-use constraints, HITL checkpoints, and safe fallbacks.
* Expertise in agent evaluation task success scoring, trajectory analysis, tool\-call accuracy, safety checks, and regression automation.


**LLM Engineering**
* Proven experience with prompt engineering patterns, structured outputs, and reliability techniques (self\-checks, constrained decoding, schemas).
* Deep practical knowledge of RAG ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, context assembly, and grounding metrics.
* Understanding of embeddings and vector databases and how to tune retrieval for precision/recall in enterprise settings.
* Awareness of fine\-tuning approaches (when/why; trade\-offs) and model selection strategies for regulated enterprise use.
* Strong focus on latency/cost optimization and observability for GenAI systems (tracing \+ cost controls \+ quality monitoring).
* Experience with Enterprise AI engine – DataBricks AIBI, DataIku AI and Others
* Architecture, Integration \& Platform Thinking
* Ability to define reference architectures for commercial AI solutions and scalable design patterns for multiple products/markets.
* Experience integrating AI/agent services with enterprise applications/APIs, authentication/authorization, logging, and audit trails.
* Strong cloud\-native engineering containers, orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and reliability practices.


**Governance, Risk \& Responsible AI**
* Working knowledge of model governance documentation, validation, monitoring, auditability, and human oversight suitable for regulated environments.
* Data privacy/security\-by\-design access controls, encryption, secure secrets, and collaboration with InfoSec for audits and risk management.


****Education Requirements****
 Masters (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline with strong focus on AI/ML and modern data systems.
   

  

****Required Experience And Skills****
* 8\+ years in relevant experience across software engineering, ML engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, or AI product engineering, with hands on experience of production deployments at scale.
* 4\+ years leading teams and driving delivery across multiple stakeholders; proven ability to mentor and raise engineering standards.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python, API/service development, and modern engineering workflows (Git, code reviews, CI/CD).
* Proven experience implementing LLM applications and/or AI agents in production, including evaluation and monitoring.
* Strong cloud\-native foundation (Azure/AWS/GCP) containers, orchestration, automated testing, release discipline, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated capability to establish reusable frameworks/SDKs, integration patterns, and scalable operating models for AI delivery.
* Excellent stakeholder communication ability to explain trade\-offs, risks, and outcomes clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences


****Required Skills****
 Business Intelligence (BI), Coding Best Practices, Computer Science, Cost Controls, Database Design, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Privacy, Data Science, Data Visualization, Digital Healthcare, End to End Management, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Infrastructure Automation, Machine Learning (ML), Operational Excellence, Reference Architectures, Responsible AI, Software Development, Stakeholder Communications, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Waterfall Model

title: Sr. Staff Architect
description:
**About Gap Inc.**
 Our past is full of iconic moments — but our future is going to spark many more. Our brands — Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy and Athleta — have dressed people from all walks of life and all kinds of families, all over the world, for every occasion for more than 50 years.
   

  

 But we’re more than the clothes that we make. We know that business can and should be a force for good, and it’s why we work hard to make product that makes people feel good, inside and out. It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work. If you're one of the super\-talented who thrive on change, aren't afraid to take risks and love to make a difference, come grow with us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Staff Architect, you are a high\-impact individual contributor responsible for designing robust and scalable solutions within a domain stream. You bring deep technical and functional expertise and partner with cross\-functional teams to define and implement architecture that supports business and technical objectives. Department: Enterprise ArchitectureRole : Senior Staff Enterprise Solution ArchitectEmployment Type : Full\- TimeLocation: Hyderabad, India (HDC)This role is focused on hands\-on solution design, documentation, and delivery — with increasing influence across products, platforms, and governing teams. You bring deep expertise in retail and consumer goods, partnering with cross\-functional business, product, and engineering teams to define and implement architecture that is robust, scalable, and aligned to both business and technical objectives.You serve as a bridge between architecture and engineering leadership, ensuring consistency, quality, and performance of solutions. As AI reshapes how software is designed and delivered, you will play an active role in embedding AI\-driven thinking into architecture practices and championing adoption across your domain.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

**Solution design \& documentation**
* Design and document end\-to\-end solutions for key initiatives within your domain, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and business needs.


**Project architecture leadership**
* Lead architecture for individual projects and features, guiding engineering teams through solution execution and well\-reasoned technical trade\-offs.


**Cross\-functional collaboration**
* Partner with strategy teams, product managers, architects and engineers to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable architecture complaining to EA guidelines. Provide architectural input across multiple simultaneous initiatives.


**Quality, feasibility \& integration alignment**
* Ensure technical feasibility, performance, and integration alignment of solutions with adjacent systems and domains. Participate in defining, enhancing and ensuring design and code reviews to uphold architectural quality.


**Architecture framework \& reusability**
* Contribute to the evolution of architecture frameworks, reusable components, and reference implementations that raise the bar across the engineering organisation.


**Planning, estimation \& technology evaluation**
* Engage in early project planning and estimation through an architecture lens. Stay current with emerging technologies and help evaluate their applicability within your domain.


**AI ADOPTION**
* Identify and drive opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities into enterprise domain solutions to enhance business value and operational efficiency.
* Serve as a strategic advocate for responsible, ethical, and compliant AI adoption across the domain architecture landscape.
* Lead the execution and advancement of enterprise architecture strategies in alignment with the vision and direction established by Principal Architects.


**ENTERPRISE ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATION**
* Hands\-on solution design and delivery within a domain stream. Operationalises enterprise guidance into project\-level architecture.


**Alignment With Principal \& Sr Principal Architects**
 Engage regularly with Principal and Senior Principal Architects to ensure domain\-level solutions are grounded in enterprise architecture strategy. Consume and operationalise enterprise standards, patterns, and guardrails into project\-level designs, and surface domain\-specific insights that inform broader strategic decisions.
   

  

**Cross\-domain Architecture Reviews**
 Participate in architecture review boards and cross\-domain design forums facilitated by Principal Architects. Represent your domain's perspective, highlight integration touch\-points, and collaborate on solutions that span multiple domain streams.
   

  

**Feedback Loop \& Pattern Sharing**
 Maintain a continuous feedback loop with the EA team — sharing reusable patterns, lessons learned, and implementation experiences from domain delivery that can be elevated into enterprise\-wide frameworks and reference architectures.
   

  

**Strategic Roadmap Contribution**
 Contribute domain\-level input to enterprise technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives led by Senior Principal Architects. Help bridge the gap between long\-term architectural vision and near\-term delivery realities within your domain.
   

  

**SaaS Vendor Product Evaluations**
 Collaborate with Principal Architects and product stakeholders to ensure recommended SaaS choices are grounded in both domain delivery needs and long\-term enterprise architecture direction.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* Seasoned technologist with strong architectural thinking and a solid background in hands\-on software or platform engineering.
* Deep understanding of at least one architectural Product to Market domain stream, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to cross\-domain conversations.
* Able to manage and prioritise multiple concurrent initiatives, providing architectural support from planning through to delivery.
* Experienced engaging with senior architecture leadership — comfortable consuming enterprise strategy from Principal and Senior Principal Architects and translating it into grounded, deliverable domain solutions.
* Skilled at producing technical documentation and architecture artifacts that clearly communicate design intent to both Strategy, Business, Engineering and non\-technical stakeholders.

 Countries

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About us, but we'll be brief:**
 Experian is the world's leading global information services company, unlocking the power of data to create more opportunities for consumers, businesses and society. We are thrilled to share that FORTUNE has named Experian one of the 100 Best Companies to work for. In addition, for the last five years we've been listed as one of the 100 "World's Most Innovative Companies" by Forbes Magazine.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You will be the architecture owner for Experian's telephony, Teams Calling, and Contact Center services. As we modernize, we are moving toward a cloud‑first, Teams‑centric model. In this model, NICE will serve as the contact center platform, and we will use Teams Calling for corporate/campus telephony. This role is accountable for the end‑to‑end technical design and standards. This includes global telephony transformation. We mean this transformation to replace EOL Avaya, reduce on\-premise dependencies. It will also deliver features such as advanced IVR, dashboards, reporting, AI/speech recognition, omnichannel, call recording, and call accounting, etc. Additionally, I designed and guided Experian's contact center capability uplift. This included Presence Bi‑Sync with Salesforce Omni‑Channel, advanced quality, sentiment analysis, self‑service/automation, and ACD enhancements. I measured all of these against efficiency targets and business benefits. APAC modernization and discovery work (e.g., Teams Calling \+ NICE CXone direction; addressing EOL Cisco/Ribbon, India calling enablement constraints, and staff augmentation needs). This role directly owns PSTN/calling architecture, carrier/SBC design, numbering/porting, call routing, contact center flows, recording/QA/analytics, and compliance\-aligned controls. You will report to a Senior Director.
   

  

**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Own global telephony \& contact center target architectures: Define and maintain end‑to‑end designs for Teams Calling, NICE contact center, call routing, numbering, porting, recording/CDR, and integration patterns across regions.
* The UKI \& EMEA telephony modernization architecture authority is responsible for leading the technical approach. This approach involves replacing legacy Avaya, including the decommission of \~60 Avaya devices, and delivering the proposed campus/contact center changes. These changes include desk phone removal as standard, power\-user and VIP retention models, mandatory CC training, and enhanced IVR/ACD/analytics/automation capabilities.
* Contact center evolution and feature enablement involve architecting and governing advanced CC capabilities. We plan or have in\-flight these capabilities. They include integrating Salesforce enhancements, implementing Presence Bi\-Sync, developing omnichannel, creating QM\+/quality, conducting sentiment analysis, and designing automation/self\-service patterns. Examples of automation/self\-service patterns are password reset self\-service IVR flows and Origins integration.
* Compliance, risk, and data\-flow architecture: Own the technical inputs required to satisfy multi‑region risk/compliance needs, including DPIA/LIA/ROPA/TPRA patterns, country data residency constraints, and risk items affecting schedule/solution design. Drive "secure by design" call recording and processing architectures.
* Carrier/SBC and routing design leadership involves leading carrier/provider architecture decisions. It also includes solution designs, considering constraints that require Teams and NICE migrations to occur together in certain routing models. Additionally, it requires finalizing EMEA routing designs.
* Operational reliability and ITSM guardrails: Define architecture standards for availability, survivability, monitoring, and change rigor while modernization executes—balancing "run" stability with transformation delivery.
* Executive\-ready architecture artifacts: Produce reference architecture, option papers, sequencing plans, and risk statements to support business cases, funding approvals, vendor due diligence, and leadership decision forums.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years developing enterprise telephony/voice and contact center solutions in several environments (global/multi‑region preferred).
* Demonstrated experience modernizing from legacy PBX/contact center platforms to cloud SaaS models with emphasis on routing/porting/numbering, agent workflows, and service continuity.
* You have Contact center domain depth (e.g., NICE\-like platforms) including call flows, IVR/ACD, recording, QA, analytics, and CRM integration patterns.
* You have good partner communication—able to translate architecture tradeoffs into clear decisions for all kinds of audiences.
* You have operational governance and discipline; comfortable operating in environments with active risk, compliance review cycles, and change controls.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's strong people first approach is award winning; Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, FORTUNE Best Companies to work and Glassdoor Best Places to Work (globally 4\.4 Stars) to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Awareness** 
 \- Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best\-in\-class family well\-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.
   

  

 Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together

title: Vice President | Senior Engineer API Gateway
description:
Our team is responsible for building and evolving the enterprise API Gateway platform on AWS, providing secure, scalable, and innovative capabilities that support both traditional API protocols and emerging AI technologies. Working with a product mindset, we partner with engineering teams across Macquarie to deliver a seamless self\-service platform experience that enables developers to build, integrate, and innovate with speed and confidence.
   

  

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 In this role, you will design, deploy, and operate internal and external API Gateway platforms, with deep hands\-on ownership of Solo.io products, including routing, traffic management, transformations, rate limiting, and authentication/authorization. You will configure and manage API Gateways on Kubernetes, covering control plane setup, Envoy data plane optimization, Gateway API integration, and platform lifecycle management. You will also architect and deliver platform engineering capabilities on AWS EKS, including cluster provisioning, networking, autoscaling, service mesh implementation, and workload onboarding.
   

  

**What You Offer**

* Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes\-based API gateway platforms, particularly Solo.io Gloo, with exposure to other gateway solutions such as Kong, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, or Tyk considered advantageous.
* Proven platform engineering experience on AWS EKS, including Kubernetes operations, Terraform, Helm, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD/Flux), IAM, and VPC networking.
* Experience designing and operating CI/CD and developer platforms, with a focus on self\-service capabilities, GitOps practices, and automation using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation mindset, with proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash, and practical knowledge of API governance frameworks, standards, and tooling; experience with Gloo Mesh/Gloo Platform is a plus.

description:

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits

* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 We are seeking a seasoned Associate Director – Technology Lead to provide hands‑on engineering leadership and delivery oversight across Appian (Low‑Code BPM), Talend (Data Integration), and SQL‑based data platforms. This role is critical to improving release predictability, production stability, and engineering quality across globally distributed teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep technical foundations with exceptional leadership, delivery discipline, and stakeholder management. This role is accountable not only for what we build, but how reliably and sustainably we deliver enterprise\-grade solutions.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone who can set standards, enforce rigor, coach teams, and partner with business and technology stakeholders to ensure scalable, resilient, and high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Technology \& Engineering Leadership
   

  

* Provide clear technical vision and strategic direction across Appian, Talend, and SQL\-based platforms.
* Establish and enforce solution architecture standards, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Serve as the senior technical authority, reviewing designs and challenging solutions that introduce delivery, scalability, or operational risk.
* Drive consistent adoption of enterprise engineering principles, including modularity, reusability, performance, and security\-by\-design.


 Delivery Excellence \& Operational Rigor
   

  

* Own end‑to‑end delivery accountability, from solution design through development, testing, release, and production stabilization.
* Address historical delivery issues by strengthening release readiness, defect prevention, and root\-cause remediation practices.
* Implement and govern SDLC controls, including design reviews, code quality standards, testing expectations, and production readiness criteria.
* Actively manage delivery risk, dependencies, and cross\-team coordination, particularly across globally distributed teams.
* Ensure predictable delivery through strong planning discipline, execution tracking, and escalation management.


 Quality, Stability \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Drive a quality\-first culture, prioritizing defect prevention over detection.
* Partner with QA and DevOps teams to improve test automation, CI/CD maturity, deployment reliability, and rollback strategies.
* Analyze production issues and missed delivery commitments to identify systemic gaps and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Define and track engineering metrics (e.g., defect leakage, release stability, cycle time) to continuously improve delivery performance.


 Platform \& Domain Leadership
   

  

* Lead and mentor multi\-disciplinary, global engineering teams, including: \- Appian BPM developers
* Talend data integration engineers
* SQL / data engineers
* Provide technical leadership for: \- Appian\-based workflow, BPM, and low‑code solutions
* Talend ETL / ELT pipelines and data integration architecture
* SQL data modeling, performance tuning, and optimization for enterprise workloads
* Ensure platform solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise data and integration standards.


 People Leadership \& Talent Development
   

  

* Build and lead high\-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Set clear expectations for accountability, ownership, and engineering excellence.
* Identify skill gaps and drive targeted upskilling across architecture, quality, and modern delivery practices.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous learning across geographies and functions.


 Stakeholder \& Enterprise Engagement
   

  

* Act as a trusted technology partner to product owners, business leaders, architects, and platform teams.
* Translate business objectives into practical, scalable technology solutions with clear delivery commitments.
* Provide concise, executive\-ready communication on delivery status, risks, and mitigation strategies.


**Qualifications**
* 12–15 years of technology experience, with 5\+ years in senior leadership roles overseeing enterprise delivery.
* Proven success leading cross\-functional, globally distributed engineering teams.
* Experience in large enterprise or financial services environments, with an appreciation for regulatory, risk, and operational controls


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Strong, hands\-on experience with Appian BPM architecture and low\-code development (L2 or L3 certification strongly preferred).
* Appian L2 or L3 certification preferred.
* Advanced expertise in SQL databases, including data modeling, performance tuning, data lineage, and governance considerations.
* Proven experience producing HLDs and LLDs, and leading complex system and data integrations.
* Solid understanding of APIs, microservices, and SaaS\-based integrations.
* Demonstrated experience with Talend or equivalent ETL/data integration platforms.
* Practical experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation across enterprise platforms.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. title: Distinguished Engineer, Data Platforms
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
 13
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery**
* Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target enterprise data platform.
* Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
* Guide the design and operation of cloud\-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as:
+ Amazon S3 for durable storage
+ AWS Glue for integration and catalog\-driven processing
+ AWS Lambda for event\-driven processing
+ Amazon Kinesis for streaming use cases
+ AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls

* Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment\-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations.
* Influence architectural decisions related to Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Unity Catalog, metadata\-driven processing, and governed data lake design.


**AI\-Assisted Engineering and Context Engineering**
* Champion the adoption of AI\-powered development tools, including Claude, GitHub CoPilot, LLMs, and other AI\-assisted engineering solutions, to increase engineering velocity, code quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Apply LLM\-based tools to support common data engineering activities such as:
+ Code generation
+ Code refactoring
+ SQL optimization
+ PySpark optimization, etc.

* Develop and implement context engineering practices that provide AI tools with the necessary technical background, architectural constraints, data schemas, coding standards, platform patterns, security requirements, and governance expectations.
* Create reusable context packs, prompt libraries, and AI\-enabled engineering playbooks for common data platform tasks, including Databricks pipeline migration, ingestion framework development, test generation, code review support, and operational troubleshooting.
* Use LLMs to accelerate understanding and modernization of legacy pipelines, including dependency analysis, code explanation, transformation logic interpretation, metadata extraction, and refactoring recommendations.


**Data Onboarding and Asset\-Agnostic Enablement**
* Provide technical direction for offshore teams supporting data onboarding to the enterprise platform in an asset\-agnostic manner.
* Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case.
* Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform.
* Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event\-driven integrations where appropriate.


**Data Mastering Platform Integration**
* Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows.
* Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows required to support trusted mastered data in the platform.
* Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering\-related ingestion and distribution workflows.
* Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including: Data acquisition, Cleansing, Enrichment, Mastering, Reconciliation, Golden copy generation \& Downstream distribution of trusted data products.


**Semantic Modeling and Data Discoverability**
* Support semantic modeling practices that help create consistent business definitions, reusable data concepts, and governed consumption patterns across the enterprise data platform.
* Partner with business, architecture, data governance, and platform teams to align technical data structures with business\-friendly semantic definitions.
* Contribute to defining common entities, attributes, relationships, hierarchies, metrics, and business terms across key data domains such as instruments, issuers, accounts, portfolios, risk, market data, reference data, and investment data.
* Help connect semantic modeling concepts with metadata management, business glossaries, data catalogs, lineage, and governed data products.


**Technical Influence and Engineering Excellence**
* Serve as a senior technical expert for offshore data platform engineering, providing guidance on architecture, design patterns, implementation quality, and production readiness.
* Influence architectural decisions across pipeline migration, lakehouse design, cloud\-native data engineering, metadata\-driven processing, AI\-assisted engineering, and governed data platform operations.
* Provide technical guidance to engineers and partner teams without direct people management responsibility.
* Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, implementation planning, and technical problem\-solving for complex data platform initiatives.
* Support delivery execution by translating broader architectural direction into practical implementation patterns, engineering tasks, reusable technical assets, and AI\-enabled productivity accelerators.
* Drive rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business\-critical data platforms.


**Collaboration, Governance, and Platform Standards**
* Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, security, data mastering, and Databricks\-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding frameworks, cloud platform controls, data governance, AI\-assisted engineering practices, semantic modeling, and mastering integrations.
* Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, access control, auditability, metadata, and secure data distribution.
* Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate.
* Act as a technical bridge between offshore execution teams and global platform stakeholders to ensure alignment, reduce ambiguity, and accelerate delivery.
* Help define standards for responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including review practices, sensitive data handling, secure prompt construction, validation requirements, and production deployment controls.


**Required Qualifications**
**Technical Leadership and Delivery Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, cloud data architecture, software engineering, or related engineering domains.
* Demonstrated experience operating as a senior Individual Contributor, technical lead, principal engineer, staff engineer, distinguished engineer, architect, or equivalent role in complex data platform environments.
* Proven ability to provide technical guidance, influence architectural decisions, and drive engineering best practices across distributed teams.
* Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones.
* Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable technical designs, implementation patterns, and delivery plans.
* Comfortable operating in a role that blends hands\-on engineering, technical strategy, architecture influence, delivery enablement, and cross\-team technical mentorship.


**Data Platform and Cloud Engineering Expertise**
* Strong hands\-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows.
* Experience working with Databricks\-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse\-oriented architecture.
* Strong familiarity with AWS cloud\-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Kinesis, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms.
* Working knowledge of technologies and concepts such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Databricks Unity Catalog, metadata\-driven pipelines, data catalogs, and governed lakehouse architectures.
* Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, risk data, or trusted data distribution workflows.
* Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, encryption, observability, and operational support for production data pipelines.
* Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, policy\-based access controls, and metadata\-driven controls to support secure, policy\-aligned platform operations.
* Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release management, and monitoring.
* Experience designing or implementing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, telemetry, operational dashboards, and production support procedures.


**AI Tooling and Context Engineering**
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools such as Claude, GitHub CoPilot, LLMs, or similar AI\-enabled development tools in software engineering or data engineering workflows.
* Experience applying LLMs to engineering use cases such as code generation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, debugging, pipeline analysis, SQL optimization, PySpark optimization, and production support.
* Demonstrated understanding of context engineering, including how to structure technical requirements, architectural constraints, data schemas, data contracts, examples, coding standards, logs, and acceptance criteria to improve AI\-generated outputs.
* Ability to create reusable context packs, prompt templates, engineering playbooks, and documentation patterns that improve consistency and quality of AI\-assisted engineering work.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code, recommendations, and documentation for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Experience using AI\-assisted workflows to improve engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate controls for production\-grade systems.


**Collaboration and Execution**
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams.
* Ability to influence technical direction without relying on formal people\-management authority.
* Experience contributing to design reviews, architecture discussions, technical standards, implementation planning, and production readiness assessments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging, metadata management, business glossary, lineage, operational metadata platforms, or semantic data layers.
* Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets.
* Experience with NeoXam\-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, stewardship, golden copy creation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
* Knowledge of semantic modeling is a strong plus, particularly for designing consistent business definitions, improving data discoverability, supporting governed data consumption, and aligning business terminology with technical data products.
* Experience applying AI\-assisted engineering practices to data pipeline migration, Databricks development, AWS data engineering, metadata analysis, data quality investigation, documentation automation, or production support.
* Databricks certifications, AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus.

description:

 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role manages technical support staff who provide technical support for the design and building of technical solutions. Provides leadership in designing, developing and implementing solutions in support of the business, according to standards and policies, while mentoring junior staff and guiding technology decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, business judgment, and problem\-solving ability.

While hands\-on coding is not a primary responsibility, the successful candidate must possess sufficient technical depth to guide engineering teams, evaluate solutions, and influence architectural decisions.

title: Senior Technical Lead (Product Releases & Engineering)
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
 Company Name: Incepteo
   

  

 Industry: Information Technology \& Services
   

  

 Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level
   

  

 Experience: 5\+ yrs
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
   

  

 Job Type: Full\-time
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 Senior Technical Lead – Product Releases \& Engineering
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.
   

  

 The role sits between the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, Technical Architect and engineering team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that multiple developers, features and code changes come together into stable, well\-coordinated product releases.
   

  

 This is not simply a senior developer role and it is not a purely managerial position. You must remain technically hands\-on while taking ownership of release coordination, engineering discipline and day\-to\-day technical delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Management
   

  

 You will coordinate releases across Development → Test / QA → UAT → Production → Monitoring.
   

  

  

* Coordinate release scope with the Product Owner and Delivery Manager, maintaining visibility of features, fixes and dependencies
* Ensure development, code reviews, integration and testing are completed before release and conduct technical release\-readiness checks
* Coordinate application, API, database and configuration changes; manage release branches, versioning, hotfixes and production fixes
* Coordinate deployments across Dev, Test, UAT and Production, support UAT issue resolution and provide technical Go / No\-Go recommendations
* Ensure rollback or recovery procedures are understood, validate Production releases and coordinate post\-release issue resolution


 The objective is to create a repeatable, controlled and increasingly automated release process rather than relying on individual developers or last\-minute effort.
   

  

 Engineering Team Coordination
   

  

  

* Maintain visibility of development progress and identify dependencies across frontend, backend, database and integrations
* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early
* Coordinate work where features cross multiple components, help resolve difficult technical issues and review progress against sprint and release commitments
* Escalate architectural concerns to the Technical Architect, delivery risks to the Delivery Manager, and work with the Product Owner where requirements need clarification


 The successful candidate should bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
   

  

 Engineering Maturity \& Quality
   

  

 You will help strengthen:
   

  

  

* Pull\-request and code\-review discipline; Git branching, merge management, release branching and versioning
* Definition of Done, release\-readiness criteria, automated build/test/deployment, code coverage and automated testing
* Environment management, logging and monitoring, technical documentation, incident management and root\-cause analysis
* Technical\-debt management and secure development practices


 You will ensure code produced by different developers is properly reviewed, consolidated and integrated before entering shared environments.
   

  

 Hands\-On Technical Capability
   

  

 Although release and team coordination are the main focus, this remains a hands\-on technical leadership role. You should be comfortable working across React / React.js, Python, REST APIs and backend services, MySQL or similar relational databases, Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions / CI/CD, Google Cloud Platform, authentication and authorisation, SaaS integrations, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
   

  

 Strong, practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and GitHub is vital for this role. You should have hands\-on experience using Google Cloud services to deploy, operate, monitor and troubleshoot production SaaS applications, and be confident managing GitHub repositories, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews, permissions and GitHub Actions\-based CI/CD workflows.
   

  

 You should be capable of reviewing code, challenging implementation decisions and stepping into complex technical or production issues when necessary.
   

  

 Experience with AI applications, LLMs, agents, RAG, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini would be advantageous.
   

  

 Production \& Incident Management
   

  

  

* Assess incident severity and impact, coordinate developers during investigation and identify root causes
* Manage hotfixes and emergency releases, communicate technical status clearly and validate systems following fixes
* Conduct root\-cause reviews and ensure preventative actions are completed


 We are looking for someone who remains calm, methodical and accountable under pressure.
   

  

 Experience We Are Looking For
   

  

 Ideally, you will have 5\+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful technical leadership responsibility in a production SaaS environment, including:
   

  

  

* Coordinating development teams and managing SaaS releases into Production across Dev, Test, UAT and Production environments
* Google Cloud deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting
* GitHub repository, branch, pull\-request and permissions management, including GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation
* Release\-readiness, deployment processes, code consolidation and strong code\-review practices
* Production incident resolution, cross\-functional working with Product Owners, architects and delivery managers, and continuous engineering process improvement


 We are particularly interested in candidates who have personally owned these responsibilities, rather than simply participated within a team where others managed releases and coordination.
   

  

 Leadership Maturity
   

  

  

* Ownership – takes responsibility and drives outcomes
* Judgement – knows when to proceed, challenge or escalate
* Organisation – keeps multiple developers and dependencies coordinated
* Communication – explains technical issues clearly
* Composure – remains effective during releases and incidents
* Constructive leadership – guides developers without micromanaging
* Quality mindset – balances speed with reliability
* Continuous improvement – strengthens processes after every release


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

  

* More predictable and controlled releases with clear ownership and readiness criteria
* Better engineering coordination with earlier visibility of blockers and dependencies
* Stronger GitHub, PR, code\-review, testing and CI/CD discipline and more reliable Google Cloud operations
* Fewer release\-related defects and last\-minute integration issues, with faster Production incident resolution
* Improved engineering maturity and reduced dependency on individual heroics


**In one sentence: Your responsibility is to turn multiple developers, features and code changes into one coordinated engineering team delivering stable, high\-quality SaaS releases consistently for the Stratpilot venture, using strong GitHub practices and reliable Google Cloud delivery and operations.**
**About The Company**
 About Incepteo Labs Incepteo Labs Private Limited is a dynamic and fast\-growing startup venture builder creating innovative technology products and businesses. This role offers the opportunity to work in a high\-energy environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution and where engineer
   

  

 Good\-to\-have skills
   

  

 Release Management

title: Cloud AI Security - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Manager \- Cloud AI Security
   

  

 Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross\-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high\-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.
   

  

 Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
   

  

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud\-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001\.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform\-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service\-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud\-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI\-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red\-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.


**The team**
 Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
   

  

**Required:**
* 9\+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI\-related programs.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud\-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.
* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.


**Preferred:**
* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud\-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM\-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API\-driven, and agent\-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go\-to\-market offerings, and practice\-building activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior\-level cloud and security credentials.

description:

**What You’ll Do**
 As a
 **Principal Engineer**

 **Database Marketplace**

* Design, architect, develop, and maintain high quality systems, services, and applications with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineers and product partners to shape architecture and consistently deliver end to end features.
* Storage layer evolution — Work on page management, durability guarantees, and consistency semantics across disaggregated compute\-storage topologies.
* Write path and recovery — Extend the logging and recovery subsystem for multi\-node and branching workload patterns.
* Concurrency and isolation — Build visibility and isolation semantics for non\-linear, multi\-context execution patterns.
* Executor\-storage interface — Own buffer management, prefetch behavior, and cost model correctness when storage is remote.
* Agentic tooling — Use AI coding agents critically on a large C/C\+\+ codebase. Know where they fail.
* Technical leadership — Drive implementation\-level decisions across global engineering teams.


**Who You’ll Work With**
 You will be part of a high\-performing engineering team building core components of Teradata’s AI platform. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, AI/ML specialists, product managers, cloud architects, and partner teams across the company. The role offers opportunities to contribute directly to Teradata’s AI product roadmap and technological direction.
   

  

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
* Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a recognized institution.
* 15\+ years of experience on backend services, distributed systems, or data platform development.
* Strong proficiency in C, C\+\+, Rust for development.
* Internals experience with PostgreSQL or postgres based relational engine — source\-level, not API\-level
* Deep understanding of the WAL write path, checkpointing, and crash recovery mechanics
* Ability to trace and resolve concurrency anomalies through the engine's MVCC implementation
* Clear mental model of where traditional storage assumptions live in the executor and buffer manager
* Practical experience with AI coding assistants on production systems engineering work


**What You’ll Bring**
* Deep expertise in systems or database engineering, with meaningful time spent inside a relational engine at the source level
* Demonstrated contributions to PostgreSQL or an equivalent open\-source engine — patches, extensions, or fork\-level work
* Production experience with storage or replication subsystems under real failure conditions
* Comfort operating across distributed teams with high autonomy and low process overhead
* A track record of technical decisions that held up — and the judgment to know when to revisit them


**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
 We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally.  Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace.
